title: 007 Legends
description: 007 Legends is a first-person shooter video game featuring the character of British secret agent James Bond. It was developed by Eurocom and released by Activision on October 2012 for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, November 2012 for Microsoft Windows and December 2012 for Wii U. The game is available as physical optical disc media, as well as a digital release download via PlayStation Network and Xbox Live Marketplace on date of release. It was removed off all other digital stores without warning.

title: 1001 Spikes
description: Prepare to die. A lot. This brutally challenging retro-style platformer demands pixel-perfect precision as you guide adventurer Aban Hawkins through ancient temples filled with deadly traps, spikes, and devious obstacles. Every level is a gauntlet of instant death, where timing and memorization are everything. With over 100 stages of punishing difficulty, unlockable characters each with unique abilities, and competitive multiplayer modes, 1001 Spikes rewards persistence with that sweet taste of victory after countless failures. The 8-bit aesthetic masks a modern design philosophy that respects your intelligence while testing your reflexes.

140 is a mesmerizing rhythm-action platformer where music and gameplay merge into one synchronized experience. Guide a shape-shifting geometric character through minimalist abstract worlds that pulse, shift, and transform in perfect harmony with the electronic soundtrack. Every jump, dash, and movement must be precisely timed to the beat as platforms materialize, obstacles animate, and the environment breathes with the music. The game strips away all unnecessary elements to create a pure challenge of rhythm and reflexes across three increasingly intense levels. Each stage introduces new mechanics that test your ability to internalize the beat while navigating deadly hazards.

title: 153 Hand Video Poker
description: Play 153 hands of video poker simultaneously in this unique casino simulation from Skunk Software. Each dealt hand triggers a corresponding piano chord based on its rank, creating an audiovisual poker experience. Choose your holds across all hands, then watch as the game analyzes each result in sequence. Features standard video poker gameplay including Jacks or Better rules, with the distinctive twist of managing over a hundred hands at once. The sheer scale transforms traditional video poker into a test of patience as you wait through extended analysis sequences to see your winnings across all active hands.

title: 6-Hand Video Poker
description: Experience casino-style video poker on your Wii U with the ability to play six hands simultaneously. Start with a set amount of credits and place bets across all six hands at once. Choose which cards to hold or discard, then watch as your hands are compared against the pay table for payouts. Features unlimited play with a realistic pay structure and a Las Vegas-themed backdrop. Track your credit totals across sessions as you aim to build your virtual bankroll through strategic card play and lucky draws in this digital poker experience.

title: 6180 the Moon
description: Defy gravity in this minimalist puzzle platformer where the moon has disappeared and the sun has gone dark. Play as the moon itself, navigating through a mysterious universe by inverting gravity and seamlessly wrapping between the top and bottom of the screen. Each of the 60+ levels presents intricate challenges that demand precise timing and creative thinking as you master the unique screen-wrapping mechanic. Accompanied by a hauntingly beautiful ambient soundtrack, guide the moon through ethereal environments in search of the sun.

title: 8Bit Hero
description: Team up with up to four friends in this retro hack-and-slash adventure that blends 2D pixelated characters with 3D environments. Battle through eight worlds and over 30 challenging levels across three difficulty modes—Casual, Arcade, or Hardcore. Explore a secret-filled world to discover hidden weapons, tools, and pixel pieces that extend your hit points. Customize your attacks with special equipment found throughout your journey and spend loot on upgrades. The unique visual style features cardboard-like characters in a pop-up book aesthetic, creating a distinctive retro arcade experience with local co-op gameplay. Sources: - [8Bit Hero Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.n...

title: 99Moves
description: 99Moves is a unique puzzle game that challenges you to clear the board in exactly 99 moves or less. Each level presents a grid filled with colored blocks that you must eliminate by matching three or more of the same color. The twist? Every single move counts toward your strictly limited total of 99 moves across the entire game. Strategic planning is essential as you progress through increasingly complex puzzles, deciding when to make aggressive plays and when to conserve moves for later challenges. Chain reactions and careful positioning become critical as the difficulty ramps up. Can you master the perfect sequence of moves to conquer all levels before your move counter hits zero?

title: 99Seconds
description: Race against time in this fast-paced puzzle platformer where every second counts. You have just 99 seconds to navigate through increasingly challenging levels filled with obstacles, traps, and hazards. Collect stars to add precious time to your dwindling clock while avoiding deadly spikes, moving platforms, and other dangers. Master tight controls and precise timing as you dash, jump, and wall-slide through compact levels designed for speedrunning. Each completion unlocks new stages with devious layouts that demand quick reflexes and smart routing. With minimalist pixel art and addictive one-more-try gameplay, every fraction of a second matters in your quest to beat the clock.

title: A Day at the Carnival
description: Step into a desolate carnival wasteland where colorful tents house simple yet engaging mini-games designed for family fun. Play through six carnival classics including skeeball and dart throwing, each offering straightforward gameplay that anyone can enjoy. Rack up points across the various attractions to unlock the secret seventh mini-game and prove your carnival skills. Created by independent developer Thornbury Software with simplified graphics and accessible mechanics, this budget-friendly collection delivers quick carnival thrills.

title: A World of Keflings
description: Build and expand a thriving kingdom with the help of tiny Keflings in this charming city-building adventure. As a giant among the pint-sized inhabitants, you'll gather resources, construct buildings, and shape entire cities across colorful fantasy worlds. Command your Kefling workers to harvest materials, transport supplies, and bring your architectural visions to life. Explore multiple kingdoms, each with unique themes and challenges. Customize your giant avatar and unlock special buildings as you progress. The game blends relaxing creativity with strategic planning, letting you build at your own pace while discovering new blueprints and expanding your influence across the land.

title: A.C.E.
description: Aliens have infested cities across the world, and it's your job to clean them up in this brutally challenging arcade throwback. Inspired by 90s coin-op machines, ACE offers no menus, no options, and no easy mode—just pure, unforgiving action where one hit means game over. Battle through procedurally generated levels, rack up high scores, and compete against players worldwide on the online leaderboards. With its old-school difficulty and score-chasing gameplay, ACE delivers an authentic arcade experience that demands precision, quick reflexes, and nerves of steel. Can you survive the alien cleanup? Character count: 598 Sources: - [A.C.E.

title: Absolutely Unstoppable MineRun
description: A challenging vertical auto-runner where an out-of-control Miner must escape rising lava. Navigate 16 vertical levels of escalating difficulty using precisely timed jumps and double jumps to reach the top. Features 3 objectives per level for added challenge. Supports 1-5 players with two multiplayer modes, including a unique "Describe & Draw" mode. Difficulty ranges from very easy to near-impossible, demanding memorization and timing over pure skill.

title: Abyss
description: Guide Nep2no, a bio-mechanical deep-sea submarine, through the ocean depths in the year 3024 to harvest Gaia energy stones. Navigate 12 increasingly challenging missions while battling gravity's constant pull in this physics-based survival game. Collect energy sources while avoiding obstacles in the dark abyss. Features competitive two-player mode with asymmetric GamePad and TV play, plus unlockable Dark Mode with tougher challenges and time-attack Arcade Mode for skilled players. title: Adventure Party - Cats and Caverns
description: A unique tabletop-inspired party RPG where one player becomes the Storyteller using the GamePad to control the world, while up to four Adventurers explore dungeons filled with feline-themed creatures. Players collaborate through role-playing interactions as the Storyteller narrates their journey through caverns, presenting challenges and controlling NPCs. Features four story missions offering 10-15 hours of cooperative gameplay that blends digital gaming with pen-and-paper RPG mechanics, emphasizing creative storytelling and player interaction over traditional combat systems. Sources: - [Adventure Party: Cats and Caverns (2016) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.co

title: Adventure Time Explore the Dungeon Because I Don't Know!
description: Join Finn and Jake in this dungeon-crawling adventure through the Secret Royal Dungeon beneath the Candy Kingdom. Princess Bubblegum has tasked you with exploring 100 floors of monster-filled mayhem to uncover why the creatures inside are acting so weird. Battle through procedurally-generated levels solo or team up with up to four friends in local co-op, choosing from beloved characters including Finn, Jake, Marceline, Cinnamon Bun, and others. Collect treasure, upgrade your heroes' abilities, and unleash special attacks as you descend deeper into the dungeon. Featuring the show's signature humor and art style, you'll encounter familiar faces and discover new secrets in the Land of Ooo.

title: Adventure Time Finn and Jake Investigations
description: Join Finn and Jake in this adventure game that brings the Land of Ooo to life with an original story and the humor fans love. Investigate strange occurrences across five exciting cases, from mysterious disappearances to supernatural happenings. Use Finn's sword skills and Jake's shape-shifting abilities to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and interrogate colorful characters from the show. Explore 3D environments across familiar locations, collect clues, and piece together evidence. The game features full voice acting from the original cast and captures the show's distinctive art style and comedic tone. Perfect for Adventure Time fans and newcomers alike. Character count: 663

title: Adventures of Pip
description: Adventures of Pip is a side-scrolling action platformer where you literally evolve your character through three distinct pixel forms. Start as a single pixel, then transform into an 8-bit hero, and finally a detailed 16-bit warrior. Each form has unique abilities: the single pixel can float and fit through tiny gaps, 8-bit Pip delivers powerful punches, and 16-bit Pip wields a sword for combat and wall-jumping. You'll need to master evolving and devolving between forms to solve environmental puzzles, defeat enemies, and navigate cleverly designed levels. Battle through five worlds to rescue the kidnapped princess and restore the Pixel Kingdom from the evil Skeleton Queen.

title: Affordable Space Adventures
description: Affordable Space Adventures is a puzzle adventure game developed and published by NapNok Games in collaboration with Nifflas' Games. The game was released for the Wii U via the Nintendo eShop download service on April 9, 2015. The game's main gameplay feature is its unique use of the Wii U Gamepad to control a spaceship by using the controls shown on the touch-screen including two different engines and other controls. .

title: Alice in Wonderland
description: An interactive visual novel adaptation of Lewis Carroll's classic tale. Choose chapters, select settings, and experience the timeless story of Alice's journey through Wonderland with narrated text, 2D character illustrations over photographic backgrounds, and occasional story choices. Designed to bring classic literature to life for young audiences who prefer visual storytelling over traditional reading. Features the complete original story across multiple chapters. Sources: - [Alice in Wonderland (Wii U eShop) Review - Seafoam Gaming](https://seafoamgaming.com/2016/10/08/alice-in-wonderland-wii-u-eshop-review/) - [Alice in Wonderland (2016) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.n

title: Alphadia Genesis
description: Alphadia Genesis is a classic-style Japanese RPG that combines traditional turn-based combat with a deep narrative spanning two intertwined worlds. Play as Fray and his companions as they uncover the mystery behind dangerous energy clones threatening the kingdom. The game features a rich job system allowing characters to master multiple classes, strategic turn-based battles with combo attacks, and extensive character customization. Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and engage in side quests across vibrant environments.

title: amiibo Tap
description: amiibo Tap transforms your amiibo figures into keys that unlock playable scenes from classic NES games. Each amiibo reveals a different retro Nintendo title, letting you experience iconic moments from games like Super Mario Bros., The Legend of Zelda, Metroid, and more. Tap an amiibo to the GamePad and discover which game you've unlocked, then play through a timed demo scene showcasing memorable levels and gameplay. With multiple NES classics available and different amiibo unlocking different titles, this free application offers a nostalgic journey through Nintendo's 8-bit heritage while adding new purpose to your amiibo collection.

title: Angry Birds Trilogy
description: Launch into addictive physics-based mayhem with three complete Angry Birds adventures in one package. Sling your feathered arsenal across hundreds of levels from the original Angry Birds, Seasons, and Rio, using the Wii U GamePad's intuitive touchscreen controls or traditional inputs. Each bird brings unique abilities to demolish the egg-stealing pigs' increasingly elaborate fortifications. Master precision shots, discover hidden bonus content, and chase three-star perfection through diverse themed worlds ranging from tropical beaches to snowy wonderlands.

title: Angry Birds: Star Wars
description: Join an epic adventure with the Angry Birds in the legendary Star Wars universe, re-mastered for gaming systems! Use the Force, wield your Lightsaber, and blast away Pigtroopers on an intergalactic journey from the deserts of Tatooine to the depths of the Pig Star! Can you become a Jedi Master and restore freedom to the galaxy?

title: Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures
description: Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures is a brutally challenging retro platformer that throws you into the Nerd's pixelated nightmare. Battle through eight fiendishly difficult stages filled with death blocks, impossible jumps, and references to gaming's most notorious failures. Armed with your trusty Zapper and special weapons like the Super Scope and Power Glove, you'll face bosses inspired by terrible games while the Nerd's signature crude humor drives the experience. This is old-school difficulty cranked to eleven—expect to die hundreds of times as you navigate pixel-perfect jumps and memorize enemy patterns.

title: Animal Crossing Plaza
description: Animal Crossing is a social simulation video game series developed and published by Nintendo and was created by Katsuya Eguchi. In Animal Crossing, the player character is a human who lives in a village inhabited by anthropomorphic animals, carrying out various activities including fishing, bug catching, fossil hunting, etc. The series is notable for its open-ended gameplay and extensive use of the video game consoles' internal clock and calendar to simulate real passage of time.

title: Animal Crossing: amiibo Festival
description: Animal Crossing: Amiibo Festival is a party video game developed by Nintendo and NDcube for the Wii U. The game is a spin-off of the Animal Crossing series, and was released worldwide in November 2015.

title: Animal Gods
description: Play as Thistle, an ancient hunter on a mission to destroy the curse plaguing fallen gods in Bronze Age Europe. This beautifully illustrated top-down adventure combines zen-like exploration with skill-based puzzling and precision platforming. Choose your path through the Gardens of Gwyn, Halls of Eynd, and Coast of Syn, wielding a Bronze Age sword against one-hit-kill challenges. Each dungeon offers unique weapons and upgrades as you battle to free the cursed Animal Gods through approximately 75% skill and 25% strategy-based gameplay. Sources: - [Animal Gods for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/animal-gods-wii-u/) - [Animal Gods (2017) | Wii U eShop Game

title: Annihilation
description: Defend your base in this top-down arcade shooter as endless waves of enemies spawn in random variations. Battle solo or team up with a friend in co-op mode to fight off the relentless onslaught. Face increasingly challenging waves as you protect your position and rack up points. Simple but intense gameplay designed for quick sessions, with randomized enemy patterns keeping each playthrough fresh. title: Another World - Out of This World
description: You are Lester Knight Chaykin, a brilliant physicist whose experiment goes catastrophically wrong, teleporting you to a hostile alien world. Armed with nothing but your wits and eventually an energy pistol, you must survive deadly encounters with indigenous creatures and alien captors. This cinematic platformer pioneered rotoscoped animation and atmospheric storytelling without dialogue. Navigate treacherous environments through precision jumping, puzzle-solving, and strategic combat. Form an unlikely alliance with an alien prisoner as you fight to escape. Every screen presents a new lethal challenge requiring quick reflexes and careful observation.

title: Aqua Moto Racing Utopia
description: Aqua Moto Racing Utopia delivers high-speed jet ski racing action across stunning open-world environments. Pilot powerful watercraft through dynamic ocean waves, perform gravity-defying stunts, and master challenging courses in both single-player and multiplayer modes. The game features a robust career mode where you'll unlock new vehicles and customize your ride with performance upgrades. Race through tropical paradises, navigate treacherous weather conditions, and compete in various event types including circuit races, time trials, and freestyle competitions. The Wii U GamePad integration provides unique control options and real-time race data.

title: Archery
description: An archery tournament featuring multiple levels from easy indoor target ranges to challenging outdoor courses. Aim carefully and hit stationary and moving animal-shaped targets to earn points and advance through increasingly difficult stages. Designed with younger players in mind, this arcade-style archery simulator uses the Wii U GamePad or Wii Remote for aiming. Progress through sharp-shooter challenges by meeting point requirements in each level, testing your precision and timing across varied environments and target configurations. Sources: - [Archery by Thornbury Software - Nintendo Official Page](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/archery-by-thornbury-software-wii-u/) - [Archery by

title: Armikrog
description: Step into a handcrafted world of stop-motion clay animation in this unique point-and-click adventure from the creators of Earthworm Jim and The Neverhood. You are Tommynaut, a space explorer who crash-lands on a mysterious planet with your blind alien dog Beak-Beak. Together you must explore the fortress of Armikrog, solving environmental puzzles and uncovering the secrets of this strange world. Every frame is meticulously crafted in physical clay, creating a distinctive visual style unlike anything else. Navigate bizarre rooms, interact with peculiar creatures, and piece together the story through exploration and discovery in this homage to classic adventure games.

title: Armillo
description: Roll into action as Armillo, a space armadillo on a mission to save his home planet from an alien invasion. This creative 3D platformer blends classic rolling gameplay with unique spherical level design. Navigate through vibrant planets by rolling, boosting, and bouncing across challenging obstacle courses. Collect orbs, rescue critters called cubes, and battle mechanical enemies in fast-paced environments. Switch between the colorful 3D worlds and retro-inspired 2D bonus stages for variety. Use special power-ups to freeze time, grow massive, or blast through enemies.

title: Armored Acorns
description: Four squirrels equipped with advanced robots must save their friends from an evil cat CEO in this retro-inspired beat 'em up. Play as Flapjack, Foxglove, Nitelite, and Pothole through caves, forests, and cities. Features 1-4 player local co-op with unique repair abilities to revive teammates. Control squirrels, robots, and vehicles while unleashing special Armored Mode super abilities. Comic-style cutscenes and quirky dialogue accompany the arcade-style brawling action. Use the Wii U GamePad to scan enemies for helpful hints. Sources: - [Co-Optimus - Armored ACORNs: Action Squirrel Squad](https://www.co-optimus.com/game/8382/nintendo-wii-u/armored-acorns-action-squirrel-squad.html) - [GameF

title: Arrow Time U
description: Guide a neon blue arrow through 40 challenging levels to reach the portal exit. Navigate obstacles and solve puzzles using special abilities including a meter-limited slide power to phase through objects, time-slowing mechanics, and diagonal gliding movement. Race against the clock while managing limited health and power resources. Every 10th level features a boss battle. Developed by XenoHorizon for the Wii U eShop. title: Art Academy Home Studio
description: Art Academy: Home Studio transforms your Wii U into a comprehensive digital art studio where you can create beautiful paintings and drawings using the GamePad as your canvas. Master various artistic techniques through guided lessons that teach everything from basic sketching and color theory to advanced painting methods, or dive straight into Free Paint mode to unleash your creativity without restrictions. Use the stylus to work with realistic tools including pencils, pastels, and oil paints that respond naturally to pressure and stroke direction. The lessons are taught by experienced instructors who provide step-by-step guidance suitable for beginners and experienced artists alike.

title: Art Academy: SketchPad
description: Art Academy, also known as Art Academy: Learn painting and drawing techniques with step-by-step training in the PAL regions and Artistic Taste Classroom DS in Japan, is an art training software for the Nintendo DS handheld game console. It was developed by Headstrong Games, and published by Nintendo. Art Academy was originally a two-part training application only available for download via the DSiWare service since 2009. It was later re-released in 2010 as a fully compiled, retail-able DS Game Card with added features, thus also making it available for original Nintendo DS and Nintendo DS Lite users.

title: Art of Balance
description: Art of Balance is a physics-based puzzle video game developed and published by Shin'en Multimedia. The game was originally released on WiiWare in 2010, then ported to the Wii U's eShop in 2013, PlayStation 4 in 2016 and to Nintendo Switch in 2018. A version was also ported to the Nintendo 3DS's eShop in 2012, titled Art of Balance TOUCH!

title: Ascent of Kings
description: Race to claim the throne in this side-scrolling adventure-platformer with retro 8-bit style. Play as the youngest of four siblings competing to become king. Explore dangerous passages filled with creatures and deadly traps, solve puzzles to access twelve elemental shrines, and unlock new abilities like extended swimming and climbing to reach previously inaccessible areas. Throw stones to defend yourself while navigating challenging platforming sections. Features responsive controls with Off-TV Play support on GamePad. Sources: - [Ascent of Kings Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/ascent_of_kings) - [Ascent of Kings for Wii U - Nintendo Game

title: Asdivine Hearts
description: Embark on a grand fantasy adventure across the world of Asdivine in this classic-style JRPG. A century after a catastrophic event, deity Asdivine Light descends in cat form, enlisting a young man named Zack and his companions to prevent the world's destruction. Battle through turn-based encounters with a unique trust system that unlocks powerful combo attacks as relationships deepen. Craft weapons, customize skills, and develop your party through an extensive growth system. Explore diverse environments from bustling towns to perilous dungeons while unraveling a conspiracy threatening the realm.

title: Assassin's Creed III
description: Assassin's Creed III is a 2012 action-adventure video game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Wii U, and Microsoft Windows. It is the fifth major installment in the Assassin's Creed series, and a direct sequel to 2011's Assassin's Creed: Revelations. The game was released worldwide for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, beginning in North America on October 30, 2012, with a Wii U and Microsoft Windows release in November 2012.

title: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag
description: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag is an action-adventure video game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft. It is the sixth major instalment in the Assassin's Creed series. Its historical time frame precedes that of Assassin's Creed III (2012), though its modern-day sequences succeed III's own. Black Flag was first released for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Wii U in October 2013 and a month later for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Microsoft Windows.

title: Asteroid Quarry
description: Humanity has exhausted Earth's resources and turned to the cosmos for survival. Pilot an advanced light-speed craft to mine valuable ore from asteroid fields across the galaxy. Destroy asteroids to break them apart, then collect the precious fragments before they drift away into space. Defend yourself against pirate ships using the central space station's missile defenses. Meet mining quotas to progress through increasingly challenging asteroid configurations in this arcade-style shooter inspired by classic space games. Sources: - [Asteroid Quarry Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/asteroid_quarry) - [Asteroid Quarry for Wii U - GameFAQs](h

title: Ava and Avior Save the Earth
Avoider
description: Drag your triangle-shaped ship across the touchscreen to dodge incoming enemy spacecraft that spawn randomly from all sides. Your sluggish vessel requires careful path planning to avoid collisions as enemies swarm the screen. Survive as long as possible to rack up points in this simple but challenging arcade avoidance game. The minimalist visuals keep the focus on reflexes and quick decision-making as the screen fills with geometric threats. title: Axiom Verge
description: Explore a vast, interconnected alien world filled with hidden secrets, deadly enemies, and powerful upgrades in this acclaimed metroidvania-style adventure. After a catastrophic event strands scientist Trace on a mysterious planet, you'll navigate labyrinthine corridors, battle bizarre biomechanical creatures, and uncover the truth behind an ancient civilization's collapse. Master a diverse arsenal of reality-bending weapons and tools, including the iconic Address Disruptor, which lets you glitch through enemies and barriers. Discover over 60 items and power-ups that unlock new abilities and areas, encouraging thorough exploration of the haunting, pixel-art environments.

title: Azure Snake
description: Guide a blue snake around a confined play area, collecting green orbs as they appear. Unlike traditional Snake games, your body creates visual obstruction rather than physical danger. The snake moves automatically forward while you control its direction using the D-Pad. Collect orbs strategically while navigating the increasingly cluttered screen. A minimalist take on the classic formula with simplified collision mechanics and budget-friendly eShop pricing. title: Back to Bed
description: Guide the sleepwalker Bob safely back to his bed in this surreal puzzle adventure inspired by the artwork of M.C. Escher and Salvador Dalí. Playing as Bob's subconscious guardian Subob, you must navigate impossible architecture and mind-bending perspectives across dreamlike levels. Place objects to redirect Bob's path, avoid dangers, and manipulate the laws of physics in a world where staircases twist into infinity and gravity bends to your will. With its striking art style, clever spatial puzzles, and whimsical atmosphere, each level presents a fresh challenge as you protect the oblivious Bob from perilous drops and nightmare creatures while shepherding him through his bizarre dreams.

title: Badland - Game of the Year Edition
description: Guide a fragile forest creature through a hauntingly beautiful side-scrolling world filled with deadly traps and mysterious obstacles. This atmospheric physics-based platformer challenges you to navigate increasingly complex levels where timing and momentum are everything. Manipulate your character's size, multiply into swarms of creatures, and use creative solutions to overcome imaginative hazards. The Game of the Year Edition includes over 100 single-player levels plus local multiplayer modes where up to four players cooperate or compete simultaneously.

title: Baila Latino
description: Dance to 20 Latin hits with choreography created by professional dancers from the Carolyn Smith Dance Academy. Play solo or with up to four players simultaneously in this beach party-themed rhythm game. Follow on-screen dance instructions while lyrics display on the GamePad, allowing friends to sing along. Features local multiplayer modes where families can dance together to energetic Latin American music. Published by O2 Games exclusively for the Wii U eShop. Sources: - [Baila Latino for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/162665-baila-latino) - [Baila Latino Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/baila_latino) - [Baila Latin

title: Ballpoint Universe Infinite
description: Pilot a paper plane through a hand-drawn universe where combat and creativity collide. This unique shoot-em-up blends side-scrolling action with imaginative art direction, all rendered in a distinctive pen-and-ink style. Battle through waves of enemies in your customizable fighter, then land on planets to explore on foot in platforming sequences. Collect scrap to upgrade your ship with new weapons and abilities, mixing and matching parts to create your ideal combat loadout. The game's distinctive aesthetic brings a sketchbook to life, with every element looking like it was drawn with ballpoint pen on paper.

title: Barbie and Her Sisters - Puppy Rescue
description: Join Barbie and her sisters on a heartwarming adventure to rescue adorable puppies in need! Explore a colorful world as you search for lost puppies, care for them, and help them find loving homes. Complete fun mini-games and activities that test your reflexes and problem-solving skills while learning about pet care and responsibility. Customize your own puppy with accessories and outfits, then train them with various tricks and commands. Work together with Barbie's sisters—Skipper, Stacie, and Chelsea—each bringing unique abilities to help on your rescue missions. Discover hidden puppies throughout diverse environments, from sunny beaches to bustling city streets.

title: Barbie Dreamhouse Party
description: Step into Barbie's fabulous Dreamhouse for the ultimate party experience. Join Barbie and her sisters Skipper, Stacie, and Chelsea as you explore six beautifully decorated rooms, each offering unique mini-games and activities. Bake cupcakes in the kitchen, design fashion in the closet, perform on stage, and care for adorable puppies. Play solo or with up to four players in exciting party mode competitions. Customize your experience by choosing your favorite activities and create the perfect party playlist. With motion controls bringing the Dreamhouse to life, every room is an adventure waiting to happen. Perfect for fans of Barbie and family-friendly multiplayer fun.

title: Batman Arkham Origins Blackgate - Deluxe Edition
description: Experience Gotham's Dark Knight in this enhanced Metroidvania-style adventure set after the events of Arkham Origins. As Batman, infiltrate Blackgate Prison to quell a violent uprising led by some of Gotham's most dangerous villains including the Joker, Penguin, and Black Mask. Navigate through the sprawling prison complex using Detective Mode to analyze environments, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover hidden paths. Engage in tactical combat with the signature FreeFlow system, combining strikes, counters, and gadgets. This Deluxe Edition features enhanced HD visuals, a new map and hint system, and full controller support optimized for console play.

title: Batman: Arkham City - Armored Edition
description: Batman: Arkham City is a 2011 action-adventure video game developed by Rocksteady Studios and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. Based on the DC Comics superhero Batman, it is the sequel to the 2009 video game Batman: Arkham Asylum and the second instalment in the Batman: Arkham series. Written by veteran Batman writer Paul Dini with Paul Crocker and Sefton Hill, Arkham Citywas inspired by the long-running comic book mythos. In the game's main storyline, Batman is incarcerated in Arkham City, a super-prison enclosing the decaying urban slums of fictional Gotham City. He must uncover the secret behind a sinister scheme orchestrated by the facility's warden, Hugo Strange.

title: Batman: Arkham Origins
description: Batman: Arkham Origins is a 2013 action-adventure video game developed by WB Games Montréal and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment for Microsoft Windows and the PlayStation 3, Wii Uand Xbox 360 video game consoles. Based on the DC Comics superhero Batman, it is the successor to the 2011 video game Batman: Arkham City and is the third main installment in the Batman: Arkham series. It was released worldwide on October 25.

title: Bayonetta
description: Bayonetta is an action-adventure hack and slash video game developed by Platinum Games and published by Sega. The game was originally released for Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 in Japan in October 2009, and in North America and Europe in January 2010. The game was later released on the Wii U alongside its sequel, Bayonetta 2, releasing in September 2014 in Japan and worldwide the following month. An enhanced port for Microsoft Windows was released in April 2017 with support for 4K visuals. The game was released on the Nintendo Switch in February 2018 worldwide, also alongside its sequel.

title: Bayonetta 2
description: Bayonetta 2 is an action-adventure hack and slash video game developed by Platinum Games and published by Nintendo for Wii U and Nintendo Switch. It is the sequel to the 2009 game Bayonetta, and was directed by Yusuke Hashimoto and produced by Atsushi Inabaand Nintendo's Hitoshi Yamagami, under supervision by series creator Hideki Kamiya.

title: Beatbuddy
description: Dive into a mesmerizing underwater world where music shapes everything around you. As Beatbuddy, you'll swim through six beautifully hand-painted environments, each pulsing to its own original soundtrack. Interact with the living, breathing world by touching plants and creatures that generate sounds and beats, creating dynamic musical compositions as you play. Solve environmental puzzles by manipulating the rhythm and tempo of your surroundings, awakening sleeping creatures and activating mechanisms in time with the music.

title: Ben 10 Omniverse
description: Transform into powerful alien forms and battle enemies across space and time in this action-packed adventure based on the hit Cartoon Network series. Play as both 11-year-old Ben and his older 16-year-old self, switching between timelines to solve puzzles and defeat villains. Access the Omnitrix to transform into fan-favorite aliens like Four Arms, Heatblast, and XLR8, each with unique abilities and combat styles. Team up with Rook Blonko to take on Malware and other dangerous foes threatening the universe. Master combo attacks, explore diverse environments, and unlock new alien forms as you progress through the story. Features both single-player campaign and local co-op multiplayer modes.

title: Ben 10 Omniverse 2
description: Join Ben Tennyson in this action-packed adventure based on the popular Cartoon Network series. Transform into powerful aliens from the Omnitrix to battle Malware and his minions across diverse levels filled with platforming challenges and intense combat. Switch between multiple alien forms, each with unique abilities - use Four Arms for devastating melee attacks, XLR8 for lightning-fast speed sequences, or Gravattack to manipulate gravity and solve environmental puzzles. Fight through hordes of enemies in dynamic brawler-style combat, explore colorful 3D environments, and unlock new aliens as you progress through the story.

title: Bigley's Revenge
description: A first-person shooter from the creators of Meme Run. Players defend a floating platform from waves of meme-based enemies including Bigley, Cucumber Dog, and Illuminati symbols approaching from all sides. Shoot down enemies before they reach you while managing limited ammunition that must be reloaded using currency earned from kills. Features a single game mode focused on surviving endless waves of internet meme characters in this controversial eShop title that was later removed from the store. Sources: - [Bigley's Revenge Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/bigleys_revenge) - [Bigley's Revenge (2016) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](http

title: Bird Mania Party
description: Guide Mojo the bird through increasingly challenging side-scrolling stages in this frantic avian adventure. Dodge obstacles, collect stars, and navigate treacherous environments as you race against the clock. With simple one-button controls, Bird Mania Party is easy to pick up but difficult to master. Compete for high scores across multiple game modes, including the intense survival-focused Mojo Mania and the combo-driven Star Mania. The colorful cartoon visuals and upbeat soundtrack create a cheerful atmosphere as you help Mojo overcome environmental hazards and tricky timing challenges. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or extended score-chasing marathons.

title: Bit Dungeon+
description: Dive into this fast-paced roguelike action RPG where death is just the beginning. Battle through randomly generated dungeons filled with demons and monsters, collecting souls to craft powerful weapons and armor. Every run is different as you slash, dodge, and fight your way through bite-sized dungeons designed for quick gameplay sessions. Die and your spouse must venture forth to resurrect you, continuing the cycle of dungeon crawling mayhem. With simple two-button controls, retro pixel art aesthetics, and addictive loot-driven progression, Bit Dungeon+ delivers intense hack-and-slash action perfect for both short bursts and extended play sessions.

title: BIT.TRIP Presents... Runner2
description: Commander Video returns in this rhythm-infused platforming sequel that expands the BIT.TRIP formula with stunning HD graphics and branching paths. Race through vibrant worlds where every jump, slide, and kick syncs perfectly to an infectious soundtrack spanning chiptune to orchestral arrangements. Choose from multiple characters including fan-favorite CommanderVideo and unlockable runners, each bringing unique flair to the action. Master increasingly complex levels filled with obstacles, collectibles, and multiple routes that reward both precision and exploration.

title: Blackjack
description: Test your luck and skill at the classic casino card game of blackjack, also known as 21. Face off against the dealer as you aim to build a hand that totals as close to 21 as possible without going bust. Make strategic decisions on whether to hit, stand, double down, or split pairs based on your cards and the dealer's visible card. Master basic strategy to maximize your odds, or push your luck with risky plays for bigger payouts. Track your winnings as you play hand after hand of this timeless gambling favorite, bringing the excitement of the casino floor directly to your Wii U GamePad. Please note that if you need information for a specific blackjack title (such as one published by a par...

title: Blasting Agent Ultimate Edition
description: The Black Hand of Fate has built a secret base inside a volcano and assembled a massive army to conquer the world. As the Blasting Agent, infiltrate their stronghold across 6 expansive non-linear levels filled with enemies, secrets, and challenging bosses. Use jump-and-shoot gameplay to battle with guns or martial arts, discover upgrades to enhance weapon damage, speed, and health, and unlock a second playable character. Navigate optional paths and hidden areas in this retro-style action platformer that brings classic jump-and-shoot mechanics to the Wii U. Sources: - [Blasting Agent: Ultimate Edition Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/blast

title: Blek
description: Draw a single line and watch it repeat across the screen in this award-winning minimalist puzzle game. Your goal is to collect colored circles while avoiding black holes using only the motion pattern you create. Each level presents a new spatial challenge where timing, curves, and angles matter. With over 60 hand-crafted puzzles, Blek offers an elegant test of creative problem-solving where simple mechanics yield surprisingly deep strategic possibilities. The game's clean aesthetic and meditative soundtrack create a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience.

title: Bloc
description: Control up to four BLOCS simultaneously on the Wii U GamePad to keep the ball from escaping the screen in this fast-paced arcade game. Each BLOC moves independently using different GamePad inputs, creating a frantic multitasking challenge. Support for 1-4 players lets you share control with friends, with each player managing BLOCS on different sides of the screen. A modern twist on classic paddle games, BLOC tests your coordination and reflexes as you juggle multiple controls at once to prevent the ball from going offscreen. title: Blockara
description: Blockara is a fast-paced competitive puzzle game that combines color-matching mechanics with strategic positioning and special abilities. Face off against colorful characters in intense head-to-head battles where you slide rows and columns of blocks to create matches of three or more, launching attacks at your opponent while defending against their assaults. Each of the game's diverse roster of characters brings unique special moves and fighting styles to the board, adding depth to every match. Master the art of chaining combos, timing your blocks, and unleashing devastating character abilities to overwhelm your rivals.

title: Blok Drop U
description: Blok Drop U is a physics-based puzzle game where you strategically destroy blocks to guide colored spheres to their matching containers. Each level presents a tower of various block types that you must carefully demolish by touching them on the GamePad screen. The challenge lies in determining the correct sequence—remove the wrong blocks and your spheres might roll away or get stuck, forcing you to restart. With over 30 increasingly complex levels, the game demands careful planning and precise timing.

title: Blok Drop X Twisted Fusion
description: A crossover puzzle game combining RCMADIAX's Blok Drop U with Leuvsion's Twisted Fusion. Guide the GoGo character to safety through 50 challenging levels by destroying blocks and enemies using physics-based mechanics. Strategic gameplay requires careful planning to crush enemies by dropping blocks in the correct sequence while clearing each gameboard. Features the fantasy world and art style of Twisted Fusion merged with the core block-dropping puzzle gameplay, creating a tough challenge even for experienced puzzle fans. Sources: - [BLOK DROP X TWISTED FUSION Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/blok_drop_x_twisted_fusion) - [BLOK DROP X TWIS

title: Bombing Bastards
description: Navigate explosive mazes in this fast-paced action puzzler that puts a modern spin on classic bomber gameplay. As one of the Bombing Bastards, strategically place bombs to blast through obstacles, trap opponents, and clear each arena-style level. Chain explosions for devastating combos while collecting power-ups that enhance your bomb range, blast radius, and movement speed. Face off against quirky AI enemies with unique behaviors, or challenge friends in chaotic local multiplayer battles. With vibrant cartoon visuals, numerous unlockable characters, and increasingly devious level layouts that demand quick thinking and tactical positioning, every match delivers explosive action.

title: Breakout Defense 2
description: Face off against a computer opponent across 20 challenging levels in this competitive twist on classic breakout gameplay. Defend your own blocks while simultaneously attacking your opponent's wall, creating a strategic back-and-forth battle. Master the paddle mechanics to outmaneuver the AI and claim victory in this fast-paced arcade experience. Features both single-player campaign and local multiplayer support for head-to-head matches with friends.

title: Breezeblox
description: Stack and clear colored blocks in this vibrant physics-based puzzle game that challenges both your reflexes and strategic thinking. Drop blocks of matching colors to create groups and clear them before they pile too high. The twist? Blocks sway and shift with realistic physics, making every placement a calculated risk. Chain massive combos by planning ahead and timing your drops perfectly. Features multiple game modes including frantic arcade action and methodical puzzle challenges. Master the art of controlled chaos as you navigate increasingly complex block arrangements, utilize power-ups, and chase high scores across global leaderboards.

title: Brick Breaker
description: Battle through 100 increasingly challenging levels filled with explosive surprises in this classic brick-breaking game. Use your paddle to bounce balls and destroy brick walls while collecting power-ups like multi-ball, magnetic paddle, and fireball. Play solo or compete with up to 4 players in split-screen multiplayer modes including Versus, Rush, and Base Defense. Sharp reflexes and precision are essential to avoid traps and achieve victory across all levels. Sources: - [Review: Brick Breaker (Wii U eShop) - Pure Nintendo](https://purenintendo.com/review-brick-breaker-wii-u-eshop/) - [Brick Breaker (2016) - MobyGames](https://www.mobygames.com/game/86993/brick-breaker/) - [Brick Breaker |

title: Bridge Constructor Playground
description: Build bridges and watch them collapse in spectacular fashion—or better yet, watch them hold! Bridge Constructor Playground challenges you to engineer sturdy structures across 32 increasingly tricky scenarios. Using materials like wood, steel, cables, and concrete pillars, you'll need to construct bridges that can support cars, trucks, and even massive tank convoys. The playground setting adds whimsy to the physics-based puzzle solving, with colorful environments and a lighthearted tone. Experiment with different designs, test your creations under stress, and learn from your failures as vehicles plummet into ravines.

title: Brunswick Pro Bowling
description: Step up to the lanes in this authentic bowling simulation that brings the arcade experience home. Brunswick Pro Bowling delivers realistic physics and precise control as you aim for that perfect 300 game. Choose from multiple Brunswick-branded bowling balls, each with distinct characteristics, and master various lane conditions and oil patterns. Compete across numerous real-world bowling venues, fine-tuning your approach, release, and spin to knock down pins with satisfying accuracy. Whether you're practicing solo to perfect your technique, challenging friends in local multiplayer, or climbing the career mode ranks, every frame tests your skill and precision.

title: Cabela's Big Game Hunter - Pro Hunts
description: Step into the wilderness as a professional hunter in this immersive hunting simulation. Travel across North America pursuing trophy game animals including deer, elk, bears, and more in diverse environments from dense forests to open plains. The game features authentic hunting mechanics with realistic animal behavior and AI, requiring patience, strategy, and precision marksmanship. Choose your weapons from an arsenal of licensed firearms and gear, then track your prey using calls, scents, and stealth tactics. Complete challenging missions and objectives while building your reputation as an elite hunter.

title: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2013
description: Face the world's most dangerous predators in this intense hunting experience that puts survival at the forefront. Armed with an arsenal of firearms and equipment, track deadly animals across diverse environments from African savannas to frozen tundras. The Maneater story mode challenges you to hunt aggressive apex predators that have turned the tables on humans. Use the Wii U GamePad for precision aiming and weapon management while navigating treacherous terrain. Features include pulse-pounding encounters with charging bears, stalking lions, and other lethal wildlife that fight back. Test your skills in various game modes that reward accuracy, stealth, and quick reflexes under pressure.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops II is a first-person shooter developed by Treyarch and published by Activision. It was released for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, and the Xbox 360 on November 13, 2012, and for the Wii U on November 18 in North America and November 30 in PAL regions. Black Ops II is the ninth game in the Call of Duty franchise of video games, a sequel to the 2010 game Call of Duty: Black Ops and the first Call of Duty game for the Wii U. A corresponding game for the PlayStation Vita, Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, was developed by nStigate Games and also released on November 13.

title: Call of Duty: Ghosts
description: Call of Duty: Ghosts is a first-person shooter video game developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision, it is the tenth major installment in the Call of Duty series and the sixth developed by Infinity Ward. It was released for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Wii U on November 5, 2013. The game was released with the launch of the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

title: Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker
description: Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker is an action puzzle video game developed and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. It is a spin-off of the Super Mario series which builds upon the isometric mini-games starring Captain Toad from Super Mario 3D World. The game was announced at Nintendo's Electronic Entertainment Expo 2014 Nintendo Direct presentation and released in 2014 and 2015.

title: Captain U
description: Play as Captain U on a mission to rescue the missing princess using the PowerPad, the universe's legendary weapon. This 2D platformer utilizes the Wii U GamePad's dual-screen capabilities, touch controls, and motion features across 9 levels. A love letter to the Wii U console and 1980s Nintendo nostalgia, this eShop title features retro-inspired gameplay and unique powers granted by the PowerPad. Navigate through platforming challenges in this tribute to classic gaming that launched as one of the final games released for the Wii U.

title: Cars 3 Driven to Win
description: Race as Lightning McQueen, Cruz Ramirez, and other beloved characters from the Cars universe in this high-octane racing game. Master multiple game modes including Race, Battle Race, Stunt Showcase, and Takedown as you prove you have what it takes to become a racing champion. Pull off incredible stunts, drifts, and tricks to boost your performance and gain the edge over competitors. Customize your skills and abilities by unlocking new characters and upgrades. Battle against friends in split-screen multiplayer or tackle solo challenges across diverse tracks inspired by the film.

title: CastleStorm
description: Unleash medieval mayhem in this addictive tower defense hybrid that blends real-time strategy, physics-based destruction, and action-packed combat. Command your army, launch devastating projectile attacks to obliterate enemy castles brick by brick, and deploy powerful heroes directly into battle. Master the ballista to fire everything from arrows to explosive sheep while managing troops, casting spells, and defending your fortress. The destructible environments create endless strategic possibilities as you topple towers and crush opponents under falling debris.

title: Chariot
description: Guide a chariot carrying a king's remains through elaborate underground caverns in this unique physics-based platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op to push, pull, and maneuver the chariot across treacherous terrain using ropes and momentum. Explore sprawling levels filled with environmental puzzles that demand clever use of the chariot's weight and physics. Collect loot to upgrade your abilities and customize the royal ride. The chariot's momentum-based movement creates constantly shifting challenges as you navigate platforms, activate switches, and overcome obstacles.

title: Chasing Aurora
description: Soar through stunning mountain vistas in this multiplayer aerial action game where precision flying meets competitive chaos. Take control of graceful birds navigating treacherous Alpine peaks in fast-paced challenges that blend racing, tag, and survival gameplay. Master momentum-based flight mechanics as you swoop, dive, and climb through procedurally shifting courses filled with deadly hazards. Compete locally with up to five players across multiple game modes, from frantic freeze tag battles to score-chasing solo runs. The minimalist art style and dynamic weather create a mesmerizing backdrop as you chase the mythical Aurora through increasingly perilous mountain ranges.

title: Chasing Dead
description: Step into a nightmarish vision of Tokyo where the dead have risen and reality itself seems corrupted. As Jake, an elite AECID agent, you'll fight through hordes of zombies and supernatural horrors using an arsenal of weapons and special abilities. This first-person horror shooter blends intense gunplay with unsettling atmosphere as you uncover the dark conspiracy behind the outbreak. Explore interconnected environments, solve environmental puzzles, and survive encounters with grotesque enemies that defy explanation. With its mix of action-horror gameplay and dystopian setting, Chasing Dead delivers a uniquely bizarre and challenging experience that pushes the boundaries of survival horror.

title: Child of Light
description: Child of Light is a platforming role-playing video game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft for Microsoft Windows, the PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Wii U, Xbox 360 and Xbox One in April 2014, and was released on PlayStation Vita in July 2014. The game was later released on Nintendo Switch on 11 October 2018; the announcement of this release also teased a sequel. It is powered by UbiArt Framework.

title: Chompy Chomp Chomp Party
description: Chase and chomp your way through frantic multiplayer mayhem for up to nine players. Control colorful Chompies across multiple game modes: hunt targets in Chase & Chomp, race to zones before being eaten in Zone Dash, or hold onto precious items in Keep the Thing. With support for GamePad, Wii Remotes, Pro Controllers, and Nunchuks, every controller counts. Fast-paced chaos where everyone chases someone and flees from someone else simultaneously. Perfect for local multiplayer sessions where survival depends on quick reflexes and strategic chomping. Sources: - [Frantic Wii U Party Game 'Chompy Chomp Chomp Party' Coming To Switch With New Content | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/ne

title: Chroma Blast
description: A color-matching arcade shooter where you control a diamond-shaped ship composed of four colored segments. Defeat circular enemies by matching your shot color to theirs while navigating a rectangular battlefield. Cycle through colors strategically to eliminate targets in Normal Mode's objective-based challenges or test your endurance in instant-death Survival Mode. Features online leaderboards and colorblind-friendly options. Fast-paced action meets puzzle mechanics in this budget eShop title. title: Chronicles of Teddy
description: Chronicles of Teddy (also known as Teddy Ganeau in some regions) is a Metroidvania-style action-adventure where you explore a mysterious, hand-drawn fantasy world. You play as a young girl who discovers a magical book that transports her to a dangerous realm filled with strange creatures and ancient secrets. The game features a unique language system where you must learn and use musical notes to communicate with inhabitants and solve environmental puzzles. Combat blends sword-based action with puzzle-solving as you unlock new abilities and traverse interconnected areas.

title: Citadale
description: Play as Sonja Dorleac, a warrior trained in combat by her immortal husband, as she infiltrates a dark fortress and battles through hordes of the undead. This retro-inspired action platformer pays homage to classic Castlevania with NES-style graphics and challenging gameplay. Navigate treacherous levels filled with enemies and obstacles, utilizing Wii U Pro Controller support and GamePad features that display level maps on either screen. Experience old-school difficulty with platforming action reminiscent of 8-bit classics as you fight your way through the cursed citadel. Sources: - [Citadale Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/citadale) - [C

title: Citadale - The Legends Trilogy
description: Battle through three generations of demon slayers in this retro Castlevania-inspired adventure. Play as Sonja Dorleac in Gate of Souls, her son Gabriel in Curse of Darkness, and grandson Christopher in Legacy of Fate as you face vampires, zombies, and creatures of the night. Features classic NES-style graphics and platforming action across the complete trilogy, culminating in an epic confrontation with the Dark Lord. Master monster-slaying combat through branching storylines spanning the Dorleac family legacy.
