title: Citizens of Earth
description: Step into the shoes of the newly-elected Vice President of the World in this quirky turn-based RPG that pays homage to classic titles like EarthBound. Your mission? Convince citizens to join your party and help save the world from a mysterious conspiracy. Recruit up to 40 playable characters, each with unique abilities - from conspiracy theorists to baristas to protesters. Battle enemies in strategic turn-based combat, delegate tasks to your citizens to uncover secrets, and explore a colorful world filled with humor and satire.

title: Cloudberry Kingdom
description: Cloudberry Kingdom delivers pure platforming chaos with its revolutionary level generation system. Every stage is procedurally created to match your skill level, ensuring relentless challenge whether you're a newcomer or speedrunning veteran. Navigate through impossible gauntlets of spinning blades, moving platforms, fireballs, and deadly spikes as the difficulty escalates to seemingly superhuman levels. The game features multiple hero types with unique movement abilities, from double-jumping adventurers to jetpack-equipped daredevils. Story mode provides structured campaign progression, while Free Play mode generates endless custom challenges.

title: Coaster Crazy Deluxe
description: Build gravity-defying roller coasters across 50+ unique locations spanning the globe and even the moon in this theme park management sim from the creators of RollerCoaster Tycoon 3. Use the GamePad's touchscreen and stylus to design custom coasters with seven different track types and themed trains. Guide the quirky Crazies through your creations while managing your cash-making coaster empire. Complete challenges in diverse environments, customize layouts with scenery pieces, and play entirely on the GamePad screen without needing the TV.

title: Cocoto Magic Circus 2
description: A colorful shooting gallery game supporting up to 5 simultaneous players. Four players use Wii Remotes while a fifth uses the GamePad in this papercraft-styled party game. Aim precisely and shoot quickly across various circus-themed courses in three different game modes. Face waves of enemies while competing for high scores. The charming visual presentation features eye-catching effects and varied music tracks. Perfect for family-friendly multiplayer sessions, though enemy variety is somewhat limited across the different challenges. Sources: - [Cocoto Magic Circus 2 | Jeux Wii U | Jeux | Nintendo FR](https://www.nintendo.com/fr-fr/Jeux/Jeux-Wii-U/Cocoto-Magic-Circus-2-846183.html) - [Cocoto

title: Color Zen
description: Color Zen is a meditative puzzle game that strips away traditional game elements like timers, points, and life systems to deliver pure relaxation and mental engagement. Each puzzle presents a canvas of colored shapes that you manipulate by dragging and matching colors together. When matching colors collide, they expand and merge, gradually filling the screen. Your goal is to match colors strategically until the entire puzzle matches the border color. The minimalist design, soothing soundtrack, and gradual difficulty progression create a zen-like experience that's both calming and mentally stimulating.

title: Color Zen Kids
description: A relaxing puzzle game designed specifically for younger players, Color Zen Kids removes time limits and pressure to create a stress-free experience. Solve color-matching puzzles by dragging and merging colored shapes until only one color fills the screen. The game features intuitive touch controls optimized for the Wii U GamePad, allowing players to simply tap and swipe their way through increasingly complex abstract puzzles. With vibrant, minimalist visuals and soothing ambient music, each level presents a gentle mental challenge that encourages spatial thinking and color recognition without frustration.

title: Cosmophony
description: Navigate through a psychedelic audiovisual tunnel at breakneck speed in this challenging rhythm-based game. Control a small heart-shaped avatar as you dodge obstacles and fire at enemies, all synchronized to an intense electronic soundtrack. Each level combines precise timing with lightning-fast reflexes as you weave through a hypnotic neon landscape. The game features minimalist controls—move and shoot—but demands absolute precision as patterns become increasingly complex. With its stark visual style and pulse-pounding music, every attempt feels like hurtling through a fever dream where one mistake sends you back to the start. Master the rhythm, survive the chaos.

title: Costume Quest 2
description: Return to the whimsical world of trick-or-treating and turn-based combat in this charming RPG sequel. When a diabolical dentist threatens to ruin Halloween across all of time, it's up to you and your friends to don creative costumes and save the day. Battle enemies using imaginative costume transformations—become a pterodactyl, a superhero, or a clown as you explore vibrant neighborhoods and time periods. Master strategic turn-based combat, collect candy for upgrades, and unlock new costumes with unique abilities.

title: Crystorld
description: Navigate over 120 challenging stages as you retrieve crystals using precise jumps and dashes in this 3D puzzle platformer. Master both normal and hard difficulty modes that test your timing and spatial reasoning. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local multiplayer to tackle the puzzles together. Simple controls meet increasingly complex stage designs that demand careful planning and execution to reach each crystal's location. Sources: - [Crystorld Release Information for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/308772-crystorld/data) - [Crystorld for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/308772-crystorld) - [Crystorld (2019) - MobyGames](https://w

title: Cube Life - Island Survival
description: Survive and thrive on a mysterious island made entirely of cubes in this voxel-based survival adventure. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, and build shelters to protect yourself from dangerous creatures that emerge at night. Explore diverse biomes across the procedurally generated island, from lush forests to snowy peaks and underground cave systems. Hunt animals for food, farm crops, and manage your hunger and health as you adapt to island life. The creative building system lets you construct elaborate structures block by block, while the survival mode challenges you to stay alive against hostile mobs. Play solo or team up in local multiplayer to conquer the wilderness together.

title: Cubemen 2
description: Command an army of Cubemen in this tower defense strategy game that flips the genre on its head. Deploy various unit types across 3D battlefields, from defensive turrets to aggressive attackers, as you protect your base while assaulting enemy positions. Face off in multiplayer battles supporting up to six players, or tackle single-player challenges across multiple game modes including Skirmish, Territory Control, and Capture the Flag. The minimalist aesthetic and dynamic camera angles put you right in the action as you strategically position your cubic troops.

title: Cubit The Robot HD
description: Guide Cubit the robot through challenging platforming stages using only one button to jump. This hardcore difficulty platformer features music-driven gameplay, level-based progression with multiple paths, and three different endings. Choose from four game modes catering to all skill levels, including a two-player mode. Navigate obstacles and enemies while racing through detailed environments. Guest characters from other games make appearances throughout your journey. Originally released on 3DS in 2013, this HD version features enhanced visuals and improved backgrounds. Sources: - [Nintendo Life - Cubit the Hardcore Platformer Robot HD](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/cubit_the

title: Daikon Set
description: A free collection of three retro-inspired mini-games celebrating early gaming history. Chroma Star is a color-matching fixed shooter where you defend barriers from diving enemies. Pink Mite has you guide a bubble-encased butterfly through obstacle courses collecting bubbles. The Queen blends Pong mechanics with color dodging as you keep a bouncing pellet from hitting the wrong side of your dual-colored paddle. Simple controls, charming lo-fi aesthetics, and quick arcade action capture the spirit of classic coin-op and early console gaming.

title: Dare Up Adrenaline
description: Strap on your wingsuit and dive through treacherous mountain terrain in this extreme flight simulator. Navigate narrow passages, dodge cliff faces, and weave through forests filled with obstacles across ten challenging levels. Complete objectives like flying through ring sequences and executing safe landings. Features local multiplayer where one player uses the GamePad while another flies with the Wii Remote, plus asymmetrical Adrenaline Mode with vehicles including helicopters and boats. Explore open environments using a hang glider powered by wind gusts. Sources: - [Dare Up Adrenaline Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/dare_up_adrenaline)

title: Darksiders II
description: Darksiders II is an action role-playing hack and slash action-adventure video game developed by Vigil Games and published by THQ. It is the sequel to Darksiders and was released in August 2012 for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360 and as a launch title for Wii U upon the console's Australian, European, and North American release in November 2012. The story follows the efforts of player character Death to clear the name of his brother, War, who stands accused of wiping out humanity.

title: Darksiders Warmastered Edition
description: Step into the armored boots of War, one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, in this remastered hack-and-slash epic. Caught in the crossfire between Heaven and Hell, you've been wrongly accused of prematurely triggering the End of Days. Wield devastating weapons and supernatural abilities as you tear through hordes of angels and demons alike in your quest for redemption. Explore a sprawling post-apocalyptic Earth filled with dungeons, puzzles, and massive boss battles that will test your combat prowess. Ride your fiery steed Ruin across desolate landscapes, collect legendary gear, and unlock powerful new abilities in this darker take on action-adventure gameplay.

title: Demonic Karma Summoner
description: Summon animal demons using virtual blood in the mysterious Karmarealm. Dress your demonic creatures in kawaii outfits and guide them through challenging platforming sequences. Uncover the fate of the KarmaSlayer by collecting ancient scrolls scattered throughout the realm. Master passwords and spells to progress through this unique blend of occult summoning mechanics and adorable aesthetics. Navigate treacherous platforms while managing your summoned companions in this single-player eShop adventure that combines dark themes with charming visuals.

title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut
description: Deus Ex: Human Revolution is an action role-playing video game developed by Eidos Montréal and published worldwide by Square Enixin August 2011 for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360: a version for OS X released the following year. It is the third game in the Deus Ex series, and a prequel to the original Deus Ex. The gameplay—combining first-person shooter, stealth and role-playing elements—features exploration and combat in environments connected to multiple city-based hubs, in addition to quests that grant experience and allow customization of the main character's abilities with items called Praxis Kits.

title: Devil's Third
description: Devil's Third is an action-adventure hack and slash shooter video game developed by Valhalla Game Studios and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. The Wii U version was released in most regions in August 2015, and later in North America in December 2015. An online multiplayer-only version for Microsoft Windows, titled Devil's Third Online, was released in collaboration with Korean publisher Nexon in Japan in June 2016. The Windows version also supports voice-chat, which the Wii U version lacks. Despite receiving positive reviews in Japan, the Wii U version received negative reviews internationally upon release.

title: Disney DuckTales Remastered
description: DuckTales: Remastered is a Metroidvania style platform video game developed by WayForward Technologies and published by Capcom. The game is a high-definition remake of DuckTales, a game released on the Nintendo Entertainment System in 1989. It was released for multiple gaming platforms, including the PlayStation 3, the Xbox 360, and the Wii U, over a three-month period between August and November 2013, and later expanded to iOS, Android, and Windows Phone in April 2015.

title: Disney Epic Mickey 2
description: Join Mickey Mouse and Oswald the Lucky Rabbit in this cooperative platforming adventure through the Wasteland, a realm of forgotten Disney characters and attractions. Wield the Magic Paintbrush to paint in or thin out the environment, solving puzzles and shaping your path forward. Team up with Oswald, who uses his remote control to command electricity and reprogram enemies. Sing musical numbers that advance the story and influence the world around you. Choose between heroic or mischievous actions that affect how characters react and alter the outcome of your journey.

title: Disney Infinity
description: Disney Infinity is an action-adventure sandbox video game developed by Avalanche Software and published by Disney Interactive Studios. It was announced on January 15, 2013. The game used collectible figurines that were then synchronized with the game, unlocking characters from Disney and Pixar properties that interact and go on adventures. The game was released for Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, Wii, Wii U, and Nintendo 3DS in August 2013. A PC version of Toy Box was also released on November 14, 2013. The game had a budget approaching $100 million.

title: Disney Planes
description: Take to the skies in this high-flying racing adventure inspired by Disney's animated film. Play as Dusty Crophopper, a crop duster with dreams of becoming a racing champion, and compete against skilled opponents from around the world. Soar through stunning environments including the Great Wall of China, the Himalayas, and Monument Valley as you master aerial maneuvers and strategic flight paths. Utilize power-ups and boosts to gain the edge over competitors while performing daring tricks and stunts. The game features multiple racing modes, unlockable characters from the film, and GamePad integration for enhanced controls and map viewing.

title: Disney Planes 2 - Fire & Rescue
description: Take to the skies as Dusty Crophopper joins the elite Piston Peak Air Attack team in this action-packed racing adventure based on Disney's animated film. Battle dangerous wildfires across diverse environments, from dense forests to rugged canyons, using water drops and fire retardant to save the day. Switch between multiple aircraft including helicopters and air tankers, each with unique handling and abilities. Complete rescue missions, navigate treacherous terrain, and work alongside beloved characters like Blade Ranger and the Smokejumpers. Features accessible controls for younger players while offering engaging challenges throughout the campaign.

title: Dolphin Up
description: Dive into an underwater adventure where you guide a playful dolphin through vibrant ocean environments. Leap through hoops, collect stars, and perform acrobatic tricks in this charming arcade experience designed for the Wii U. Using the GamePad's motion controls or traditional buttons, you'll navigate colorful coral reefs and sunlit waters while mastering increasingly challenging obstacle courses. Perfect for quick gaming sessions, Dolphin Up offers accessible gameplay that's easy to pick up but surprisingly addictive. Compete for high scores as you execute perfect jumps and discover hidden paths through each aquatic stage.

title: Don't Starve Giant Edition
description: Enter an uncompromising wilderness survival experience where science meets the supernatural. As Wilson, a gentleman scientist trapped in a mysterious world, you must learn to exploit your environment and its inhabitants to escape and find your way home. Gather resources, craft tools, and build shelters to survive increasingly hostile nights filled with darkness and monsters. The Giant Edition includes the Reign of Giants expansion, adding new seasonal challenges, giant bosses, and additional playable characters—each with unique abilities and playstyles. Permadeath means every decision matters.

title: Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze
description: Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze is a side-scrolling platformer video game developed by Retro Studios, with assistance from Monster Games, and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. The fifth instalment in the main Donkey Kong Country series, Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze is the direct sequel to the 2010 Wii game, Donkey Kong Country Returns, and was released worldwide in February 2014. An enhanced port for the Nintendo Switch was released in May 2018.

title: Dot Arcade
description: Dot Arcade delivers three retro-inspired mini-games on an 8x8 dot matrix grid. Navigate through Mr. Snake, dodging obstacles while your tail grows longer. Dance across dangerous floors in Dodge Club. Race down tracks while avoiding traffic in Rally Driver. Each game challenges you to chase high scores with simple one-button controls and minimalist visuals that evoke classic arcade cabinets. The stripped-down presentation and straightforward gameplay focus purely on quick reflexes and score competition across three bite-sized arcade experiences.

title: Dr. Luigi
description: Dr. Luigi is a puzzle video game for the Wii U console, developed by Nintendo and Arika. The game was released as an eShop game in North America on December 31, 2013 and in Europe and Japan on January 15, 2014. As the title suggests, Luigi is the protagonist instead of Mario. The game was released at the end of Nintendo's "Year of Luigi" promotion in 2013.

title: Dragon Fantasy - The Black Tome of Ice
description: The second chapter in the Dragon Fantasy saga blends classic JRPG gameplay with modern indie sensibilities and irreverent humor. Choose from four distinct heroes—each with unique abilities and storylines—as you explore a vast world map, delve into treacherous dungeons, and battle monsters in turn-based combat. The Black Tome of Ice expands on the original with enhanced graphics, deeper character progression, and interconnected storylines that weave together as you uncover an ancient evil threatening the realm. With its nostalgic 16-bit aesthetic, quirky dialogue, and surprisingly strategic combat system, this chapter delivers dozens of hours of adventure for retro RPG enthusiasts.

title: Dragon Fantasy - The Volumes of Westeria
description: Dragon Fantasy: The Volumes of Westeria is a retro-inspired JRPG that combines classic 8-bit and 16-bit aesthetics with modern gameplay conveniences. Experience multiple chapters following different heroes across the realm of Westeria, each with their own unique storyline and gameplay style. Battle monsters in turn-based combat, explore dungeons filled with puzzles and treasures, and uncover a humorous narrative that lovingly parodies classic RPG tropes. The game features multiple visual styles that evolve as you progress, charming chiptune music, and a blend of nostalgia and accessibility.

title: Draw a Stickman EPIC 2
description: Draw your way through an imaginative adventure where your creativity becomes your greatest weapon. In this charming puzzle-adventure sequel, you'll bring your stick figure hero to life and guide them through hand-drawn worlds filled with challenges, enemies, and mysteries. Sketch objects directly into the game world to solve puzzles—draw a sword to defeat monsters, create a key to unlock doors, or craft a cloud to reach new heights. Every level presents unique scenarios that demand both artistic thinking and problem-solving skills. Face off against the evil Zarp and his corrupted creations as you explore vibrant environments from lush forests to dark caverns.

title: Dreamals
description: Control three dreaming animals simultaneously as they navigate through 80 stages across dreamlike worlds. A raccoon moves left, a goat moves right, and a parrot jumps in place. When animals merge on contact, their abilities combine, creating new movement possibilities. Manage all three creatures at once while collecting keys to escape the dream realm. Features 4 distinct visual themes with increasingly complex multi-character puzzles that challenge coordination and spatial reasoning. Sources: - [Dreamals (Wii U) Review - Nintendo World Report](https://www.nintendoworldreport.com/review/42289/dreamals-wii-u-review) - [Dreamals Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.co

title: Dual Core
description: Battle through a derelict space station on Europa, one of Jupiter's moons, as two awakened AIs discover the facility overrun with aliens and rampaging machines. This twin-stick shooter features arcade-style action with light RPG elements through collectible upgrade points. Control your robot with dual-analog sticks while blasting through rooms filled with enemies. Supports up to 4-player local co-op in Story and Arcade modes, plus competitive Versus mode. Upgrade firepower, durability, or regeneration abilities using green crystals collected throughout your journey. Sources: - [Dual Core Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/dual_core) - [Co-O

title: Dungeon Hearts DX
description: Fuse strategy and pattern matching with fast-paced action in this unique puzzle-battle hybrid. Align magical runes flowing along the Fatestream to attack, defend, and conjure magic against waves of fantastic creatures. Control eight heroes and form parties of four to defeat the Dark One. Exclusively designed for Wii U with full touchscreen controls - play on TV or GamePad only. Battle through intense encounters where quick thinking and strategic rune matching determine survival. Developed by Wolfgame as an enhanced version with reworked interface and new game engine. Sources: - [Dungeon Hearts DX (2016) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/dungeo

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Chronicles of Mystara
description: Dungeons & Dragons: Chronicles of Mystara is a 2013 video game compilation by Capcom released as a digital download for the Wii U, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360 and Microsoft Windows (via Steam). It includes two arcade games based on the Dungeons & Dragons franchise: Dungeons & Dragons: Tower of Doom(1993) and Dungeons & Dragons: Shadow over Mystara (1996).

title: Earthlock Festival of Magic
description: Embark on a turn-based adventure through a vibrant alien world where magic and technology intertwine. Assemble a party of unique heroes to uncover the mysteries of Umbra, a planet that stopped spinning thousands of years ago. Master a tactical combat system with combo attacks, harvest ingredients to craft powerful items, and build your own island sanctuary complete with farming and resource gathering. Explore diverse environments from sun-baked deserts to frozen wastelands, battle exotic creatures, and solve environmental puzzles. With hand-crafted visuals, strategic depth, and a rich fantasy world to discover, this indie RPG blends classic adventure with fresh gameplay mechanics.

title: Edge
description: Navigate a vibrant minimalist world as a reflective cube in this elegant puzzle-platformer. Roll, climb, and balance across geometric landscapes suspended in stark, colorful voids. Master precise movements to collect prisms scattered throughout increasingly complex stages while avoiding deadly drops into the abyss. The ingenious level design challenges your spatial reasoning and timing as you discover shortcuts, trigger switches, and exploit the cube's unique physics. With its distinctive visual style, pulse-pounding electronic soundtrack, and deviously clever puzzles that reward both careful planning and quick reflexes, Edge delivers a mesmerizing experience that's easy to learn but sati...

title: Educational Pack
description: A collection of educational mini-games designed for young children. Features seven activities including Building Blocks with realistic physics, Counting Sheep for learning numbers 1-100, Menu Math for addition practice, Ice Cream Colors for color identification, a simplified Piano for musical creativity, Shapes toolbox, and SK8 skateboarding that teaches math. Each activity combines learning fundamentals with interactive gameplay, offering variety for early childhood education through the GamePad.

title: Electronic Super Joy
description: Electronic Super Joy is a brutally hard platformer set in a world of pulse-pounding electronic music. Guide a groove-loving hero through a surreal psychedelic landscape filled with lethal hazards, precise jumps, and punishing difficulty. Every death sends you back to the checkpoint, but the infectious soundtrack and tight controls keep you coming back for one more attempt. Master pixel-perfect platforming across challenging levels that demand split-second timing and unwavering focus. Features a unique visual style with vibrant neon colors, trippy backgrounds, and rhythmic gameplay that syncs with the electronic beats. Designed for players who crave old-school difficulty with modern flair.

title: Electronic Super Joy Groove City
description: Electronic Super Joy Groove City is a rhythm-infused precision platformer that blends fast-paced action with an electronic soundtrack. Navigate through neon-drenched levels filled with deadly traps, dangerous enemies, and challenging obstacles that demand split-second timing and reflexes. Each death is instant, but respawns are immediate, encouraging you to learn patterns and master each section. The game's pulsing electronic music synchronizes with the gameplay, creating an immersive audiovisual experience. Features include punishing but fair difficulty, tight controls that reward precision, and a vibrant visual style with glowing environments.

title: Elliot Quest
description: Embark on a mysterious quest across the cursed island of Urele in this retro-inspired action-adventure. As Elliot, you're afflicted with an ancient curse that's slowly transforming you into a demon, and only by exploring dangerous dungeons and uncovering the island's secrets can you hope to find a cure. Battle enemies with your bow and arrows, solve environmental puzzles, and gain new abilities as you progress through a sprawling interconnected world. With its Zelda II-inspired gameplay combined with Metroidvania exploration, challenging boss battles, and multiple endings determined by your choices, Elliot Quest delivers a compelling blend of classic 8-bit aesthetics and modern game desig...

title: Emojikara
description: Match emojis to two-word phrases in this puzzle game featuring hundreds of emoji symbols and over a hundred word challenges. Choose between two game modes: precision mode where you aim for five matches in as few tries as possible, or timed mode where you race to find as many matches as you can in ninety seconds. Select emoji pairs from a 3x5 grid to match phrases like "Blood Moon" or "Liberty Bell." Successfully matched symbols unlock an Emoji Sentence mode where you can create custom emoji strings to share on Miiverse. title: Epic Dumpster Bear
description: Play as Dumpster Bear, a traumatized brown bear whose forest was destroyed by an evil corporation, forcing him to survive on trash. This precision platformer features over 70 challenging levels filled with tricky jumps, boss battles, and secret stages. Run and jump using momentum-based controls reminiscent of classic Sonic games, bouncing on enemies' heads to clear gaps. Unlock puzzle levels that utilize the Wii U GamePad's touch screen, plus over 35 Miiverse stamps. Supports Off-TV play and Wii U Pro Controller for classic platforming action. Sources: - [Epic Dumpster Bear Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/epic_dumpster_bear) - [Epic Dump

title: ESPN Sports Connection
description: ESPN Sports Connection brings six different sports experiences to life using the Wii U GamePad's unique capabilities. Compete in soccer, tennis, baseball, golf, football, and kart racing, each designed to leverage motion controls and the GamePad's touchscreen. The soccer mode lets you draw plays on the touchscreen before executing them on the pitch, while tennis uses precise motion tracking for serves and volleys. Baseball features full batting and pitching mechanics, and golf utilizes the GamePad as your club for realistic swing detection. Football challenges you with passing plays and defensive strategies, and kart racing adds arcade-style competition.

title: Exile's End
description: Explore a hostile alien world in this atmospheric sci-fi action-adventure that pays homage to classic 8-bit and 16-bit exploration games. You are Jameson, a reluctant hero searching for your missing comrades on a mysterious planet. Navigate treacherous underground caverns, battle deadly indigenous creatures, and uncover the dark secrets of an ancient civilization. With limited resources and challenging combat, every encounter demands careful strategy. The non-linear world rewards thorough exploration with valuable upgrades and weapons.

title: Extreme Exorcism
description: Battle ghosts that learn from your every move in this supernatural arcade platformer. Each time you defeat a spirit, it returns as a ghost that mimics your exact actions from the previous round. The arena fills with deadly echoes of your past selves, creating increasingly chaotic combat as you face growing swarms of your own moves. Blast through possessed locations using an arsenal of over 20 weapons from shotguns to cat launchers. Master strategic movement and weapon choices across 10 eerie environments. Play solo or compete with up to 4 players in local multiplayer modes including deathmatch and last ghost standing challenges.

title: F1 Race Stars Powered Up Edition
description: F1 Race Stars takes the world of Formula One and reimagines it as a vibrant, cartoon-style arcade racer packed with power-ups and personality. Race as your favorite F1 drivers on fantastical tracks inspired by real-world circuits, transformed with loops, jumps, and shortcuts. Grab power-ups like bubbles to shield yourself, safety cars to slow rivals, or boost pickups for explosive speed. The Powered Up Edition includes all DLC content, adding extra tracks, drivers, and championships. Master the slipstream mechanic for turbo boosts, navigate dynamic track changes, and battle through chaotic multiplayer races.

title: Factotum
description: Guide two robots through an intricate mechanical world in this clever puzzle-platformer. Control both bots simultaneously or switch between them to solve mind-bending challenges that require precise coordination and timing. Use one robot's abilities to create paths for the other, activate switches, and manipulate the environment. The ingenious dual-character mechanic demands creative thinking as you navigate through beautifully designed industrial landscapes filled with hazards, platforms, and contraptions. Each puzzle builds upon the last, introducing new mechanics that test your spatial reasoning and multitasking skills.

title: Falling Skies The Game
description: Step into the war-torn world of the hit television series in this third-person action shooter. As part of the human resistance fighting against an alien invasion, you'll lead squads through dangerous missions to reclaim Earth from the Espheni forces. Command your team strategically, utilizing cover-based combat and tactical positioning to survive encounters with Skitters, Mechs, and other deadly alien threats. Switch between multiple squad members, each with unique abilities and weapons, to adapt to different combat scenarios. Complete story-driven missions that expand the Falling Skies universe, scavenging resources and weapons while defending civilian survivors.

title: Family Party 30 Great Games Obstacle Arcade
description: Gather your family and friends for a collection of 30 exciting mini-games designed to get everyone moving and competing together. Navigate obstacle courses, test your reflexes in arcade-style challenges, and compete in various physical activities using the Wii U GamePad and Wii Remote controllers. From balancing acts to racing challenges, each game is designed for quick, accessible fun that players of all ages and skill levels can enjoy. The game emphasizes motion controls and multiplayer competition, making it perfect for family gatherings and parties. Jump, dodge, and outmaneuver your opponents across a variety of colorful, energetic challenges.

title: Fast & Furious - Showdown
description: Buckle up for high-octane cooperative action in this Fast & Furious experience built for two players. Team up locally or online to execute daring heists, precision driving sequences, and explosive combat missions inspired by the blockbuster film franchise. Switch between driving and shooting roles on the fly as you drift through crowded city streets, leap between moving vehicles, and take down rival crews. Features competitive multiplayer modes alongside the story-driven campaign where split-second teamwork makes the difference between victory and a spectacular crash. Master each character's unique abilities and vehicle specialties across diverse international locations.

title: FAST Racing NEO
description: Fast Racing Neo (stylized as FAST Racing NEO) is a futuristic racing video game developed by Shin'en Multimedia and released for the Wii U in December 2015. It is often compared to Nintendo's F-Zero franchise.

title: Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water
description: Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water is a survival horror video game developed by Koei Tecmoand published by Nintendo for the Wii U. The fifth main entry in the Fatal Frameseries, it was released in Japan in September 2014 and worldwide in October 2015. As with previous games in the series, players navigate areas filled with hostile ghosts which must be fought by taking photographs using the Camera Obscura, which is directly controlled using the Wii U Gamepad. A post-endgame story featuring Ayane, a character from the company's Dead or Alive series, is also available featuring altered gameplay mechanics.

title: FIFA Soccer 13
description: Experience the beautiful game with FIFA Soccer 13, bringing EA Sports' acclaimed soccer simulation to Wii U with revolutionary GamePad integration. Manage your squad, call plays, and execute precise passes using the touchscreen controller while the action unfolds on your TV. The game features the revolutionary Player Impact Engine for realistic physicality, Complete Dribbling for unprecedented ball control, and Tactical Free Kicks that give you total control over set pieces. Choose from over 500 licensed teams across more than 30 leagues, including the Premier League, La Liga, and Serie A.

title: Fist of the North Star Ken's Rage 2
description: Step into the brutal post-apocalyptic world of Fist of the North Star in this Dynasty Warriors-style brawler. Play as Kenpachi and other legendary fighters from the beloved manga and anime series as you unleash devastating martial arts techniques against massive hordes of enemies. Experience two distinct gameplay modes: Legend Mode follows the original manga storyline with enhanced narrative depth, while Dream Mode lets you rewrite history with alternative scenarios and character interactions. Master the signature Hokuto Shinken fighting style, trigger explosive finishing moves, and watch enemies literally explode from your pressure point strikes.

title: Flowerworks HD - Follie's Adventure
description: Guide Follie the fairy through a vibrant garden adventure in this match-three puzzle game with a twist. Launch flower buds from your cannon to create matches of three or more, clearing the board while growing beautiful blooms. Utilize the Wii U GamePad's touchscreen and motion controls to aim precisely and unleash powerful special moves. Progress through increasingly challenging stages across multiple garden worlds, each bursting with colorful flora and creative obstacles. Master combo chains to earn higher scores and unlock new abilities. The HD visuals bring the whimsical garden to life with crisp detail and smooth animations, making every successful match a visual delight.

title: Forest Escape
description: Run for your life through a dangerous forest in this endless runner arcade game. Danger breathes down your neck, gaining speed with every moment as you dodge trees and obstacles in your desperate escape. Navigate through the perilous woodland environment while the threat behind you grows ever closer. Test your reflexes and see how far you can survive in this fast-paced escape challenge. Developed by RandomSpin for the Wii U eShop.

title: forma.8
description: Guide a small exploration probe through a beautiful alien world filled with ancient mysteries and dangerous creatures. In this atmospheric Metroidvania, you crash-land on a distant planet and must navigate intricate cave systems, solve environmental puzzles, and acquire new abilities to access previously unreachable areas. The game features stunning hand-drawn visuals with a unique geometric art style, physics-based gameplay mechanics, and a haunting ambient soundtrack. Combat hostile lifeforms using your probe's limited arsenal while carefully managing energy reserves.

title: Frederic Ressurection of Music
description: Step into the shoes of legendary composer Frederic Chopin, resurrected in modern times to reclaim his musical legacy. This unique rhythm game blends classical piano masterpieces with contemporary beats as you battle your way through musical duels across the globe. Tap, hold, and release notes in perfect timing to Chopin's reimagined compositions, now infused with rock, electronic, and jazz influences. Face off against quirky opponents who've corrupted classical music, from Vegas showgirls to fame-hungry pop stars. Master increasingly complex piano performances while uncovering a story that mixes humor with musical heritage.

title: Freedom Planet
description: Freedom Planet is a 2D platform video game developed and published by GalaxyTrail, a studio set up by designer Stephen DiDuro. The player controls one of three anthropomorphic animal protagonists: the dragon Lilac, the wildcat Carol, or the basset hound Milla. Aided by the duck-like Torque, the player attempts to defeat Lord Brevon, who plans to conquer the galaxy. While the game focuses on fast-paced platforming, its levels are interspersed with slower action scenes.

title: FreezeME
description: FreezeME is a 3D collectathon platformer that pays homage to the classic Nintendo 64 era of gaming. Play as R, a young girl accompanied by her trusty companion M, a sentient camera with the unique ability to freeze enemies and objects in time. Explore colorful, open worlds filled with secrets, coins, and golden cubes to collect as you work to rescue R's best friend from the clutches of the villainous Fat the Cat. Use M's freezing powers strategically to solve environmental puzzles, create platforms, and stop enemies in their tracks.

title: FullBlast
description: FullBlast is a vertical-scrolling shoot 'em up that delivers classic arcade action with modern polish. Pilot your fighter through intense bullet-hell battles across multiple stages, each packed with enemy formations, environmental hazards, and massive boss encounters. Collect power-ups to upgrade your weapons and unleash devastating special attacks. The game features vibrant graphics, a pulse-pounding soundtrack, and responsive controls optimized for quick reflexes. With multiple difficulty settings and score-based gameplay, it challenges you to master intricate bullet patterns and discover optimal routes through each level.

title: Funk of Titans
description: Jump, slide, and groove through a vibrant world of Greek mythology with a funky twist. As Perseus, champion of the Funk, battle the gods of Pop, Rap, and Rock in an endless running platformer that combines rhythm and reflexes. Dash through colorful environments, collect vinyl records, and unlock new gear to boost your abilities. Time your jumps and attacks to the beat as you face mythological creatures reimagined with musical flair. Master over 40 levels across three unique worlds, each with its own musical style and challenges. Compete for high scores and perfect runs while building your collection of weapons and costumes.

title: Funky Barn
description: Manage your own vibrant farm in this charming simulation where you'll raise animals, grow crops, and keep your barnyard running smoothly. Juggle the needs of chickens, cows, pigs, and sheep while dealing with unexpected challenges like pesky wolves and UFO invasions. Use the Wii U GamePad to interact directly with your farm, tapping to feed animals, collect resources, and build new facilities. Expand your operation by purchasing equipment like egg incubators and wool spinners to process goods and earn more coins. The quirky art style and upbeat soundtrack create a cheerful atmosphere as you balance productivity with the chaos of farm life.

title: Futuridium EP Deluxe
description: Pilot a nimble spacecraft through a retro-futuristic gauntlet of geometric obstacles and enemy defenses in this fast-paced shoot 'em up. Your mission: destroy energy cubes scattered throughout massive capital ships, then escape before it's too late. Speed is essential as you weave through tight corridors, dodge deadly barriers, and engage hostile forces with precision shooting. The minimalist aesthetic combines stark wireframe visuals with pulsing electronic music, creating an intense arcade experience. Master the art of quick reflexes and spatial awareness across multiple challenging levels, each demanding perfect runs and strategic cube destruction sequences.

title: Galaxy Blaster
description: Defend your base from waves of incoming alien ships in this arcade-style shooter. Control your paddle to move left or right across the screen, tapping to fire your blaster at approaching enemies. The challenge intensifies as alien vessels close in on your position. Miss too many targets and they'll breach your defenses, ending your run. Simple touch controls combine with classic arcade action for quick, accessible gameplay sessions. Battle through increasingly difficult waves to achieve high scores and test your reflexes against the alien invasion.

title: Game & Wario
description: Game & Wario is a party video game in the WarioWare series developed by Nintendo for the Wii U, named after the series of electronic games known as Game & Watch. It is the eighth game in the WarioWare Series. The game revolves around 16 minigames played using the Wii U GamePad. The game was released in Japan on March 28, 2013, North America on June 23, 2013, Europe on June 28, 2013, and Australia on June 29, 2013.

title: Game Party Champions
description: Game Party Champions brings motion-controlled party gaming to Wii U with a collection of competitive mini-games designed for group play. Challenge friends and family across activities including table hockey, basketball, bocce ball, darts, table football, and ping pong. The GamePad integration adds unique asymmetric gameplay possibilities, allowing one player to use the controller differently than those with Wiimotes. Each game features accessible controls that welcome casual players while offering enough depth for competitive matches. Track your progress, earn trophies, and climb the leaderboards as you master each activity.

title: Games for Toddlers
description: A collection of four simple mini-games designed for young children using the Wii U GamePad touchscreen. Includes A-Mazing, a top-down maze navigator with three difficulty sizes; Icy Block Stacker, an arctic-themed block-stacking game where you tap to drop penguin blocks; an egg collection game; and one additional activity. All games use touch controls and feature colorful, child-friendly visuals aimed at toddlers. Short play sessions make it suitable for young attention spans, though gameplay is simple and straightforward throughout the collection. Sources: - [Games For Toddlers Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/games_for_toddlers) - [Game

title: Gear Gauntlet
description: Control a spinning cog racing through increasingly punishing gauntlets in this fast-paced 2D action arcade game. Boost, teleport, reverse and rotate to survive as the auto-scrolling screen relentlessly pursues you - fall behind and it's game over. Collect gear medallions and navigate through colored path blockers while avoiding barriers that damage your gear on higher difficulties. Features hand-drawn gritty artwork and a rock soundtrack with shredding guitars, creating an intense test of reflexes and patience across multiple difficulty modes. Sources: - [Gear Gauntlet Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/gear_gauntlet) - [Gear Gauntlet Arriv

title: Gemology
description: A gravity-based puzzle game combining elements of Tetris and Bejeweled with unique mechanics. Features two distinct modes: Lapidiary challenges players to solve pre-designed puzzles by mining gem formations through strategic rock placement and row completion, while Annealiation offers arcade-style high-score gameplay where you tap, drag, and combine gems to create massive stones. Supports multiple GamePad configurations including Off-TV play and an Observer Mode for spectators.

title: Geom
description: A budget puzzle game where players race against the clock to identify and tap geometric shapes on the GamePad touchscreen. Features three distinct game modes: grouping identical shapes together, finding specific shapes among distractors, and locating bonus shapes. Created by solo developer Pablo Millan, this fast-paced score-chaser challenges spatial recognition and quick reflexes across progressively difficult timed challenges. All gameplay uses touchscreen controls, with simple mechanics designed for quick pick-up-and-play sessions. Sources: - [GEOM Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/geom) - [GEOM (Wii U eShop)- Review – Seafoam Gaming](h

title: Ghost Blade HD
description: Ghost Blade HD brings classic bullet hell arcade action to the Wii U with stunning high-definition visuals and relentless intensity. Choose from three unique fighters, each with distinct weapons and shot patterns, as you battle through five challenging stages filled with massive bosses and intricate bullet patterns. Master the risk-reward scoring system by collecting ghosts in close combat while weaving through dense projectile curtains. Features multiple difficulty modes from beginner-friendly to hardcore danmaku expert levels, plus Score Attack and Caravan modes for competitive play.

title: Giana Sisters - Twisted Dreams
description: Transform between two dream worlds in this beautiful platformer featuring punk rock Giana and her cute alter ego. Switch between personalities on the fly to navigate twisted dreamscapes filled with enemies, traps, and secrets. Each world transformation changes the environment, music, and Giana's abilities—cute Giana twirls gracefully through the air while punk Giana dashes powerfully through obstacles. Master both forms to conquer over 20 challenging levels packed with collectibles and hidden pathways. The dynamic soundtrack shifts seamlessly between gentle melodies and hard rock as you swap worlds, creating an immersive audio-visual experience that responds to your every move.

title: Giana Sisters - Twisted Dreams Director's Cut
description: Transform between two worlds in this visually stunning platformer featuring the legendary Giana. Switch between cute Giana and her punk alter-ego at will, warping the dreamworld around you to reveal new paths and abilities. Each transformation changes not only Giana's appearance and powers but the entire environment and soundtrack. Navigate through twisted landscapes filled with challenging enemies and hazardous obstacles. Master precise platforming mechanics, collect crystals, and use each sister's unique abilities to overcome increasingly complex puzzles.

title: Girls Like Robots
description: Girls Like Robots is a charming logic puzzle game where you arrange dinner party seating to keep everyone happy. Place guests strategically across increasingly complex scenarios - girls prefer sitting next to robots, boys want to be near girls, robots clash with each other, and nobody wants to sit by nerds or pie. Each level presents a unique grid-based challenge requiring careful planning to maximize happiness scores. The game evolves from simple parties to weddings, beaches, and concerts, introducing new character types and special rules that dramatically shift your strategy.

title: Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing
description: Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing delivers fast-paced arcade racing action with a retro twist. Choose from a colorful roster of drivers and hit the track in overhead-view races that blend classic top-down racing gameplay with modern sensibilities. Master tight corners, dodge obstacles, and outmaneuver your rivals across diverse circuits filled with jumps, shortcuts, and hazards. The game features both single-player championships and multiplayer mayhem where up to four players can compete locally. With its vibrant pixel art style, energetic rock soundtrack, and accessible pick-up-and-play mechanics, it captures the spirit of old-school arcade racers while offering enough challenge to keep you comi...

title: Gravity Badgers
description: Launch badgers through space in this physics-based puzzle adventure where gravity is your greatest tool and biggest obstacle. Guide your fearless badger astronauts across treacherous asteroid fields, navigating gravitational wells that pull you toward planets, moons, and deadly hazards. Time your jumps perfectly, slingshot around celestial bodies, and collect all the carrots while avoiding explosive mines and dangerous debris. With dozens of increasingly challenging levels, Gravity Badgers tests your spatial reasoning and timing as you master the art of zero-gravity navigation.

title: Gravity+
description: Guide a small robot through a maze-like space station by manipulating gravity to reach the exit. Rotate environments in multiple directions to navigate over two dozen stages filled with enemies, laser beams, teleportation devices, and locked doors. Use the D-pad to shift gravity and overcome traps and hazards. Features online leaderboards, stamps, and Miiverse support. An optional level editor DLC lets you create your own custom challenges. Supports Pro Controller, Wii Remote, and Classic Controller. Sources: - [Gravity+ for Wii U Reviews - Metacritic](https://www.metacritic.com/game/wii-u/gravity+) - [Gravity+ | Wii U download software | Games | Nintendo UK](https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/

title: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition
description: Guacamelee! is a metroidvania action platforming video game developed and published by DrinkBox Studios. The game was released for PlayStation 3 and PlayStation Vita in April 2013, and was later ported to Microsoft Windows in August 2013, and to OS X and Linux in February 2014. An enhanced edition was released for Wii U, Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Xbox 360 in July 2014, and later on the Nintendo Switch in October 2018. The game draws its inspiration from traditional Mexican culture and folklore.

title: Guitar Hero Live
description: Guitar Hero returns with a revolutionary new guitar controller featuring two rows of three buttons, mimicking real guitar chord shapes and delivering the most authentic playing experience yet. Perform in first-person perspective as a live-action band member, facing real crowds that react dynamically to your performance—cheer when you nail solos, jeer when you stumble. The game features two distinct modes: GH Live lets you rock out in music festivals with full-motion video performances, while GHTV streams a constantly-updating catalog of playable music videos across multiple themed channels.

title: Gunman Clive HD Collection
description: Gunman Clive HD Collection brings both beloved indie platformers to Wii U in stunning high definition. Take control of the titular gunslinger in a wild west adventure that blends precise run-and-gun action with creative platforming challenges. Battle through diverse environments from desert canyons to speeding trains, facing off against bandits, wildlife, and massive boss encounters. The game features multiple playable characters, each with unique abilities that dramatically change how you approach levels. Its distinctive visual style mimics sketched pencil artwork brought to life with subtle animation and sepia tones.

title: Hello Kitty Kruisers
description: Race through colorful tracks with Hello Kitty and her Sanrio friends in this family-friendly kart racer. Choose from multiple beloved characters including My Melody, Badtz-Maru, and Keroppi, then compete in go-karts or speedboats across vibrant courses filled with shortcuts and power-ups. Collect items to gain advantages over opponents, customize your vehicle's appearance, and master different racing modes. The game features split-screen multiplayer for up to four players locally, making it perfect for family gaming sessions.

title: High Strangeness
description: Switch between 8-bit and 16-bit worlds in this unique action-adventure that seamlessly blends retro aesthetics with mind-bending gameplay. As Boyd, a kidnapped boy with mysterious powers, explore a world where reality shifts between two graphical dimensions—each revealing different secrets, enemies, and pathways. Solve ingenious puzzles that require flipping between visual styles, battle creatures that exist in only one dimension, and uncover a conspiracy involving secret societies and interdimensional threats.

title: Hive Jump
description: Descend into alien hive worlds as an elite JUMP Corps soldier in this intense run-and-gun platformer. Each procedurally generated mission throws you into hostile underground caverns crawling with deadly insectoid aliens. Blast through enemy swarms with an arsenal of upgradeable weapons, plant charges on alien backpacks to complete objectives, and extract before the hive overwhelms you. Die and you're permanent—roguelike permadeath means every run matters. Unlock new equipment and abilities between missions to push deeper into increasingly dangerous hive chambers. Fast-paced combat meets strategic resource management as you balance aggression with survival.

title: Hot Wheels - World's Best Driver
description: Take control of iconic Hot Wheels vehicles in this family-friendly racing game that brings the classic toy cars to life on your Wii U. Race through imaginative tracks inspired by the legendary orange track sets, performing death-defying stunts, loops, and jumps. Compete in various racing modes across multiple vibrant environments, from city streets to fantastic fantasy worlds. The game features the distinctive arcade-style racing that Hot Wheels is known for, with power-ups, shortcuts, and boost mechanics. Utilize the Wii U GamePad for unique racing experiences and track challenges.

title: How to Survive
description: Fight for survival on a mysterious archipelago infested with the undead in this challenging action game. Stranded on remote islands, you must scavenge for weapons, craft essential supplies, and build shelter while fending off relentless zombie hordes. Choose from multiple survivors, each with unique skills and abilities, as you explore dangerous terrain and uncover the secrets behind the outbreak. The game challenges you to master survival fundamentals through day-night cycles where darkness brings greater peril. Combine melee combat, ranged weapons, and environmental hazards to overcome the undead threat.

title: How to Train Your Dragons 2
description: Soar through the skies of Berk and beyond in this action-adventure based on the hit DreamWorks Animation film. Take control of Hiccup and Toothless as you explore vast open environments, engage in aerial combat, and build your bond with dragons. Battle against Drago's forces using fire blasts, tail whips, and devastating combo attacks. Switch between flying and ground-based gameplay as you complete missions, discover hidden collectibles, and unlock new dragon abilities. Face off against massive boss battles that test your reflexes and strategic thinking. Master the art of dragon riding with intuitive flight controls designed specifically for the Wii U GamePad.

title: Human Resource Machine
description: Human Resource Machine is a unique programming puzzle game where you program office workers to solve increasingly complex challenges. Using a visual programming language with simple drag-and-drop commands like INBOX, OUTBOX, COPY, and JUMP, you automate tasks for your workers in a darkly humorous corporate setting. Each puzzle requires you to write efficient "programs" to process data, teaching fundamental programming concepts like loops, conditionals, and memory management without any coding experience.

title: Hyrule Warriors
description: Hyrule Warriors (known as Zelda Warriors in Japan) is a hack and slash action video game developed by Omega Force and Team Ninja for the Wii U video game console. Hyrule Warriors was released in Japan in August 2014, and internationally the following month. The game is a collaboration between Koei Tecmo and Nintendo, and is a crossover between Koei Tecmo's Dynasty Warriors and Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda. It is one of the best-selling games on the Wii U. An updated port Hyrule Warriors Legends, known as Zelda Warriors: Hyrule All-Stars in Japan, was released for the for the Nintendo 3DS in Japan in January 2016 and worldwide in March 2016.

title: Infinity Runner
description: Race through a massive spaceship at breakneck speed in this intense first-person action runner. As a prisoner with mysterious werewolf abilities, you must escape the clutches of a sinister corporation by sprinting, sliding, and leaping through futuristic corridors filled with deadly obstacles. The fate of humanity hangs in the balance as you alternate between human agility and lupine power to survive increasingly challenging sections. Master split-second timing to dodge security barriers, leap across perilous gaps, and transform into werewolf form to smash through obstacles.

title: Injustice: Gods Among Us
description: Injustice: Gods Among Us is a fighting video game based upon the fictional universe of DC Comics. The game was developed by NetherRealm Studios and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment for the PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Wii U. It was released in April 2013 in North America, Europe, and Australia, and June 2013 in Japan. An expanded version of the game, titled Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition, was released in November 2013 for the PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Xbox 360, and Microsoft Windows.

title: Inside My Radio
description: Step inside a dying boombox and save its world through the power of music in this innovative rhythm-based platformer. Every jump, dash, and action must sync perfectly with the beat as you navigate through pulsing electronic landscapes. Play as three unique characters—Beat, Groove, and Astro—each with distinct abilities and musical styles ranging from electro to reggae to dubstep. Master precise timing to overcome rhythm-driven obstacles, defeat musical enemies, and restore harmony to the radio's inner world. The entire game pulses to an original electronic soundtrack, where platforming and music become one seamless experience.

title: Internal Invasion
description: Journey deep into an infected body to find and defeat the source of the virus in this gravity-based platformer. Launch character Ro'bert from cannon to cannon using touchscreen controls, racing against time as he can only survive outside these devices for seconds. Collect pills to gain control over his flight path and complete 50 challenging levels. Master the physics-based mechanics by using the fewest launches possible while beating par times for maximum scores. Sources: - [Internal Invasion Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/internal_invasion) - [Internal Invasion Release Information for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wi

title: Invanoid
description: A hybrid arcade game that combines Space Invaders-style descending enemies with Arkanoid's ball-and-paddle mechanics. Control a block at the bottom of the screen to keep a ball bouncing while destroying invading foes. Features endless high score gameplay with colorful animations as you deflect the ball upward to eliminate waves of descending enemies. Developed by RCMADIAX for the Wii U eShop, this budget title merges two classic arcade formulas into a simple score-chasing experience that challenges players to maintain ball control while clearing enemy formations.

title: Island Flight Simulator
description: Transport freight across twelve exotic islands in this arcade-style flight sim featuring over a hundred missions. Pilot three different aircraft, each upgradable for enhanced speed, durability, and fuel capacity. Navigate between tropical destinations while choosing between legitimate cargo runs and riskier illegal contracts from questionable clients. Master your landings at three airfields and manage your personal hangar as you build your island aviation business through increasingly challenging delivery missions. Sources: - [Island Flight Simulator Release Information for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/184437-island-flight-simulator/data) - [Island Flight Simulator

title: Ittle Dew
description: Embark on a charming adventure as Ittle Dew, a spirited adventurer who crashlands on a mysterious island and needs money for a raft back home. This puzzle-adventure game puts your problem-solving skills to the test with clever dungeon designs that let you tackle challenges in any order. Armed with just three items—a stick, a fire sword, and an ice ring—you'll discover creative solutions to environmental puzzles and combat encounters. The hand-drawn art style brings personality to every screen, while the witty dialogue and self-aware humor poke fun at adventure game tropes. Speed through the main quest in under an hour or take your time exploring every secret room and optional challenge.

title: Jeopardy!
description: Test your knowledge in America's favorite quiz show, now on Wii U! Jeopardy! brings the authentic game show experience home with thousands of clues across dozens of categories. Compete solo or with friends and family in classic Jeopardy!, Double Jeopardy!, and Final Jeopardy! rounds. The GamePad serves as your personal signaling device, letting you buzz in and write answers just like the real contestants. Challenge yourself in single-player mode against AI opponents, or gather up to three players for local multiplayer showdowns. With official show presentation, familiar board layouts, and that iconic theme music, it's your chance to prove you have what it takes to be a champion.

title: Jett Tailfin
description: Join Jett and his fish friends in underwater racing action through exotic locations like Atlantis, Ship Graveyard, and Pirates Island. Navigate obstacle-filled tracks while dodging sharks, jellyfish, and stingrays. Compete in fast-paced races across vibrant ocean environments, collecting power-ups and bonuses along the way. Features multiplayer mode supporting up to 8 players and includes mini-adventure challenges. Originally a mobile title, this Wii U version adds enhanced features and refinements to the arcade-style aquatic racing experience. Sources: - [Jett Tailfin Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/jett_tailfin) - [Jett Tailfin Release

title: Jewel Quest
description: Match three or more jewels to turn the tiles beneath them gold in this addictive puzzle adventure. Journey across ancient ruins as you flip jewels, create explosive combos, and race against time to transform the entire board. The game combines classic match-3 mechanics with strategic tile-flipping gameplay that requires careful planning—you must turn every tile gold before time runs out. Features multiple game modes including Classic, Buried Treasure where you excavate hidden jewels, and Balance where you must manage falling jewels on a precarious scale. Explore exotic locations from Mayan temples to Egyptian pyramids while solving increasingly challenging puzzles.

title: Joe's Diner
description: Step into the night shift at Joe's Diner, where your job is simple: keep the two haunted animatronic characters, a cowboy and an Indian, from meeting each other. Working the graveyard shift in this cursed establishment, you must monitor security cameras and rush between rooms to prevent these supernatural beings from crossing paths. As the nights progress, the challenge intensifies - the animatronics move faster and more unpredictably, testing your reflexes and strategic thinking. One wrong move, one moment of hesitation, and catastrophic consequences unfold.

title: Jotun Valhalla Edition
description: Explore the vast world of Norse mythology as Thora, a Viking warrior who died an inglorious death and must prove herself to the gods to enter Valhalla. Journey through stunning hand-drawn landscapes, battling massive elemental jotun bosses in epic confrontations. Armed with your two-handed axe and divine powers bestowed by the gods, you'll face colossal enemies inspired by Norse legends. The Valhalla Edition includes Valhalla Mode, offering even more challenging boss battles. Experience beautiful art and atmospheric music as you traverse nine distinct realms, uncovering runes to increase your power and learning Thora's story through ethereal narration in Icelandic.

title: Journey of a Special Average Balloon
Jumpy Cat
description: Don't be fooled by its innocent appearance—Jumpy Cat is one of the most brutally difficult games on Wii U. This deceptively simple platformer challenges players with punishing obstacles while calm music and quacking ducks play in the background. Navigate through treacherous levels as a cat that can only jump, testing your timing and precision to the limit. Originally planned for eShop release but pulled due to controversy over stolen pixel art assets, this notorious title from Ninja Pig Studios never saw official distribution. Sources: - [Jumpy Cat for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/116663-jumpy-cat) - [Jumpy Cat Details - LaunchBox Games Database](https://gamesdb.lau

title: Just Dance 2014
description: Just Dance 2014 is a dance video game developed by Ubisoft Paris, in collaboration with Ubisoft Milan, Ubisoft Reflections, Ubisoft Bucharest, Ubisoft Pune and Ubisoft Montpellier. The fifth main instalment in the Just Dance series (which as of February 2019 ranged from Just Dance of 2009 to Just Dance 2019), it was announced at Ubisoft's E3 2013 press event, and released for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Wii, and Wii Uon 9 October 2013, and for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One as launch titles on 15 November and 22 November 2013 respectively.

title: Just Dance 4
description: Just Dance 4 is a music video game developed by Ubisoft as the fourth main installment of the Just Dance series. Announced at E3 2012 by Flo Rida and Aisha Tyler, it was released on the Wii, the Wii U, the PlayStation 3 (for PlayStation Move), and the Xbox 360 (for Kinect) and was for Xbox 360, Wii, and PlayStation 3 and released in Europe and Australia on October 2, 2012 and on October 9, 2012 in North America, The Wii U version was released on November 18, 2012 in North America and was released on November 30, 2012 in Europe and Australia, alongside the system.

title: Just Dance Disney Party 2
description: Dance along to beloved Disney songs in this family-friendly rhythm game that brings the magic of Disney to your living room. Featuring iconic tracks from Disney Channel shows, classic Disney films, and modern animated hits, Just Dance Disney Party 2 offers fun choreography designed for all skill levels. Use the Wii U GamePad or Wii Remote to follow on-screen dancers and rack up points with your moves. The game includes popular songs from Frozen, Teen Beach Movie, Violetta, and more Disney favorites. Perfect for parties and family gatherings, with multiplayer modes that let up to four players dance simultaneously, competing for the highest score or working together cooperatively.

title: Keytari 8-Bit Music Maker
description: Transform your Wii U GamePad into a retro 8-bit synthesizer with KEYTARI. Touch the on-screen keys with your stylus to play classic chiptune sounds reminiscent of NES-era games. Choose from lead instruments like SineSquare, MultiPlex, and PolySaw, layer background beats and bass lines, and jam with the built-in drum kit. While it lacks recording or sharing features, KEYTARI serves as a straightforward digital instrument for creating nostalgic 8-bit melodies and experimenting with old-school gaming sounds on the fly. Sources: - [KEYTARI: 8-bit Music Maker Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/keytari_8-bit_music_maker) - [KEYTARI: 8-bit Music M

title: Kick and Fennick
description: Join young Kick and his unlikely companion Fennick, a small but powerful gun, in this charming puzzle-platformer adventure. After crash-landing on a strange tower, Kick must use Fennick's recoil to propel himself through 45 handcrafted levels filled with clever physics-based challenges. Master the art of momentum-based movement as you blast, bounce, and fly through colorful environments, solving puzzles and collecting items to repair your rocket. The unique recoil-jumping mechanic transforms every shot into a strategic decision—conserve ammo or take risky shortcuts.

title: KickBeat
description: KickBeat delivers rhythm-action combat where martial arts meets music in an explosive fusion. Fight through waves of enemies by striking, blocking, and countering in perfect sync with a pulse-pounding soundtrack featuring licensed tracks and original compositions. Every beat is a potential attack or defense move, demanding precision timing and rhythmic mastery. Chain together combos, collect power-ups, and unleash special attacks as you battle across multiple difficulty levels. The game features two playable characters, each with their own fighting styles and story campaigns.

title: Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
description: Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, known in the PAL regions as Kirby and the Rainbow Paintbrush, is a platforming video game in the Kirby series, developed by HAL Laboratory for Wii U. The title, which is a follow-up game of the 2005 Nintendo DS title Kirby: Canvas Curse, was released by Nintendo on January 22, 2015 in Japan, February 20, 2015 in North America, May 8, 2015 in Europe and May 9, 2015 in Australia. The game supports the Kirby, Meta Knight, and King Dedede Amiibo.

title: Knytt Underground
description: Explore a vast underground world in this atmospheric 2D platformer that combines precision movement with environmental storytelling. Play as Mi, a mute sprite who can climb walls and ceilings, navigating through hundreds of interconnected rooms filled with secrets and hidden passages. Switch between different character abilities to overcome obstacles and solve environmental puzzles. The game blends challenging platforming with philosophical themes, featuring a sprawling nonlinear map that rewards exploration and curiosity.

title: Kung Fu Fight!
description: Battle through relentless old-school action in this retro-styled endless runner. Punch, jump, and dodge your way through varied environments on a quest for rescue and revenge. Face unique enemies across Story Mode or test your skills in the challenging Infinite Fortress mode. Simple three-button controls keep you focused on the fast-paced combat as you fight to save the girl and defeat the bad guys. Unlock comical achievements in the Trophy Case and tackle multiple difficulty modes for added replayability. Sources: - [Kung Fu FIGHT! Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/kung_fu_fight) - [Kung Fu FIGHT! for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https:

title: Kung Fu Panda Showdown of Legendary Legends
description: Enter the arena in this fast-paced fighting game featuring beloved characters from the Kung Fu Panda universe. Battle as Po, Tigress, Shifu, and other legendary warriors across dynamic 3D arenas filled with interactive hazards and destructible environments. Master each character's unique kung fu fighting style, from Po's powerful belly-based attacks to Tigress's lightning-quick strikes. Compete in tournament mode, team battles, or free-for-all brawls supporting up to four players simultaneously. Unleash devastating special moves and combo attacks while dodging environmental dangers like rolling boulders and crumbling platforms.

title: Kung Fu Rabbit
description: Master the art of precision platforming as a martial arts rabbit on a quest to rescue your enslaved disciples from the evil monster king. This challenging puzzle-platformer demands perfect timing and skillful jumps through over 150 levels of deadly traps, spikes, and obstacles. One hit means instant death, so you'll need lightning-fast reflexes and clever use of wall-jumps and slide moves to survive. Collect carrots to unlock bonus stages and challenge yourself to achieve perfect completion across four distinct worlds.

title: Last Soldier
description: Your mission failed. You're the sole survivor trapped in a secret spider-infested facility. Fight for survival in this top-down shooter where massive arachnids swarm endlessly. Click to shoot enemies, scavenge resources, and every 60 seconds seek refuge at the campfire to rest and purchase supplies from the mini store. Face infinite levels of increasingly dangerous spider hordes as you battle to stay alive in this desperate survival experience. Can you endure against the relentless eight-legged terror? Sources: - [Last Soldier (2018) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/last_soldier) - [Last Soldier (2017) - MobyGames](https://www.mobygames.com/g

title: Legend of Kay Anniversary
description: Legend of Kay Anniversary brings the beloved action-adventure classic to life with stunning remastered visuals and enhanced gameplay. Take control of Kay, a courageous young cat warrior who must save his homeland from the invading forces of the Gorillas and Rats. Master fluid martial arts combat as you execute devastating combos and unleash special moves against diverse enemies. Explore a vibrant fantasy world inspired by Asian mythology, filled with challenging platforming sequences, clever puzzles, and epic boss battles. Wield an arsenal of weapons including swords, hammers, and claws, each with unique fighting styles.

title: LEGO Batman 2: DC Super Heroes
description: Lego Batman 2: DC Super Heroes is a Lego-themed action-adventure video game developed by Traveller's Tales, for the PlayStation 3, PlayStation Vita, Nintendo 3DS, Wii U, Wii, Nintendo DS, Xbox 360, Microsoft Windows, Mac OS X, and iOS.The game is a standalone sequel to Lego Batman: The Video game and the second Lego Batman video game. Numerous DC characters within the Batman continuity and outside it are playable characters. Lego Batman 2: DC Super Heroes also featured dialogue and an open world to explore, the first in the Traveller's Tales' Lego series to do so. The game was released in North America on 19 June 2012.

title: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham
description: Lego Batman 3: Beyond Gotham is a Lego-themed action-adventure video game developed by Traveller's Tales and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment in November 2014 for multiple platforms. It is the third instalment in the Lego Batman video game series and a sequel to Lego Batman: The Video Game and Lego Batman 2: DC Super Heroes. A port was released to mobile phones, excluding the numeral in the title.

title: LEGO City Undercover
description: Lego City Undercover is an action-adventure video game developed by TT Fusion for the Wii U. The game was released on 18 March 2013 in North America, in Europe and Australia on 28 March 2013 and in Japan on 25 July 2013. A prequel, Lego City Undercover: The Chase Begins was developed for the Nintendo 3DS. Unlike previous Lego titles developed by Traveller's Tales, which have been based on various licenses, the game is based on the Lego City brand and is the first Lego game to be published by Nintendo. It was also the first Lego game to be first released on the Wii U and Nintendo Switch.

title: LEGO Dimensions
description: Lego Dimensions is a Lego-themed action-adventure video game developed by Traveller's Tales and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment, for the PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3, Wii U, Xbox One and Xbox 360. It follows the toys-to-life format, in that the player has Lego figures and a toy pad that can be played within the game itself where it features characters and environments from over 30 different franchises. The Starter Pack, containing the game, the USB toy pad, and three minifigures, was released in September 2015, and has been expanded with additional level packs and characters.

title: LEGO Jurassic World
description: Lego Jurassic World is a Lego-themed action-adventure video game developed by TT Fusion and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment, which was released for Microsoft Windows, Nintendo 3DS, OS X, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Wii U, Xbox 360, and Xbox One. It adapts the plots of the first four films in the Jurassic Park franchise, and is part of a series of Lego-themed video games. The game was released on 12 June 2015 to coincide with the theatrical release of Jurassic World. Lego Jurassic World was later released for Android and iOS on 31 March 2016.

title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes
description: Lego Marvel Super Heroes is a Lego-themed action-adventure video game developed by Traveller's Tales and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment for the PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Wii U, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Microsoft Windows, and published by Feral Interactive for OS X. The game features gameplay similar to other Lego titles, such as Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga and Lego Batman 2: DC Super Heroes, alternating between various action-adventure sequences and puzzle solving scenarios. The handheld version of the game by TT Fusion was released under the title Lego Marvel Super Heroes: Universe in Peril for iOS, Android, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 3DS and PlayStation Vita.

title: Lego Marvel's Avengers
