description: Relive the epic moments from Marvel's Avengers films in blocky LEGO form. Battle through scenes from The Avengers and Age of Ultron, plus bonus content from other MCU films. Switch between iconic heroes like Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye, each with unique abilities and combat styles. Smash through LEGO environments, solve puzzles using character-specific powers, and unleash devastating team-up moves. Explore open-world Manhattan and other locations between missions, unlocking over 200 playable Marvel characters.

title: Lego Star Wars - The Force Awakens
description: Relive the epic story of The Force Awakens in this action-packed LEGO adventure that spans far beyond the film. Battle through all the major moments from the movie while also exploring untold stories that take place between Return of the Jedi and The Force Awakens. Master intense blaster battles with enhanced shooting mechanics, pilot iconic Star Wars vehicles including the Millennium Falcon, and switch between multiple characters to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Build and rebuild LEGO structures in creative ways, unleash devastating multi-builds, and experience the humor and charm that only LEGO games can deliver.

title: Lego The Hobbit
description: Embark on an epic brick-built journey through Middle-earth in this family-friendly adventure that brings the first two Hobbit films to life. Play as Bilbo Baggins and the Company of Dwarves as you explore iconic locations from the Shire to the Lonely Mountain, solving puzzles and battling orcs using signature Lego humor and gameplay. Master unique dwarf abilities - use Bombur as a trampoline, deploy Bifur's axe, or utilize Ori's slingshot to overcome obstacles. Craft powerful items and weapons at the forge, collect treasure, and unlock characters from across Middle-earth.

title: Letter Quest - Grimm's Journey Remastered
description: Letter Quest: Grimm's Journey Remastered challenges you to spell your way to victory in this addictive word-based RPG. Guide Grimm, a grim reaper with a vocabulary problem, through monster-filled levels by creating words from a jumbled grid of letters. The longer and more complex your words, the more damage you deal to enemies. Upgrade your abilities, equip special items, and unlock powerful letter tiles as you progress through the story mode and tackle challenging side quests. With plague tiles that corrupt your letters, timed challenges, and strategic boss battles, every encounter tests both your spelling skills and tactical thinking.

title: Life of Pixel
description: Embark on a nostalgic journey through the complete history of video game systems in this charming platformer. Play as Pixel, a tiny hero exploring authentic recreations of classic platforms from the earliest consoles to modern systems. Each world faithfully recreates the graphical style, color palettes, and technical limitations of systems like the ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64, NES, Game Boy, and many more. Navigate through challenging levels that capture the essence of each era while uncovering the evolution of gaming itself.

title: Little Inferno
description: Little Inferno is a puzzle video game developed by American independent game developer Tomorrow Corporation. The game was released for the Wii U on November 18, 2012 in North America and November 30, 2012 in Europe and Australasia. Microsoft Windows, iOS, OS X, Linux and Android versions followed throughout 2013. A Nintendo Switch version was released on March 16, 2017 in North America, and on March 23, 2017 in Europe and Australasia.

title: Lone Survivor - The Director's Cut
description: Navigate a nightmarish post-apocalyptic world in this psychological survival horror adventure. You wake up alone in a decaying apartment complex where darkness harbors unspeakable terrors. Scavenge for supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and choose when to hide or confront the grotesque creatures that stalk the corridors. Every decision matters—conserve ammunition, manage your sanity, and uncover the mystery of what happened to humanity. The Director's Cut enhances the original with expanded content, new dream sequences, additional endings, and enhanced survival mechanics.

title: Lost Reavers
description: Lost Reavers was a free-to-play multiplayer online game developed and published by Bandai Namco for the Wii U. The game was distributed via Nintendo eShop, and took advantage of the Nintendo Network. A public beta test was being held in Japan from 3 September until 13 September, followed by the title's commercial release on 2 December 2015. The game also released internationally on 28 April 2016. As of 31 May 2019, the game’s servers have been shut down.

title: Lovely Planet
description: Experience the most adorable apocalypse ever in this minimalist first-person shooter where speed and precision reign supreme. Navigate vibrant, abstract landscapes filled with pastel colors and geometric shapes as you race through bite-sized levels, eliminating cute enemies and dodging projectiles with lightning-fast reflexes. Each stage demands perfect execution—miss a single target or touch a bullet and you're back at the start. The seemingly simple visuals hide brutally challenging gameplay that requires mastering momentum, arc trajectories, and split-second timing.

title: Lucentek - Beyond
description: A sci-fi RPG set on planet Mosoideae, under threat of invasion from the Valkuren. Explore environments in first-person, uncovering hidden objects and quests to strengthen your party. Features a time-based battle system with over 15 spells and abilities. Navigate this digital-only eShop adventure as you fight to defend your world using reverse-engineered alien technology. Single-player experience blending exploration, combat, and strategic character progression in a 3D science fiction setting. Sources: - [Lucentek Beyond (2017) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/lucentek_beyond) - [Lucentek: Beyond (2017) - MobyGames](https://www.mobygames.com/g

title: Madden NFL 13
description: Experience the intensity of professional football with Madden NFL 13 on Wii U. This iteration brings the gridiron to Nintendo's console with enhanced GamePad integration, allowing you to call plays, make pre-snap adjustments, and manage your team directly from the controller's touchscreen. The Connected Careers mode combines Franchise and Superstar modes into a unified experience where you can play as a coach or player across multiple seasons. Infinity Engine physics delivers realistic player collisions and momentum-based tackles that make every hit feel authentic.

title: Mahjong
description: Rediscover the traditional Chinese tile-matching game with 70 challenging levels of varying difficulty. Clear the board by finding matching pairs of tiles while avoiding becoming blocked. Features multiple graphic styles for customization, brand new puzzle layouts, and classic Mahjong solitaire gameplay. Test your strategic thinking as you work through increasingly complex arrangements to clear each level.

title: Mahjong Deluxe 3
description: Match pairs of identical tiles to clear the board in this classic Mahjong solitaire experience. Features 640 puzzle layouts across 8 themed worlds, playable in both 2D and 3D perspectives. Random tile placement ensures each layout offers fresh replayability. Developed by award-winning EnsenaSoft, this entry in the popular series combines relaxing music and strategic tile-matching gameplay suitable for all ages and skill levels. Intuitive controls make it easy to pick up while offering depth for puzzle enthusiasts. Sources: - [Mahjong Deluxe 3 Released On Wii U - Family Friendly Gaming](https://familyfriendlygaming.com/News/Updates/2017/Mahjong%20Deluxe%203%20Released%20On%20Wii%20U.html) -

title: Mario & Sonic at the Rio 2016 Olympic Games
description: Mario & Sonic at the Rio 2016 Olympic Games is a crossover sports and party game in the Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games series, released for the Nintendo 3DS in February 2016 in Japan, March 2016 in North America, and in April 2016 for Europe and Australia, and for the Wii U worldwide in June 2016. The game is officially licensed by the International Olympic Committee, as have the other games in the series. It was developed by Sega, with assistance from Arzest and Spike Chunsoft, and published by Nintendo.

title: Mario & Sonic at the Sochi 2014 Olympic Winter Games
description: Mario & Sonic at the Sochi 2014 Olympic Winter Games is a crossover sports/party video game for the Wii U, the first for the console. It was unveiled on May 17, 2013, is the fourth game in the Mario & Sonic series, and is the official video game for the 2014 Winter Olympics being held in Sochi. It was released on November 8, 2013 in Europe, November 9, 2013 in Australia,November 15, 2013 in North America, and December 5, 2013 in Japan.

title: Mario Kart 8
description: Mario Kart 8 is a kart racing video game and the eighth major instalment in the Mario Kart series, developed and published by Nintendo for their Wii U home video game console. The game was announced at E3 2013 and released worldwide in May 2014. Like in other games in the series, in Mario Kart 8, players control characters from the Mario franchise and participate in kart racing on various race tracks, using a variety of items to hinder opponents or gain advantages in the race. While incorporating game mechanics originally featured in earlier Mario Kart games, Mario Kart 8 introduces anti-gravity sections that allow players to drive on walls or ceilings, in addition to allowing them to bum...

title: Mario Party 10
description: Mario Party 10 is a party video game developed by NDcube and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. The tenth main installment in the Mario Party series, it was released worldwide in March 2015. It is the first game in the series since Mario Party 4 to have Donkey Kong as a playable character for every aspect of the game.

title: Mario Tennis: Ultra Smash
description: Mario Tennis: Ultra Smash is a video game in the Mario Tennis series developed by Camelot Software Planning and published by Nintendo for the Wii U, released internationally in November 2015, and released in Japan in January 2016. The game received mixed to negative reviews from critics due to its lack of content.

title: Mario vs. Donkey Kong - Tipping Stars
description: Guide Mini toys to safety in this inventive puzzle-platformer that challenges you to create pathways using a variety of construction pieces. Place girders, springs, conveyor belts, and warp pipes to navigate increasingly complex levels filled with obstacles and enemies. The game features over 80 challenging stages across multiple worlds, plus a robust level editor that lets you design and share your own creations with players worldwide. Earn stars based on your performance, then use them to tip other creators whose levels you enjoy—the community-driven aspect adds endless replayability.

title: Marvel Avengers - Battle for Earth
description: Harness the power of Kinect motion controls to become Earth's Mightiest Heroes in this motion-based fighting game. Battle through an original story inspired by the Secret Invasion comic storyline as the Skrull Empire launches an all-out assault on Earth. Choose from 20 Marvel superheroes including Iron Man, Hulk, Captain America, and Thor, each with unique combat moves executed through full-body gestures. Fight solo or team up with a friend in cooperative mode, unleashing devastating super moves and iconic abilities.

title: Masked Forces
description: Test your shooting skills in this action-packed first-person tactical shooter. Eliminate enemies by any means necessary across single-player campaigns and online multiplayer modes. Visit the armor and weapon shop to unlock and upgrade your arsenal with various weapons and protective gear. With straightforward FPS mechanics, engage in intense combat scenarios designed to challenge your reflexes and strategic thinking. Face off against opponents in multiple game modes as you prove your combat prowess. Sources: - [Masked Forces (2018) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/masked_forces) - [Masked Forces Release Information for Wii U - GameFAQs](https

title: Mass Effect 3: Special Edition
description: Mass Effect 3 is an action role-playing video game developed by BioWare and published by Electronic Arts. The final instalment of the Mass Effect trilogy, it was first released in March 2012 for Microsoft Windows, Xbox 360, and PlayStation 3. A Wii U version of the game, entitled Mass Effect 3: Special Edition, was later released in November 2012. Mass Effect 3 is set within the Milky Way Galaxy in 2186, where civilization is invaded by a highly advanced machine race of synthetic-organic starships known as Reapers. It concludes the story of Commander Shepard, an elite human soldier who is tasked with forging alliances between species for the war.

title: Master Reboot
description: Enter a haunting digital afterlife in this atmospheric first-person psychological adventure. You awaken in the Soul Cloud, a massive server where human memories are stored after death, but something has gone terribly wrong. Navigate through surreal, distorted environments reconstructed from fragmented memories as you piece together your identity and uncover the dark truth behind this virtual heaven. Solve environmental puzzles, avoid nightmarish threats, and explore everything from childhood homes to eerie hospitals.

title: Maze
description: Navigate first-person labyrinths as a young hero from Mazadon searching for the Oracle. Collect coins, dodge enemies and traps, and solve puzzles across 24 single-player stages. Features arcade and local multiplayer modes where two players compete to solve mazes and collect coins. Developed by TreeFall Studios, this budget puzzle adventure challenges players to find exits while gathering all 10 coins scattered throughout each maze. Sources: - [Maze (2015) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/maze?page=2) - [Maze Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/maze) - [Maze (Wii U) Review | Nintendo World Repo

title: Meme Run
description: Meme Run is an endless running video game created by American indie developer Ninja Pig Studios (Jordan Schuetz and his brother) for the Wii U console's eShop service. The game features extensive use of Internet memes; for example, the player character is a stick figure with a trollface for a head, and the levels are made up of Lenny faces. The game was designed to appeal to both hardcore and casual audiences, but has been widely criticized both before and after its release for its perceived low quality.

title: Midnight
description: Guide a square-shaped fairy through 28 physics-based golf puzzle levels using the GamePad to launch Midnight toward the goal. Avoid deadly spikes, circular saws, and hazardous obstacles while earning 3-star ratings by completing each stage in the fewest moves possible. Features minimalist silhouette art style with lush environments and a soothing piano soundtrack. Developed by Vilmos Gyokeres and published by Petite Games as a Wii U eShop exclusive, this challenging puzzler tests precision and planning across increasingly difficult levels. Sources: - [Midnight (Wii U) Review - Nintendo World Report](http://www.nintendoworldreport.com/review/39629/midnight-wii-u-review) - [Midnight Review (W

title: Mighty No. 9
description: Mighty No. 9 is a 2016 action platform video game developed by Concept, in conjunction with Inti Creates, and published by Deep Silver. The game was crowdfunded through Kickstarter and incorporated heavy input from the public. Mighty No. 9 closely resembles the early Mega Man series in both gameplay and character design, which project lead Keiji Inafune worked on, and is considered its spiritual successor.

title: Mighty Switch Force! 2
description: Take control of cybernetic peacekeeper Patricia Wagon in this vibrant puzzle-platformer that turns firefighting into a high-speed brain teaser. Armed with your trusty Pellet Gun, you'll blast blocks to create paths, reveal secrets, and rescue adorable Hooligan Sisters from burning buildings across sixteen challenging stages. Switch between foreground and background layers to manipulate the environment, extinguish flames, and master increasingly complex spatial puzzles. Race against par times in a test of both wits and reflexes as you navigate colorful, pixel-perfect levels filled with devious obstacles and creative challenges.

title: Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition
description: Mighty Switch Force! is a puzzle platformer developed by WayForward Technologies for Nintendo 3DS. It is the third game in WayForward's Mightyseries, following Mighty Flip Champs! and Mighty Milky Way. The game was released on the Nintendo eShop on December 22, 2011. An update to the game, including five new levels, was released on May 24, 2012. A high-definition version, Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition, was released for the Wii U in 2012, featuring re-drawn graphics and other new features. A Steam version of the game was also released in June 2015. A sequel, Mighty Switch Force! 2, was released in June 2013.

title: Minecraft - Story Mode
description: Step into a narrative-driven adventure set in the blocky world of Minecraft, where your choices shape the story. Play as Jesse and embark on a perilous journey across the Overworld, through the Nether, to the End, and beyond. When the world is threatened by the legendary Wither Storm, you must team up with old friends and new allies to save it. Make critical decisions that affect the story, engage in action-packed sequences, and solve environmental puzzles. Featuring Telltale's signature choice-based gameplay combined with Minecraft's iconic visual style, this episodic adventure offers a fresh take on the beloved crafting universe with its own heroes, villains, and original storyline.

title: Minecraft: Wii U Edition
description: Minecraft is a sandbox video game created by Swedish game developer Markus Persson and released by Mojang in 2011. The game allows players to build with a variety of different blocks in a 3D procedurally generated world, requiring creativity from players. Other activities in the game include exploration, resource gathering, crafting, and combat. Multiple game modes that change gameplay are available, including—but not limited to—a survival mode, in which players must acquire resources to build the world and maintain health, and a creative mode, where players have unlimited resources to build with.

title: Mini-Mario & Friends: amiibo Challenge
description: Mini Mario & Friends: Amiibo Challenge is a puzzle video game developed and published by Nintendo for the Wii U and Nintendo 3DS. The game is free to download on the Nintendo eShop, but requires Nintendo's Amiibo lineup in order to play. It was released in Japan in January 2016, and worldwide in April of that year.

title: Momonga Pinball Adventures
description: Guide Momonga, a brave flying squirrel, through a whimsical pinball adventure to save his village from evil owls. This unique physics-based puzzler transforms classic pinball mechanics into an epic journey across beautifully hand-painted worlds. Flip, bounce, and soar through nine distinct areas filled with challenging obstacles, cunning enemies, and hidden secrets. Master precise ball control to navigate treacherous paths, solve environmental puzzles, and defeat bosses in this charming fusion of pinball action and adventure storytelling.

title: Mon Premier Karaoké
description: Mon Premier Karaoké is a karaoke game designed for children aged 3 to 6, featuring popular French nursery rhymes and children's songs. Players can sing solo using the GamePad's built-in microphone or enjoy duet mode with friends and family using an external Wii U microphone. The game presents colorful HD animations alongside the lyrics, supports off-TV play entirely on the GamePad, and allows players to capture performance photos during their singing sessions. A straightforward, child-friendly karaoke experience for young French-speaking audiences. Sources: - [Mon Premier Karaoké | Wii U download software | Games | Nintendo UK](https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Wii-U-download-software/Mo

title: Monster High 13 Wishes
description: Step into the supernatural world of Monster High in this adventure based on the popular animated movie. Play as various iconic characters from Monster High as you navigate through the story of the 13 Wishes. Explore the halls of Monster High, interact with your favorite ghoulfriends, and uncover the mystery behind a powerful lantern that grants wishes. Engage in mini-games, collect items, and make choices that influence the story. With colorful graphics faithful to the animated series and gameplay designed for fans of the franchise, experience the charm and humor of Monster High in an interactive adventure that brings the movie's storyline to life.

title: Monster High New Ghoul in School
description: Join the world of Monster High as a new student navigating the halls of this famous monster school. Create your own unique ghoul character and explore the Monster High universe through engaging minigames and social interactions. Customize your character's appearance with fashionable outfits and accessories, then participate in various activities throughout the school. Complete quests, solve puzzles, and interact with beloved characters from the Monster High franchise including Draculaura, Frankie Stein, and Clawdeen Wolf. Attend classes, decorate your locker, and make friends as you experience life as a monster student.

title: Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate
description: Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate is a game for the Nintendo 3DS and Wii U. The game is similar to Monster Hunter Portable 3rd. The 3DS version was released on December 10, 2011 in Japan as Monster Hunter Tri G and features local wireless play. In Japan, Famitsu announced that Monster Hunter Tri G was confirmed as an expanded Monster Hunter Tri. It is the first game to support the Circle Pad Pro add-on. The game was also released in two bundles, one containing the special edition 3DS and the other one containing the add-on. It was also released on Wii U, which features revised HD graphics, full online, local multiplayer, and the ability to import the game progress to the player's Nintendo 3DS.

title: Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate Packet Relay for Nintendo 3DS
description: This free utility application bridges online play between Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate on Wii U and Nintendo 3DS. By running this app on your Wii U while connected to the internet, you enable local multiplayer sessions on the 3DS version to connect online, effectively creating an internet relay for portable hunters. The app provides a simple interface showing connection status and active relays. Essential for 3DS owners wanting to hunt online with friends, it transforms your Wii U into a network gateway.

title: Mountain Peak Battle Mess
description: Battle atop a mountain high in the clouds as a lone warrior struggling to survive endless waves of enemies. This challenging action RPG features permadeath mechanics that force you to start over with each defeat. Gain experience from fallen foes to upgrade your warrior's stats and abilities. The arcade-style gameplay combines platform elements with direct combat in a fantasy setting where survival depends on quick reflexes and strategic character progression. Test your endurance in this demanding roguelike experience.

title: Mr. Pumpkin Adventure
description: Guide Mr. Pumpkin through a surreal vegetable kingdom to recover his lost memories and uncover an evil plot. This point-and-click puzzle adventure features over 50 hand-drawn scenes across 8 chapters, each filled with challenging logic puzzles and hidden mini-games. Use special tools found in each screen to solve intricate puzzles and unlock doors. With multiple endings based on your choices and a secret chapter for completionists, this brain-teasing journey offers hours of quirky puzzle-solving in a whimsical world where vegetables rule. Sources: - [Mr. Pumpkin Adventure Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/mr_pumpkin_adventure) - [Mr.

title: Mutant Alien Moles of the Dead
description: Stop an underground alien invasion in this fast-paced arcade reflex game. Whack mutant alien moles as they pop up through holes, using your hammer to defend Earth from extraterrestrial conquest. Beyond classic whack-a-mole mechanics, engage in rock-paper-scissors battles and utilize power-ups to overcome increasingly challenging waves. Developed by Pixel Bones Studio and published by EnjoyUp Games, this title offers arcade action that tests reflexes for players of all ages. Battle the invaders before they conquer the planet from below. Sources: - [Mutant Alien Moles of the Dead | Wii U download software | Games | Nintendo UK](https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Wii-U-download-software/Muta

title: Mutant Mudds Deluxe
description: Blast through a pixel-perfect platforming adventure across land, air, and sea in this enhanced version of the retro-inspired action game. Play as Max as he uses his water-powered jetpack and trusty cannon to navigate treacherous 2D environments filled with deadly spikes, floating platforms, and menacing mutant creatures. Leap between foreground and background layers to discover hidden paths and collectibles in this unique dimensional mechanic. Master precise jumps and combat timing across 80 challenging levels spanning multiple worlds. Unlock new playable characters including Max's granny and explore bonus levels designed exclusively for this deluxe edition.

title: Mutant Mudds Super Challenge
description: Push your platforming skills to the absolute limit in this brutally difficult sequel designed for hardcore players. Building on the retro-inspired gameplay of the original Mutant Mudds, this extreme challenge features 40 brand-new levels packed with precision jumps, pixel-perfect timing, and devious enemy placements. Armed with your trusty water cannon and jetpack, blast through mutant enemies across multiple dimensional planes, shifting between foreground and background layers to navigate treacherous terrain. Every level demands mastery of momentum, careful resource management, and nerves of steel.

title: My Jurassic Farm
description: Start with an empty field, $100, and a single compsognathus dinosaur. Build your own Jurassic farm by raising and breeding 10 different species of dinosaurs. Feed each species their specific diet, administer proper medicine, and maintain their happiness while keeping the farm clean. Sell dinosaur eggs to earn money and expand your prehistoric ranch. Balance resource management with animal care to create a thriving dinosaur sanctuary. Features simple gameplay mechanics suitable for younger players who dream of managing their own dino park. Sources: - [My Jurassic Farm for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/812556-my-jurassic-farm) - [PN Review: My Jurassic Farm (Wii U eSho

title: My Style Studio Notebook
description: Create paintings, sketches, notes, and flipbook animations using the Wii U GamePad's touchscreen. Features five painting tools, brush and smudge capabilities, 30 stamps, two erasers, and customizable covers. Mix photos into your artwork or craft frame-by-frame animations. This budget-priced art application offers basic drawing and editing tools for casual creative expression, though it lacks advanced features like proper zoom controls and adjustable brush sizes found in more robust art programs. Sources: - [My Style Studio: Notebook for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/my-style-studio-notebook-wii-u/) - [My Style Studio: Notebook (2015) | Wii U eShop Game

title: Nano Assault Neo
description: Nano Assault Neo is a twin-stick shoot 'em up video game developed by Shin'en Multimedia and released on the Nintendo eShop for the Wii U. It was a launch title for the system on 18 November 2012 in North America, and in PAL regions on 30 November 2012. It was later released in Japan on 27 February 2013, courtesy of Arc System Works. It is the sequel to the 2011 Nintendo 3DS game Nano Assault.

title: NBA 2K13
description: Step onto the hardwood with NBA 2K13, the critically acclaimed basketball simulation that delivers unparalleled authenticity and depth. Experience the thrill of professional basketball with stunning player likenesses, signature animations, and realistic physics that capture every crossover, dunk, and buzzer-beater. Take control of your favorite NBA teams and legends in multiple game modes including MyCareer, where you build a player from rookie to hall of famer, and Association mode for complete franchise management. The Wii U GamePad enhances gameplay with intuitive play-calling and on-the-fly coaching adjustments.

title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted U
description: Need for Speed: Most Wanted is an open world racing game developed by Criterion Games and published by Electronic Arts. Most Wanted is the nineteenth title in the Need for Speed series and was released worldwide for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, PlayStation Vita, iOS and Android, beginning in North America in 2012, with a Wii U version following in 2013 under the title Need for Speed: Most Wanted U.The game picked up on the Most Wanted intellectual property, as opposed to the Hot Pursuit reboot that Criterion Games developed previously.

title: NES Remix
description: NES Remix is a compilation video game series for Wii U, developed by Nintendo and indieszero. The first game was simultaneously announced and released on December 18, 2013 on the Nintendo eShop following a Nintendo Direct presentation. A second game, NES Remix 2, was released on April 25, 2014. A retail edition consisting of both games, titled NES Remix Pack, was released on April 24, 2014 in Japan and December 5, 2014 in North America. Another title, Ultimate NES Remix for Nintendo 3DS, was released on November 7, 2014 in Europe, November 8, 2014 in Australia, December 5, 2014 in North America and August 27, 2015 in Japan.

title: NES Remix 2
description: NES Remix is a compilation video game series for Wii U, developed by Nintendo and indieszero. The first game was simultaneously announced and released on December 18, 2013 on the Nintendo eShop following a Nintendo Direct presentation. A second game, NES Remix 2, was released on April 25, 2014. A retail edition consisting of both games, titled NES Remix Pack, was released on April 24, 2014 in Japan and December 5, 2014 in North America. Another title, Ultimate NES Remix for Nintendo 3DS, was released on November 7, 2014 in Europe, November 8, 2014 in Australia, December 5, 2014 in North America and August 27, 2015 in Japan.

title: NES Remix Pack
description: NES Remix is a compilation video game series for Wii U, developed by Nintendo and indieszero. The first game was simultaneously announced and released on December 18, 2013 on the Nintendo eShop following a Nintendo Direct presentation. A second game, NES Remix 2, was released on April 25, 2014. A retail edition consisting of both games, titled NES Remix Pack, was released on April 24, 2014 in Japan and December 5, 2014 in North America. Another title, Ultimate NES Remix for Nintendo 3DS, was released on November 7, 2014 in Europe, November 8, 2014 in Australia, December 5, 2014 in North America and August 27, 2015 in Japan.

title: Never Alone (Kisima Ingitchuna)
description: Experience an unforgettable journey through the frozen Arctic in this atmospheric puzzle-platformer based on Iñupiaq stories passed down through generations. Play as Nuna, a young Iñupiaq girl, and her loyal arctic fox companion as you traverse beautiful yet treacherous tundra, solve environmental puzzles, and encounter mythical characters from Native Alaskan folklore. Switch between both characters or play cooperatively with a friend to utilize their unique abilities—Nuna's physical prowess and the fox's agile movements and spirit-sight. Brave blizzards, leap across ice floes, and overcome obstacles while uncovering the source of an eternal blizzard threatening your village.

title: New Super Luigi U
description: New Super Luigi U (stylized as New Super Luigi Bros. U) is a 2D side-scrolling platform video game in the New Super Mario Bros. series developed by Nintendo for the Wii U. It is the fourth of five games focusing on Luigi (the others being Mario Is Missing, Luigi's Mansion, Luigi's Mansion: Dark Moon and Luigi's Mansion 3), released in two different versions first being the downloadable content(DLC) package for the main game New Super Mario Bros. U on the Nintendo eShop released in June 2013, and a standalone retail version released in Japan, Europe, and Australia in July 2013, with a release in North America the following month.

title: New Super Mario Bros. U
description: New Super Mario Bros. U is a 2D side-scrolling platform video game developed and published in 2012 by Nintendo for the Wii U. It is the fourth title in the New Super Mario Bros. series. An additional campaign for the Year of Luigi, New Super Luigi U, was released as downloadable content in June 2013. A standalone retail version was released the following month. The game received positive reviews, and is one of the best-selling games on the Wii U.

title: New Super Mario Bros. U + New Super Luigi U
description: In the Nintendo Direct from September 14, 2018, Nintendo unveiled an enhanced port from New Super Mario Bros. U and New Super Luigi U exclusively for the Nintendo Switch titled New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe. The game contains New Super Mario Bros. U and New Super Luigi U and runs in 1080p and 60 frames per second while the original Wii U version runs in 720p and 60 frames per second. The game also contains two new characters called Nabbit and Toadette. It was released on January 11, 2019. A power-up called "Super Crown" is a power up for Toadette, which causes her to transform into a character that resembles Princess Peach, Peachette.

title: Nihilumbra
description: Guide Born, a shapeless entity that has escaped from the Void, through a beautifully haunting world where nothing wants you to exist. Use powerful colors as abilities to overcome environmental puzzles and relentless enemies. Paint the world with blue to create ice, brown to bounce, green for friction - each color fundamentally changes how you interact with the environment. Master creative combinations to solve increasingly devious challenges across diverse hand-painted landscapes. Narrated with melancholic wisdom, Nihilumbra blends contemplative storytelling with inventive puzzle-platforming.

title: Ninja Gaiden 3: Razor's Edge
description: Ninja Gaiden 3: Razor's Edge is a 2012 action-adventure video game developed by Team Ninja and originally published by Nintendo for the Wii U in 2012 and subsequently released by Tecmo Koei for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2013. It is an enhanced port of Ninja Gaiden 3 that includes all downloadable content from the original title, as well as additional enhancements made to improve the game. The game can be considered an equivalent to the Ninja Gaiden Sigmagames, as it enhances the original title.

title: Ninja Pizza Girl
description: Run, jump, and deliver pizzas through a vibrant cyberpunk cityscape in this fast-paced platformer with a heart. Play as Gemma, a sixteen-year-old pizza delivery girl who uses parkour moves to navigate rooftops and alleyways while facing off against a rival pizza company and their bullying tactics. The game combines momentum-based platforming with a unique mental health system where negativity from enemies and the environment affects your performance. String together acrobatic moves, maintain your speed, and shake off the haters to make your deliveries on time.

title: Ninja Strike Dangerous Dash
description: Choose from five different ninjas, each with unique abilities, in this high-speed side-scrolling endless runner. Dash through dangerous levels while jumping over or slashing enemies to keep your momentum. Collect coins dropped by defeated foes to level up your ninjas and unlock new characters. Master three distinct ninja ways: run and jump to avoid danger, or slash through obstacles in your path. With fast-paced action and multiple playable characters, test your reflexes as you strive for the highest score in this arcade-style challenge. Sources: - [Ninja Strike: Dangerous Dash for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/ninja-strike-dangerous-dash-wii-u/) - [Ni

title: Nintendo Land
description: Step into a virtual theme park celebrating Nintendo's greatest franchises in this party game collection designed to showcase the Wii U GamePad. Play 12 attractions inspired by Zelda, Metroid, Mario, Donkey Kong, and more, each utilizing the GamePad's unique features. Compete in solo challenges or team up with friends in asymmetric multiplayer where the GamePad player has a different role than TV players. Navigate Metroid Blast's spaceship battles, tackle The Legend of Zelda: Battle Quest's cooperative sword fighting, or master Luigi's Ghost Mansion's hide-and-seek thrills. Every attraction demonstrates creative uses of the dual-screen gameplay.

title: Nova-111
description: Navigate a vibrant sci-fi universe where real-time action collides with turn-based strategy in this unique hybrid adventure. Pilot the Nova-111 research vessel through mysterious alien planets, solving intricate environmental puzzles while battling strange creatures that move in both turn-based and real-time patterns. Master the innovative dual-time mechanic—enemies and hazards operate on different temporal rules, creating mind-bending tactical challenges. Explore procedurally-generated worlds filled with scientific anomalies, rescue stranded scientists, and collect DNA samples from bizarre alien lifeforms.

title: Octodad Dadliest Catch
description: Step into the tentacles of Octodad, a dapper octopus masquerading as a human father and husband. Navigate everyday tasks like mowing the lawn, buying groceries, and attending family outings while desperately concealing your cephalopod identity from suspicious humans. The physics-based controls create hilarious chaos as you struggle to coordinate your floppy tentacles to perform simple actions without raising suspicion. Wedding anniversaries become obstacle courses, aquarium visits turn into high-stakes stealth missions, and cooking dinner becomes an exercise in controlled destruction.

title: Oddworld - New 'N' Tasty
description: Return to Rupture Farms in this stunning remake of the original Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee. Guide Abe, a Mudokon slave worker, through treacherous industrial facilities as he attempts to escape captivity and rescue his fellow workers from being processed into food products. This cinematic platformer combines precise movement, environmental puzzles, and a unique "GameSpeak" system that lets you command other Mudokons with voice commands. Sneak past deadly Sligs, possess enemies to use their abilities against them, and solve intricate puzzles across beautifully reimagined environments. Your choices matter—save all 299 Mudokons for the good ending or leave them behind.

title: OlliOlli
description: Master the art of skateboarding in this brutally addictive 2D side-scrolling action game. Grind through 50 devious levels across five distinct worlds, each demanding pixel-perfect precision and split-second timing. Chain together tricks, grinds, and manuals to build massive combos while racing against the clock. The simple two-button control scheme is deceptively deep—landing tricks requires you to time your release perfectly, turning every rail and gap into a test of skill. Compete in daily challenges called the Daily Grind, chase high scores in the punishing RAD mode, and perfect your runs in Spots mode.

title: Olympia Rising
description: Battle your way out of the Underworld as Iola, a warrior cast into Hades' domain. This vertical platformer challenges you to slash through enemies and build aerial combos while climbing upward through six twisted environments. Collect Obolus coins from defeated foes to pay Charon the Ferryman and pass through the gates of the Underworld. Face fierce bosses including giant crabs and bone-crunching cyclops. Simple to pick up but difficult to master, with fast-paced combat and fluid movement that rewards skilled players seeking the most efficient paths to Mount Olympus. Sources: - [Olympia Rising (Wii U eShop) Review – Seafoam Gaming](https://seafoamgaming.com/2016/07/18/olympia-rising-wii-u-e

title: One Piece: Unlimited World Red
description: One Piece: Unlimited World Red is an action-adventure video game based on the famous One Piece manga and anime. This is the thirty-sixth video game based on the series, and the fifth title in the Unlimited sub-series. It was released for the Nintendo 3DS in Japan on November 21, 2013 and released for additional platforms and in more regions the following year. On March 12, 2014, the game was confirmed to be releasing in North America, Europe, and Japan in 2014 on Wii U, PlayStation 3 and PlayStation Vita. The Wii U version does not have a physical retail release in North America and Australia.

title: Orbit
description: Guard your base against incoming enemy ships in this minimalist defense game. Control an orbiting arrow around a central orb and tap the screen to create protective barriers that destroy approaching threats. Enemy ships fly in from random directions, and you must time your shield deployment perfectly to stop them. Miss too many attacks and it's game over. Stylus-controlled gameplay challenges you to rack up high scores through quick reflexes and precise timing in this budget eShop title from RCMADIAX. title: Outside the Realm
description: Control Amos the Astronaut through 30 space-themed puzzle levels using the Wii U GamePad. Tap to send Amos bouncing through space as he collects crystals for an alien merchant. Use the D-Pad to control direction while dodging enemies and navigating obstacles to reach the ship safely. Master timing and trajectory in this budget-priced eShop puzzle game from TreeFall Studios that can be completed in about 30 minutes.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description: Jump into the vibrant world of Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures in this colorful 3D platformer. Play as Pac-Man with the ability to transform into different forms, each granting unique powers to overcome obstacles and defeat ghosts. Chomp through the Netherworld, navigate diverse environments from haunted castles to futuristic cities, and take on challenging boss battles. Use power-ups like Fire Pac, Ice Pac, and Chameleon Pac to solve puzzles and battle the mischievous ghosts threatening PacWorld. The game features accessible platforming action with variety in level design and abilities, making it an enjoyable adventure for fans of character-driven platformers and newcomers alike.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures 2
description: Join Pac-Man in his second 3D platforming adventure as he battles the sinister Betrayus and his ghostly forces threatening Pac-World. Jump, chomp, and power-up your way through colorful environments filled with challenging obstacles and puzzles. Transform into different forms with unique abilities - freeze enemies as Ice Pac, bounce higher as Rubber Pac, or shrink down to access secret areas. Switch between Pac-Man and his friends Cylindria and Spiral, each offering distinct gameplay mechanics and special skills. Battle through multiple worlds with improved platforming controls, creative level designs, and exciting boss encounters that test your reflexes and timing.

title: Paparazzi
description: An asymmetric two-player competitive game where one player controls a celebrity fleeing to their limo while the other plays as a paparazzi photographer hunting for the perfect shot. The celebrity hides behind buildings and crowds across six auto-scrolling levels including movie studios, nightclubs, and high-class balls. The photographer uses the Wii Remote or GamePad to snap photos for money, while the celebrity wins by dodging the camera lens. Features seven playable characters from mulleted movie stars to bears on tricycles in this frantic game of cat-and-mouse. Sources: - [Paparazzi Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/paparazzi) - [Papara

title: Paper Mario: Color Splash
description: Paper Mario: Color Splash is a 2016 action-adventure role-playing video game developed by Intelligent Systems and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. It is the fifth game in the Paper Mario series, the sequel to Paper Mario: Sticker Star, and the final Wii U game developed by Intelligent Systems. The story follows the protagonist, Mario, on his quest to retrieve the Big Paint Stars and rescue Princess Peach from Bowser.

title: Paper Monsters Recut
description: Paper Monsters Recut is a charming 2.5D platformer set in a handcrafted papercraft world. Guide your cardboard hero through vibrant environments filled with creative enemies and challenging obstacles. Run, jump, and bounce your way through multiple worlds, each featuring unique visual themes and gameplay mechanics. Collect buttons scattered throughout levels to unlock bonus content, and discover hidden areas that reward thorough exploration. The game features tight controls, colorful graphics that bring the paper aesthetic to life, and a variety of enemy types that keep gameplay fresh. Perfect for platforming fans seeking a whimsical adventure with personality.

title: Paranautical Activity
description: Dive into a fast-paced roguelike first-person shooter where voxel-styled chaos meets frantic arcade action. Battle through procedurally generated levels filled with grotesque enemies in this adrenaline-fueled dungeon crawler. Each run offers randomized rooms, power-ups, and weapons that keep every playthrough fresh and unpredictable. Choose from multiple characters with unique abilities and face off against challenging bosses that test your reflexes and strategic thinking. Permanent death means every decision matters—one mistake could end your run. Collect power-ups to become an unstoppable force, but stay alert as enemy patterns grow more complex.

title: Peg Solitaire
description: This digital adaptation of the classic peg solitaire board game challenges players to clear pegs from various playing fields by jumping over them. Start with a board full of pegs and one empty space, then hop pegs over adjacent pieces to eliminate them, aiming to leave as few pegs as possible. Using the GamePad's touchscreen and stylus, select and move pegs across different puzzle configurations that test your strategic thinking. Simple presentation focuses attention on the pure puzzle-solving experience in this timeless brain teaser.

title: Penguins of Madagascar
description: Join Skipper, Kowalski, Rico, and Private in this action-packed adventure based on the DreamWorks film. Play as all four penguins as you battle the villainous Dr. Octavius Brine across exotic locations from Venice to Shanghai. Use each penguin's unique abilities - Skipper's leadership and combat skills, Kowalski's inventions, Rico's explosive surprises, and Private's stealth maneuvers - to solve puzzles and defeat enemies. Switch between characters on the fly to overcome obstacles and take down Brine's octopus army. Features cooperative gameplay, special moves, and gadgets inspired by the movie.

title: Petite Zombies
description: Protect your territory from invading petite zombies in this stylus-driven action game. Use the Wii U GamePad to strategically defend against waves of undead attackers. Simple controls and touch-based gameplay make it accessible while providing quick arcade-style challenges. Originally released as a digital-only title on the Wii U eShop, this RandomSpin-developed game delivers fast-paced defensive action designed specifically for the GamePad's unique capabilities. Sources: - [Petite Zombies (2018) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/petite_zombies) - [Petite Zombies for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/249762-petite-zombies)

title: Phineas and Ferb - Quest for Cool Stuff
description: Join Phineas and Ferb on an exciting adventure to recover their lost artifacts and prove they're the coolest kids around. This action-adventure platformer lets you play as the inventive stepbrothers as they explore diverse worlds filled with puzzles, enemies, and hidden secrets. Use the Wii U GamePad to build custom gadgets and tools on the fly, combining different components to solve environmental challenges and overcome obstacles. Battle Agent P's nemesis Dr. Doofenshmirtz and his schemes while collecting trinkets to upgrade your abilities. Switch between characters to utilize their unique skills, explore vibrant 3D environments, and unlock new areas.

title: Pic-a-Pix Color
description: Dive into a vibrant world of logic puzzles where numbers reveal beautiful pixel art. Pic-a-Pix Color challenges you to solve nonogram puzzles using color-coded clues along each row and column. Each number indicates how many consecutive squares of that color need to be filled, transforming blank grids into charming illustrations ranging from cute animals to detailed scenes. With hundreds of puzzles across multiple difficulty levels, the game offers intuitive touchscreen controls on the GamePad for precise square-by-square filling. Progressive hints help when you're stuck, while timed challenges test your deduction speed.

title: Pier Solar
description: Experience a love letter to classic 16-bit RPGs in this turn-based adventure that pushes retro aesthetics to their limits. Guide Hoston and his friends through a vast world filled with challenging dungeons, strategic battles, and an epic story of friendship and discovery. The game features deep character customization, a branching narrative with multiple paths, and gorgeously detailed pixel art that rivals the best of the 16-bit era. With its atmospheric soundtrack, clever puzzles, and tactical combat system that rewards careful planning, Pier Solar delivers a nostalgic yet fresh RPG experience. Explore towns, gather allies, and uncover ancient secrets in this sprawling adventure.

title: Pikmin 3
description: Pikmin 3 is a game developed and published by Nintendo for the Wii U video game console. It is the sequel to Pikmin 2(2004) and was first released in Japan on July 13, 2013 and then in all other regions within the following month. Game designer Shigeru Miyamoto first announced Pikmin 3 on July 16, 2008 as a game for the Wii console, later stating at E3 2011 that its development had transitioned to Wii U. The game retains the gameplay elements introduced in previous Pikmin games, and adds new features, including new playable characters and Pikmin types, Off-TV Play and downloadable content.

title: Pikmin Short Movies HD
description: A collection of three charming 3D animated short films featuring Captain Olimar and the Pikmin. Watch the adorable plant-like creatures navigate everyday objects in The Night Juicer, Treasure in a Bottle, and Occupational Hazards. The HD presentation showcases detailed close-up interactions between Pikmin and their environment, revealing individual personalities and behaviors. Includes bonus content featuring Shigeru Miyamoto's original Flipnote Studio storyboards from the creation process. Approximately 20 minutes of delightful Pikmin adventures rendered in high definition. Sources: - [Pikmin Short Movies - Pikipedia](https://www.pikminwiki.com/Pikmin_Short_Movies) - [Pikmin Short Movies |

title: Pinball
description: Guide the ball around the board collecting points in this simple pinball experience from RCMADIAX. Navigate the playing field while racing against the clock, avoiding hazardous zones that threaten to end your game. Score points by hitting targets and keeping the ball in play. This budget-friendly eShop title offers straightforward pinball action focused on point collection and survival. Manage your time wisely as you flip, bounce, and rack up your high score. A no-frills approach to classic pinball mechanics designed for quick gaming sessions on the Wii U GamePad. Sources: - [PINBALL (2017) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/pinball) - [All Gam

title: Pinball Arcade
description: Step up to the most authentic digital pinball experience ever created. The Pinball Arcade brings legendary real-world pinball tables to your Wii U with stunning accuracy and meticulous attention to detail. Play faithfully recreated classics like Medieval Madness, Attack from Mars, and The Addams Family, each featuring realistic physics, original artwork, and the exact rule sets from the actual machines. Master complex shots, trigger multiball modes, and chase high scores across dozens of licensed tables spanning pinball history. Whether you're reliving arcade memories or discovering these iconic machines for the first time, every flipper, bumper, and ramp behaves just like the real thing.

title: Pinball Breakout
description: A hybrid arcade game that fuses classic brick-breaking action with pinball flipper mechanics. Players use flippers to launch and control a ball, smashing through blocks while keeping it in play. Features single-player high score mode and competitive two-player battles. Supports Off-TV Play on the GamePad, letting you break blocks and flip your way to victory entirely on the handheld screen. This Wii U eShop exclusive offers straightforward arcade gameplay with a unique twist on two retro gaming staples.

title: Pirate Pop Plus
description: Take on the role of Pete Jr., a young pirate on a mission to rescue his beloved pet from the nefarious Bubble Pirate. This retro-inspired arcade game challenges you to pop bubbles in an arena where gravity shifts at the press of a button. Master the unique gravity-flipping mechanic to navigate all four walls of the screen, creating strategic chains and dodging enemies. Collect coins, unlock new characters and pets, and chase high scores across multiple game modes. With its vibrant pixel art, catchy chiptune soundtrack, and addictive one-more-go gameplay, Pirate Pop Plus delivers a fresh twist on classic bubble-popping action that's easy to learn but difficult to master.

title: Pixeljunk Monsters
description: Defend your base from waves of colorful monsters in this charming tower defense game that combines strategic depth with accessible gameplay. Build and upgrade defensive towers across beautifully designed 2D environments, carefully managing resources and positioning to create the perfect defense network. Dance around the battlefield as Tikiman, the last line of defense for your village's helpless offspring. Each level presents new strategic challenges with varied monster types, multiple tower options, and branching upgrade paths.

title: PixelMaker
description: PixelMaker transforms your Wii U into a powerful pixel art creation studio. Draw and animate sprites using the GamePad's touchscreen with an intuitive interface that makes pixel-perfect artwork accessible to artists of all skill levels. Choose from a rich palette of colors, utilize layers for complex compositions, and bring your creations to life with frame-by-frame animation tools. Share your pixel art masterpieces with the community or export them for use in your own projects. Whether you're crafting character sprites, designing tilesets, or creating animated scenes, PixelMaker provides all the tools you need in a streamlined, user-friendly package that takes full advantage of the Wii U...

title: PixlCross
description: PixlCross brings the addictive logic of nonogram puzzles to your Wii U. Solve increasingly challenging picross grids by using numbered clues to reveal hidden pixel art images. Each puzzle requires careful deduction as you mark which squares should be filled and which should stay empty. With hundreds of puzzles ranging from simple 5x5 grids to massive 20x20 brain-teasers, the game offers endless hours of meditative yet mentally stimulating gameplay. Track your solving times, earn achievements, and unlock new puzzle packs as you master the art of picture logic.

title: Plantera
description: Grow your own garden in this charming idle clicker simulation. Plant crops and raise animals to produce coins, then invest in new plants, animals, and garden expansions. Your garden continues growing even when you're not playing. Harvest ripe crops by clicking them, defend against pesky magpies, rabbits, foxes, and wolves trying to steal your produce. Upgrade your garden with special items and unlock new areas as you build a thriving farm ecosystem that works for you around the clock.

title: Pokemon Rumble U
description: Pokémon Rumble U is a 2013 action video game in the Pokémon series available on the Wii U eShop. It is the successor to the 2011 3DS game Pokémon Rumble Blast. It features all Pokémon from the first five generations. Up to 100 Pokémon and 4 players are able to play at the same time. It is the first Wii U game to utilize the Wii U GamePad's NFC function. It was released in Japan on April 24, 2013, in Europe on August 15, 2013 and in North America on August 29, 2013.

title: Poker Dice Solitaire Future
description: Roll the dice to create poker hands in this GamePad-focused puzzle game. You have three rolls to form hands like straights, flushes, and full houses—successfully complete a hand to earn points, but fail all three attempts and lose points. The objective is simple: chase the perfect score of 1350 by strategically choosing which dice to keep and which to reroll. Developed by RCMADIAX as the first entry in the Tabletop Gallery series, this budget eShop title offers quick, pick-up-and-play sessions for poker fans and score chasers alike. Sources: - [POKER DICE SOLITAIRE FUTURE (2014) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/poker_dice_solitaire_future) -

title: Pokken Tournament
description: Pokkén Tournament is a fighting game developed by Bandai Namco Studios and published by Nintendo and The Pokémon Company. The game combines gameplay elements from Bandai Namco's Tekken series with characters from Nintendo's Pokémon franchise, inspiring the portmanteau title Pokkén.It was released for Japanese arcades in July 2015, and worldwide for the Wii U in March 2016. An enhanced port for the Nintendo Switch, Pokkén Tournament DX, was released in September 2017.

title: Poncho
description: Journey through a post-apocalyptic world as a tiny red robot in this unique puzzle-platformer that plays with perspective and depth. Navigate crumbling environments by switching between parallel layers of the world, revealing new paths and solutions to environmental challenges. The innovative parallax-based mechanic lets you move between foreground and background planes to bypass obstacles, discover secrets, and piece together the mystery of humanity's disappearance. Explore beautifully crafted pixel art landscapes filled with remnants of civilization, encounter quirky characters, and solve clever spatial puzzles that challenge your perception of 2D space.

title: Preston Sterling
description: Guide adventurer Preston Sterling on his quest to find Excalibur, the legendary sword of King Arthur. This touch-controlled point-and-click adventure blends English myths with puzzle-solving gameplay. Navigate through gradually challenging scenarios using intuitive controls as you uncover the mysteries behind Arthurian legend. Developed by Animation Arts, creators of Secret Files: Tunguska, this episodic adventure delivers a compact yet engaging experience designed for both newcomers and adventure game veterans. Sources: - [Preston Sterling for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/212155-preston-sterling) - [Preston Sterling Release Information for Wii U - GameFAQs](https:/

title: Puddle
description: Guide a puddle of fluid through intricate environments in this physics-based puzzle game where you tilt and manipulate the world itself. Control the flow of various liquids—water, oil, nitroglycerin, molten lava—each with unique properties that affect how they move and interact. Navigate through 48 challenging levels spanning coffee machines, gardens, laboratories, and even the human body. Carefully manage your fluid's volume as you avoid hazards like flames, electricity, and absorbent materials that threaten to drain your precious liquid. Master precise tilting mechanics and environmental physics to solve increasingly complex puzzles.

title: Pumped Bmx +
description: Pull off jaw-dropping tricks and master precision timing in this high-octane BMX stunt game. Navigate 60 increasingly challenging levels across five distinct worlds, each demanding perfect execution of flips, spins, and grinds. Chain together spectacular trick combinations while racing against the clock, balancing risk and reward with every jump. The physics-based gameplay requires split-second timing as you pump, jump, and rotate through obstacle-filled courses. With 500+ challenges to complete, 16 riders to unlock, and tricks ranging from basic maneuvers to gravity-defying combos, every run offers new opportunities to push your skills to the limit.

title: Pure Chess
description: Experience the timeless game of chess in stunning visual detail with Pure Chess. This elegant chess simulator features beautifully crafted pieces and boards rendered in photorealistic 3D, bringing the classic strategy game to life like never before. Challenge yourself against sophisticated AI opponents across multiple difficulty levels, from beginner-friendly matches to grandmaster-level play that will test even seasoned players. Play locally against friends or take on opponents online in ranked matches. The game includes comprehensive tutorials for newcomers and supports both traditional and quick-play time controls.

title: Pushmo World
description: Pushmo World, known as Pullblox World in Europe and as Hikuosu World in Japan, is a puzzle game developed by Intelligent Systems and published by Nintendo for the Wii Uvideo game console. The game is a sequel to Pushmo and Crashmo, and was released worldwide on June 19, 2014.

title: Q.U.B.E Director's Cut
description: Wake up in a mysterious facility with no memory of how you got there, armed only with a pair of high-tech gloves that can manipulate colored cubes. Navigate through mind-bending physics puzzles where you'll create blocks, rotate platforms, and reshape your environment to progress. This Director's Cut enhances the original first-person puzzle experience with improved graphics, new time trial modes, and against-the-clock challenges that test your spatial reasoning under pressure. Discover the truth behind your predicament as the stark white chambers give way to darker revelations.

title: Quadcopter Pilot Challenge
description: Take control of a quadcopter drone in over 200 challenges across seven distinct activities. Navigate through rings, pop balloons, shoot targets, and chase robotic sheep while mastering realistic flight physics. Features dual-screen gameplay with third-person view on TV and first-person camera on the GamePad. Multiple difficulty modes test your piloting skills, from easy to a realistic "real" mode requiring precise control using the GamePad's first-person perspective. Developed by TACS Games for the Wii U eShop. Sources: - [Quadcopter Pilot Challenge (2015) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/quadcopter_pilot_challenge) - [Quadcopter Pilot Challe

title: Queens Garden
description: Restore the royal garden to its former glory in this match-3 puzzle adventure. Clear colorful tiles across 100 challenging levels using three game modes: relaxed, timed, and move-restricted. Earn coins to purchase from 60 different garden decorations and customize your palace grounds. Includes bonus hidden object scenes and memory games. Help the princess rebuild her kingdom's gardens one puzzle at a time through strategic tile-matching gameplay reminiscent of classic match-3 titles. Sources: - [Queen's Garden Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/queens_garden) - [Queen's Garden (2016) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendol

title: Quest of Dungeons
description: Quest of Dungeons is a turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler where an evil Dark Lord has stolen all the light from the land. Choose from four different heroes—each with unique abilities—and descend into procedurally generated dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and treasure. Every playthrough creates a new adventure with randomized levels, loot, and challenges. Master tactical combat where every move counts, level up your character, discover powerful weapons and spells, and unlock new skills as you fight deeper into the darkness. With permadeath raising the stakes, each decision matters.

title: Rabbids Land
description: Rabbids Land is a Wii U game that was announced by Ubisoft at E3 2012. It is the seventh console installment of the Raving Rabbids series.

title: Race the Sun
description: Race toward a dying sun at breakneck speeds in this intense endless runner where velocity is survival. Pilot your solar-powered craft through a procedurally generated world of stark geometric obstacles, collecting pick-ups and power-ups while the sun sinks toward the horizon. Every collision costs precious speed, and when your solar energy runs out, the run ends. Master split-second maneuvering to thread through narrow gaps, launch off ramps for massive jumps, and chain together risky moves for maximum points. Each day brings a new randomly generated world that's the same for all players, creating daily competitive leaderboards.

title: Radiantflux Hyperfractal
description: Dive into a mesmerizing world of fractal geometry and light in this unique puzzle experience. Navigate through hypnotic, ever-shifting patterns of mathematical beauty as you solve increasingly complex spatial challenges. Each level presents a new fractal dimension where you manipulate light, color, and geometric forms to progress. The game's procedurally generated visuals create stunning kaleidoscopic environments that react dynamically to your actions. With its ambient soundtrack and meditative gameplay, Radiantflux offers a zen-like experience that challenges both your spatial reasoning and pattern recognition skills.

title: Rapala Pro Bass Fishing
description: Cast your line into the ultimate bass fishing simulation, powered by the legendary Rapala brand. Experience realistic fishing mechanics as you master various techniques including jigging, trolling, and casting across multiple tournament locations. The GamePad serves as your tackle box and sonar fish finder, adding tactical depth to every catch. Compete in career mode tournaments, customize your boat and equipment, and learn from pro angler tips to land trophy bass. With dynamic weather conditions affecting fish behavior and authentic Rapala lures at your disposal, every outing presents new challenges.

title: Rayman Legends
description: Rayman Legends is a platform video game developed by Ubisoft Montpellier and published by Ubisoft. It is the fifth main title in the Rayman series and the direct sequel to the 2011 game Rayman Origins. The game was released for Microsoft Windows, Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, Wii U, and PlayStation Vita platforms in August and September 2013. PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions were released in February 2014. A Nintendo Switch port, titled Rayman Legends Definitive Edition was released in North America, Europe and Australia on September 12, 2017.

title: Rayman Legends Challenges App
description: A free companion app to Rayman Legends featuring daily and weekly challenges that test your platforming prowess. Compete in timed obstacle courses, enemy gauntlet runs, and precision jumping trials across beautifully hand-drawn worlds. Each challenge offers a limited window to set your best time or score, with global leaderboards tracking the top players worldwide. Earn Lums and unlock exclusive costume rewards as you master increasingly difficult stages. The challenges refresh regularly, providing new tests of skill and offering a taste of Rayman Legends' tight controls and creative level design. Perfect for speedrunners and competitive players seeking bite-sized platforming action.

title: Resident Evil: Revelations
description: Resident Evil: Revelations is a survival horror video game developed by Capcom and originally released for the Nintendo 3DS handheld game console in 2012. Set between the Resident Evil titles Resident Evil 4 and Resident Evil 5, the game follows counter-terrorism agents Jill Valentine and Chris Redfield as they try to stop a bioterrorist organization from infecting the Earth's oceans with a virus. The game features a single-player mode where the player must complete a series of episodes that involve solving puzzles and defeating enemies, and a multiplayer mode where players may fight their way through altered single-player scenarios.

title: Revenant Saga
description: Embark on a classic turn-based JRPG adventure in Revenant Saga. After being infected by a strange weapon called a Grimoria, protagonist Albert gains powerful Revenant abilities but risks losing his humanity. Journey across diverse lands with a party of memorable allies, battling monsters and uncovering the truth behind the Grimoria curse. Strategic combat lets you transform into powerful Revenant forms during battle, unleashing devastating skills at the cost of corruption. Manage your transformation gauge carefully—power comes with consequences. Features deep character customization, challenging boss encounters, and a compelling story about sacrifice and redemption.

title: Rise of the Guardians
description: Join the legendary Guardians in an epic battle to protect the children of the world from the evil spirit Pitch Black. Play as North (Santa Claus), Tooth (Tooth Fairy), Bunnymund (Easter Bunny), Sandman, and Jack Frost, each with unique abilities and combat styles. Harness North's dual-wielding swords, Bunnymund's boomerangs, Tooth's aerial agility, Sandman's dreamsand whips, and Jack Frost's ice staff to defeat Pitch's nightmare creatures. Battle through vibrant, fantastical worlds from the DreamWorks animated film, switching between Guardians to solve puzzles and overcome challenges.

title: Rive Event Preview
description: Pilot a nimble spider tank through intense 2D platforming and 360-degree shooting action. Run, jump, and blast through hordes of mechanical enemies on land, underwater, in zero gravity, and on moving trains. Hack enemy robots to turn them against their allies by collecting and uploading special programs. This metal-wrecking shooter from Two Tribes blends classic sidescrolling gameplay with modern robot-hacking mechanics, delivering fast-paced combat across varied environments filled with mechanical mayhem. title: Rock 'N Racing - Off Road
description: A top-down arcade racer inspired by classic racing games. Race across various off-road tracks with simple two-button controls (accelerate and brake). Features Cup mode, time trials, and local multiplayer supporting up to 5 players simultaneously. The entire track is visible on screen from a bird's-eye view, creating chaotic battles for position as you navigate tight corners and compete for the finish line in retro-styled off-road racing action. Sources: - [Rock 'N Racing Off Road - Wii U - Metacritic](https://www.metacritic.com/game/rock-n-racing-off-road/) - [Rock 'N Racing Off Road Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/rock_n_racing_off_road

title: Rock 'N Racing - Off Road DX
description: Take your off-road racing to the extreme in this top-down arcade racer that channels the spirit of classic racing games. Tear through diverse terrain including desert dunes, muddy swamps, and snow-covered tracks as you compete against rivals in high-speed championship races. Choose from multiple vehicle types, each with distinct handling characteristics, and master challenging circuits filled with jumps, tight corners, and hazardous obstacles. Features both single-player championship modes and local multiplayer mayhem where you can prove your racing supremacy against friends.

title: Rock Zombie
description: Take control of three members of a rock band who must fight their way through hordes of female zombies using musical instruments as weapons. This quirky beat 'em up combines brawler action with rock music mayhem as you bash zombies with guitars and other instruments. Battle through city streets, shopping malls, and various urban environments while rescuing sexy survivors and building your fan base. Features fast-paced combo-based combat with special attacks, multiple playable characters each with unique fighting styles, and a soundtrack of rock music. Progress through increasingly challenging stages filled with zombie hordes while unlocking new moves and abilities.

title: Rodea the Sky Soldier
description: Rodea the Sky Soldier is an action-adventure game developed by Prope for the Wii and Kadokawa Gamesfor the Wii U and Nintendo 3DS. The game stars Rodea, an android who possesses the ability to fly and a "heart". These traits result in Rodea becoming a soldier in order to fulfill his promise of protecting the kingdom of Garuda, a series of islands that float in the sky, from the ground-based Naga Empire and its leader, Emperor Geardo. Although development was completed in 2011, Rodea the Sky Soldier went unreleased for four years until finally seeing a release in Japan in April 2015, and then a subsequent worldwide release in November 2015.

title: Rorrim
description: Princess Rorrim becomes trapped inside her own mirror and must escape by navigating dual-world dungeons. This unique puzzle game utilizes both the Wii U GamePad and TV simultaneously, requiring players to observe and solve challenges across the mirrored world and reality at the same time. Progress through maze-like levels by manipulating both perspectives to find the exit. The game's name—"Mirror" spelled backwards—reflects its core mechanic of navigating parallel realities to escape the enchanted looking glass.

title: Roving Rogue
description: A retro-inspired platformer with a twist: the game begins right after defeating the final boss. Play as Kurt, an adventurer who must retrace his steps through over 40 levels to recover lost memories. Master teleportation mechanics to navigate challenging stages filled with environmental hazards, including rising lava sequences. Features local co-op multiplayer support. The unique reverse-narrative structure turns traditional platforming progression on its head, though gameplay relies heavily on trial-and-error mechanics. title: Rto
description: A side-scrolling FPS survival horror game with permadeath. Command a six-man team through perilous levels where death is permanent and the odds are stacked against you. Fight through hostile environments against overwhelming enemy forces, managing your squad's survival in this unforgiving horror experience. Every decision matters as you battle to keep your team alive through multiple challenging stages. Developed by nuGAME for the Wii U eShop. description: RTO 2 is a side-scrolling first-person shooter with survival horror elements. Command a 6-man team through four intense episodes filled with hordes of enemies. Features randomly generated levels and permadeath, creating a challenging experience where every decision matters. Test your survival skills and tactical prowess as you fight to complete your mission while managing your squad against overwhelming odds in procedurally generated environments. title: Runbow
description: Runbow is a platform racing video game made originally for the Wii U and later ported to PC, New Nintendo 3DS, Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch. Runbow was developed by Canadian indie team 13AM Games as their debut title, releasing it on 27 August 2015 in North America, 3 September 2015 in Europe, and 23 October 2015 in Australasia. The game was later released in Japan on 25 November 2015, courtesy of Cross Function.

title: Runbow Deluxe
description: Race through a world where colors mean everything in this frantic multiplayer platformer. The background constantly shifts through different colors, and platforms matching that color completely disappear, transforming the level layout in real-time. Sprint, jump, and punch your way through dynamic obstacle courses while competing against up to eight friends locally or testing your skills in challenging single-player modes. The Deluxe edition packs in all DLC costumes and additional game modes including Arena battles and the cooperative Satura's Space Adventure campaign.

title: Rush
description: Guide colorful cubes through intricate 3D puzzle mazes in this unique spatial challenge. Using the Wii U GamePad's stylus, place conveyor belts, warps, stop signs, and splits to direct each cube to its matching exit point. Plan your routes carefully—cubes move simultaneously, and one wrong turn means starting over. With increasingly complex layouts that twist and turn through three-dimensional space, RUSH demands precision timing and strategic thinking. Master dozens of brain-teasing levels where quick reflexes meet clever puzzle-solving, all controlled with intuitive touchscreen placement that makes setup easy but perfection difficult. Sources: - [RUSH Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Li...

title: Santa Factory
description: Help elf Tonttu and reindeer Rudolf retrieve Santa's lost wishlists and presents in this puzzle platformer. Draw platforms and objects on the GamePad to overcome obstacles and guide characters through levels. Features 125 English vocabulary words for educational value, making it suitable for young children learning language basics. Navigate through Santa's workshop by creating paths and solving simple environmental puzzles. The game combines light platforming mechanics with educational elements designed for early learners.
