title: Scram Kitty
description: Blast through a space station overrun by mutant rodents in this high-speed action shooter that literally puts you on rails. Control a cat in a rocket-powered wheelchair as you circle around cylindrical rooms, using magnetic tracks to navigate 360-degree environments. Rescue captured cats while battling increasingly devious mice across multiple themed zones. Master the unique rail-switching mechanics to dodge enemy fire, collect power-ups, and reach secret areas. Each level demands precision timing and quick reflexes as you rotate around platforms, leap between rails, and unleash devastating weapons.

title: Scribblenauts Unlimited
description: Scribblenauts Unlimited is a puzzle sandbox video game developed by 5th Cell and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment for the Nintendo 3DS, Wii U, Microsoft Windows, iOS and Android. The game was announced during Nintendo's E3 2012 press conference on June 5, 2012. It is the fourth title in the Scribblenauts series.

title: Scribblenauts Unmasked
description: Team up with Batman, Superman, and the entire DC Comics universe in this imaginative puzzle-adventure. Use Maxwell's magical notebook to conjure any object you can think of—from everyday items to fantastical creations—to solve challenges across iconic DC locations like Gotham City, Metropolis, and Atlantis. Create custom superheroes by combining powers, abilities, and equipment from thousands of DC characters. Face off against legendary villains, help heroes complete missions, and unleash your creativity with an expanded object library featuring DC-specific items and characters.

title: SDK Spriter
description: An all-in-one retro game asset creation studio by HullBreach Studios. Design pixel art sprite sheets with eight directional animations, craft 256x256 tile-based maps, and build playable levels across three modes: Overworld, Platformer, and Terrain. Features a Dungeon Master mode for tabletop RPG sessions. Create 64x64 character sprites, tile sets, and complete game levels with layered maps and NPCs. Export creations to SDKSpriter.com to share with the community. Perfect for aspiring game developers and pixel art enthusiasts. title: Severed
description: Severed is a first-person dungeon crawler with a unique touch-based combat system. You play as Sasha, a one-armed warrior navigating a surreal nightmare world to find her missing family. Combat is visceral and precise—swipe across the touchscreen to slash enemies, targeting weak points and severing limbs to collect materials for upgrades. The game features a haunting art style with vibrant colors and grotesque creature designs. Each dungeon presents spatial puzzles and strategic battles where timing and pattern recognition are crucial. Defeat enemies to harvest their parts, upgrading Sasha's abilities and unlocking new powers.

title: Shadow Archery
description: Step into the darker realm as Shadow, a skilled archer defending against endless hordes of creatures. This retro-inspired arcade shooter combines 8-bit nostalgia with modern controls, letting you use the Wii Remote's motion aiming or GamePad touchscreen to take down enemies. With limited arrows, every shot must count as spiders and other threats swarm the screen. This shooting gallery-style game offers simple but challenging gameplay where precision and resource management are key to survival. A follow-up to Shadow Archer, this streamlined experience focuses on pure arcade action. Sources: - [Shadow Archery Is A Brand New Game For Wii U, And It Will Launch For Free | Nintendo Life](https://

title: Shadow Puppeteer
description: Master the art of light and shadow in this innovative puzzle-platformer where you simultaneously control a boy and his shadow companion. Navigate through a hauntingly beautiful world where teamwork between light and darkness is essential for survival. Solve intricate environmental puzzles by manipulating both characters—the boy exists in the physical world while his shadow operates in the shadowy realm, each with unique abilities that complement the other. Switch between characters or control both at once to overcome obstacles, outsmart enemies, and uncover the mystery behind your shadow's separation.

title: Shakedown Hawaii
description: Build a "legitimate" corporation through any means necessary in this sprawling open-world action game from the creator of Retro City Rampage. Take control of the CEO of a fledgling company and expand your business empire across multiple islands through shaking down stores, buying out competitors, and sabotaging the competition. Engage in top-down mayhem with an arsenal of weapons, commandeer vehicles, and complete over 200 story missions. Destroy property, collect protection money, and exploit every industry from coffee shops to weapons manufacturing.

title: Shantae and the Pirate's Curse
description: Shantae and the Pirate's Curse is a platform game developed by WayForward Technologies for the Nintendo 3DS and the Wii U. It is the third game in the Shantae series, following Shantae: Risky's Revenge. It was released in North America on the 3DS eShop on October 23, 2014 and on the Wii U eShop on December 25, 2014, and in PAL regions on both platforms on February 5, 2015. The game was later ported to PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Microsoft Windows, Amazon Fire TV, and Nintendo Switch. The game follows the adventures of the eponymous half-genie Shantae as she once again has to save Sequin Land from a new foe, the Pirate Master, with help from her nemesis Risky Boots.

title: Shantae: Half-Genie Hero
description: Shantae: Half-Genie Hero, stylized as Shantae: ½ Genie Hero, is a platform video game developed by WayForward Technologies for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Wii U, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch. It is the fourth game in the Shantae series, following Shantae and the Pirate's Curse, and the first to be specifically developed for high definition game platforms. The game was released for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Wii U, and Xbox One in December 2016, and for Nintendo Switch the following June.

title: Shantae: Risky's Revenge - Director's Cut
description: Shantae: Risky's Revenge is a platform video game developed by WayForward Technologies for Nintendo DSi. The second installment in the Shantae series, Risky's Revenge is sequel to the Game Boy Color video game Shantae and is succeeded by the Nintendo 3DS and Wii U sequel Shantae and the Pirate's Curse, and the fourth installment Shantae: Half-Genie Hero. An iOS port was made and released on October 27, 2011 and features a new "Magic Mode".

title: Shiftlings
description: Shiftlings is a quirky co-op puzzle-platformer where you control two goofy alien janitors connected by a shared air hose. After one of them gulps down a fizzy drink during a live TV show, their spacesuits become linked in the most unusual way—inflate one, deflate the other! Use this bizarre connection to solve over 50 increasingly devious levels across five alien worlds. Switch between the inflated and normal-sized Shiftlings to press switches, bounce to high platforms, and navigate deadly hazards. Play solo by swapping between both characters or team up with a friend in local co-op.

title: Shiny the Firefly
description: Guide Shiny, a brave firefly, through a beautifully hand-drawn world filled with danger and wonder. Navigate lush environments as you search for your missing children, who've been captured by malevolent creatures. Use Shiny's ability to glow and illuminate dark passages, stunning enemies and revealing hidden paths. Dodge predators, solve environmental puzzles, and master precise platforming across vibrant gardens, murky swamps, and treacherous underground caverns. The game features physics-based challenges where timing and careful movement are essential to survival.

title: Shoot the Ball
description: A minimalist touch-screen arcade game where you tap to shoot the ball through openings in moving shapes. Each shape moves at randomly assigned speeds and colors, creating escalating difficulty as you chase high scores. Use the Wii U GamePad's touch screen to time your shots perfectly and rack up points. Simple to learn but challenging to master, this score-attack game tests your reflexes and timing. Challenge friends and family to beat your best session score in this quick-play eShop title from RCMADIAX. title: Shooting Range
description: A carnival-style shooting gallery designed for younger players. Test your marksmanship skills against the clock as you progress through multiple timed levels. Starting in a carnival tent, hit as many stationary and moving targets as possible before time runs out. Later levels expand beyond the tent with increasingly challenging target layouts. Compete for high scores as you improve your accuracy and speed in this family-friendly eShop shooter that brings the classic fairground experience to the Wii U GamePad. title: Shooty Space
description: A vertical scrolling shooter where you blast through endless waves of enemies to rack up high scores. Face basic enemies worth 1 point and tougher orange foes worth 10 points. Every 100 points triggers a boss battle for a trophy. Features Off-TV play on the GamePad or 1080p HD display on your TV. Simple, arcade-style action focused on score chasing and survival.

title: Shovel Knight
description: Shovel Knight is a 2D side-scrolling platform game developed and published by Yacht Club Games. Following a successful Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign,the game was released for Microsoft Windows, Nintendo 3DS and Wii U in June 2014. The game was ported to OS X and Linux in September 2014, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita and Xbox One in April 2015, Amazon Fire TV in September 2015, and Nintendo Switch in March 2017. Shovel Knight is inspired by game play and graphics of platformer games developed for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

title: Shut the Box
description: A digital adaptation of the classic dice-and-tile board game. Roll two dice and strategically eliminate numbered tiles from three stacked layers that match your roll. Each layer alternates direction, and you must clear upper tiles before accessing those below. Test your luck and calculation skills as you aim for the highest score by clearing as many tiles as possible before running out of valid moves in this simple yet addictive puzzle challenge.

title: Silver Falls Undertakers
description: Explore the mysterious town of Silver Falls in this retro-styled horror adventure featuring dual game modes. Game A offers open-world story-driven exploration set in the 1970s, where young Bull Brandish encounters terrifying black creatures called Undertakers while camping. Game B delivers roguelike action, letting you fight back against hordes of monsters with weapons and bonuses earned from the story mode. Rendered in Atari 2600-inspired graphics, this atmospheric title blends classic top-down gameplay with survival horror elements across two distinct experiences. Sources: - [Silver Falls – Undertakers for Wii U – Silver Falls](http://silverfallsgame.com/undertakerswiiu/) - [Silver Falls:

title: Silver Falls White Inside Its Umbra
Sing Party
description: Sing Party transforms your living room into a karaoke stage with a unique twist on the music game formula. Using the Wii U GamePad as a wireless microphone and lyric display, you can perform over 50 popular songs while your friends and family watch the TV screen filled with energetic visuals and synchronized lyrics. The GamePad holder becomes the star performer, free to move around the room without being tethered to the TV. Party Mode creates a dynamic social experience where the audience can join in on choruses, while various game modes challenge you to match pitch and rhythm.

title: Skeasy
description: Guide your skier down the endless slopes of the White Mountains in this minimalist high-score chaser. Use the D-Pad to weave left and right, dodging trees as you descend through a winter wonderland. The longer you survive, the higher your score climbs. Simple controls meet addictive gameplay in this quick-play arcade experience designed for short bursts of competitive fun. Challenge yourself to beat your personal best as the mountain grows increasingly treacherous with each passing second. title: Sky Force Anniversary
description: Sky Force Anniversary revitalizes the classic vertical scrolling shooter with stunning modern visuals and addictive arcade gameplay. Command your aircraft through increasingly challenging stages filled with enemy formations, massive war machines, and screen-filling bosses. Rescue stranded operatives, collect stars to upgrade your weaponry, and master multiple difficulty modes that dramatically transform each mission. The game rewards both aggressive high-score chasers and completionists who seek to rescue every survivor and destroy every target.

title: Skylanders Giants
description: Skylanders: Giants is a 2012 video game in the Skylanders series, a direct sequel to the 2011 game Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure and features the voices of Kevin Michael Richardson, Greg Ellis, Peter Lurie, Steve Blum, Dave Wittenberg, Carlos Alazraqui, Kevin Sorbo, Bobcat Goldthwait, Patrick Seitz and Julie Nathanson. It is the game before Skylanders: Swap Force. As the title suggests, it features larger Skylanders known as "Giants", along with other new gameplay mechanics.

title: Skylanders Imaginators
description: Unleash your creativity in the ultimate Skylanders adventure where you create your own Skylander hero from scratch. Choose from ten Battle Classes including Knight, Sorcerer, Bowslinger, and Brawler, then customize everything from powers to appearance with billions of possible combinations. Battle the sinister Kaos and his Doomlanders as they attempt to rule over Skylands using a powerful ancient weapon. Switch between your custom Imaginators and classic Skylanders heroes, upgrade abilities, and take on enemies across diverse worlds filled with puzzles, platforming challenges, and epic boss battles.

title: Skylanders SuperChargers
description: Rev up for high-speed adventure in Skylanders SuperChargers, where portal masters take control of powerful vehicles alongside their Skylander heroes. Race across land, sea, and sky in supercharged vehicles, each with unique weapons and abilities. Battle Kaos and his minions through dynamic levels that blend on-foot combat with thrilling vehicular action. Customize and upgrade your SuperChargers and their signature vehicles, unlocking devastating combo attacks. Experience split-screen racing, challenge modes, and an epic story campaign.

title: Skylanders Swap Force
description: Skylanders: Swap Forceis a platformer video game developed by Vicarious Visions and published by Activision. It is the third main game in the Skylanders video game and toy franchise, following 2012's Skylanders: Giants, which was a direct sequelto 2011's Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure (the spin-off of The Legend of Spyro series). It is the game before Skylanders: Trap Team and features the voices of John DiMaggio, Jess Harnell, Audrey Wasilewski, Richard Tatum, David Sobolov, Josh Keaton, Keythe Farley, Dave Wittenberg, Joey Camen, Gregg Berger, Troy Baker, Robin Atkin Downes, and Matthew Yang King.

title: Skylanders Trap Team
description: Skylanders: Trap Team is an action 3D platformer video game developed by Toys for Bob and published by Activision. It is the fourth instalment in the Skylanders video game franchise and was released on October 2, 2014 in Australasia, October 5, 2014 in North America, and October 10, 2014 in Europe, for release on Android, Fire OS and iOS mobile platforms, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Wii, Wii U, Xbox 360, Xbox One, and Nintendo 3DS. It is the sequel to Skylanders: Swap Force, with the voices of Fred Tatasciore, Billy West, John DiMaggio, Matthew Moy, Laura Bailey, Alex Ness, John Paul Karliak, Matthew Yang King, and Richard Horvitz.

title: Slender the Arrival
description: Experience pure psychological terror in this first-person horror game that reimagines the infamous Slender Man myth. Navigate through eerie forests, abandoned buildings, and forgotten mining facilities while pursued by an otherworldly entity that grows stronger the more you observe it. Armed only with a flashlight and camcorder, you must collect scattered pages and solve environmental puzzles while managing your fear and avoiding direct contact with the faceless horror stalking you. The Wii U version includes enhanced lighting effects and GamePad integration for reviewing found footage.

title: Slots - Pharaoh's Riches
description: Step into an ancient Egyptian-themed casino with this slot machine simulator designed for the Wii U GamePad. Spin the reels with adjustable line bets and wagers per line, aiming for jackpots and bonus rounds. Features a realistic pay-table modeled after real casino slots, a gamble mini-game to double your winnings, and an interactive pyramid bonus game. Experience authentic slot machine gameplay with flashy lights, sound effects, and multiple betting options, all from the comfort of your GamePad screen. Sources: - [Slots - Pharaoh's Riches for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/slots-pharaohs-riches-wii-u/) - [Slots - Pharaoh's Riches Review (Wii U eShop) |

title: Sniper Elite V2
description: Experience the tension of World War II stealth sniping in this tactical shooter set during the Battle of Berlin. As elite marksman Karl Fairburne, you must prevent Nazi V2 rocket technology from falling into Soviet hands. Master authentic sniper tactics including ballistic calculations, wind adjustment, and held breath for the perfect shot. The game's signature X-ray kill cam delivers visceral slow-motion replays showing bullet trajectories and devastating skeletal damage. Navigate bombed-out urban environments, taking strategic high-ground positions while evading or eliminating patrols. Every shot counts with limited ammunition and eagle-eyed enemies.

title: Solitaire
description: Arrange cards from Ace to King in this digital adaptation of the classic card game. Features the three most popular solitaire game modes, offering a traditional brain-teaser that requires concentration and strategic thinking. Compete for high scores as you solve each puzzle layout. A straightforward implementation of the timeless single-player card game optimized for the Wii U GamePad, bringing the familiar tabletop experience to the console with simple, intuitive controls and clean presentation. title: Sonic & All-Stars Racing Transformed
description: Sonic & All-Stars Racing Transformed is a kart racing video game developed by Sumo Digital and published by Sega. It was released for the PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Wii U in November 2012, for PlayStation Vita in December 2012, for Microsoft Windows in January 2013, for Nintendo 3DS in February 2013, and for iOS and Android in January 2014. The PS3 and Wii U versions of the game were released in Japan on May 15, 2014.

title: Sonic Boom: Rise of Lyric
description: Sonic Boom: Rise of Lyric is an action-adventure video game developed by Big Red Button and published by Sega for the Wii U console. Along with Sonic Boom: Shattered Crystal for the Nintendo 3DS, the game is a spin-off of Sega's Sonic the Hedgehog series and is a part of the Sonic Boom franchise, which also consists of an animated television series (whose games serve as prequel), a comic series by Archie Comics, and a toyline by Tomy.

title: Sonic: Lost World
description: Sonic Lost World is an action-adventure platform game developed by Sonic Team. It is part of the Sonic the Hedgehog series, and was released in October 2013 for the Wii U and Nintendo 3DS in PAL regions by Nintendo and by Sega in North America and Japan. A port for Microsoft Windows was later released in November 2015.

title: Soon Shine
description: Play as the sun and moon—two sides of a mystical mask—to defend against mischievous spirits in this fast-paced action puzzle game. Tap spirits to squash them and swipe to flip between sun and moon modes. The sun vanquishes dark spirits while stopping bright ones, and vice versa for the moon. Master simple stylus controls on the GamePad touchscreen, then build killer combos through speed and strategy. Features various play modes, unlockable items, and dynamic backdrops with music tracks to keep the frantic gameplay fresh. Character count: 598

title: Soul Axiom
description: Soul Axiom is a first-person psychological thriller and puzzle adventure set within Elysia, a massive digital afterlife where human souls are uploaded and preserved. Explore a mysterious world filled with diverse environments—from ancient temples to futuristic cities—each containing intricate puzzles that manipulate reality itself. Wield supernatural hand powers to phase objects in and out of existence, interact with the environment, and uncover the dark secrets behind this supposed paradise. As you piece together fragmented memories, discover what happened to a lost soul and expose the sinister truth lurking beneath Elysia's pristine surface.

title: Space Hulk
description: Command a squad of Space Marine Terminators through the claustrophobic corridors of a derelict space hulk infested with Genestealers. Based on Games Workshop's classic board game, this turn-based tactical experience drops you into the Warhammer 40,000 universe where every decision matters. Position your heavily-armored troops, manage limited action points, and make split-second choices as deadly aliens lurk around every corner. The cramped passages and tense atmosphere create a brutal game of cat and mouse where one wrong move means death. Features single-player campaign missions following the Blood Angels chapter as they cleanse the Sin of Damnation.

title: Space Hunted
description: Play as Jade Hunter, an intergalactic treasure hunter stranded on an uncharted alien planet after being shot down. Survive across 128 NES-inspired platforming levels while being hunted by hostile forces. Jump between platforms, collect purple stars to boost your score, and dodge deadly hazards including gun-wielding aliens and moving obstacles. Navigate each stage to find your escape route off this dangerous world. Developed by Ultra Dolphin Revolution for the Wii U eShop, this retro-styled arcade platformer delivers straightforward challenge at a budget price. title: Space Hunted - The Lost Levels
description: Play as Jade Hunter, an intergalactic treasure hunter stranded on an uncharted planet after your ship is shot down. Hunted as an alien intruder, you must survive hostile forces and escape. This challenging arcade-style action-platformer features 128 new levels packed with deadly obstacles, traps, and enemies. Navigate NES-inspired 2D gameplay reminiscent of Metroid and Kid Icarus, featuring brand new items and hazards designed to test your platforming skills. A more difficult version of the original Space Hunted, exclusively for Wii U.

title: Space Intervention
description: Defend the galaxy from invading alien forces in this Space Invaders-inspired shooter. Battle through waves of four different alien species, forty enemies per round, as you blast your way through increasingly challenging formations. Face off against standard troops and giant alien threats in classic arcade action. Navigate simple but engaging shoot-'em-up gameplay as humanity's last line of defense against extraterrestrial invasion. A nostalgic throwback to retro arcade gaming on the Wii U platform. title: Spellcaster's Assistant
description: Play as Emmy Epheremelda, a sorcerer's apprentice left in charge when mischievous Tomeverme creatures wreak havoc in the magical library. Use magical tomes to cast unique spells and defeat enemies while organizing books back onto their proper shelves. Navigate over 30 levels with varied challenges, including stages with aggressive enemies where lightning bolt power-ups grant enhanced speed. This 8-bit styled arcade action game combines spellcasting combat with score-based gameplay as you restore order to the enchanted library. title: SphereZor
description: Control colorful smiley-faced spheres through 70 challenging levels inspired by classic '80s arcade games. Collect glowing purple pickups while dodging deadly TriZor enemies across increasingly difficult stages. Features local multiplayer for up to 5 players, letting you battle it out with friends. Simple controls mask challenging gameplay that tests your reflexes and timing. Navigate maze-like levels where precision and quick thinking are essential to help SphereZor and SphereZora escape. A nostalgic throwback to retro arcade action on the Wii U eShop. title: Spheroids
description: Navigate a vibrant 2D world where gravity-defying spheroids have invaded Earth, and only you can stop them. Armed with a modified selfie stick that doubles as a versatile weapon, dash, jump, and hook your way through 32 colorful levels across diverse environments. Use your unique tool to latch onto surfaces, swing across gaps, and pop the bouncing spheroid enemies that threaten humanity. Master precise platforming mechanics while collecting powerups and discovering secrets hidden throughout each stage. With its quirky premise, smooth controls, and increasingly challenging level design, Spheroids delivers accessible yet demanding action-platforming that rewards skillful movement and timing.

title: Spin the Bottle Bumpie's Party
description: Spin the Bottle: Bumpie's Party transforms your living room into a multiplayer playground where the GamePad stays put and players become the controllers. This quirky party game ditches traditional button-mashing for physical challenges that get everyone moving, laughing, and interacting face-to-face. Guide the adorable Bumpies through a series of bizarre mini-games by passing the GamePad, striking poses, making sound effects, and performing silly actions with friends. With its innovative "pass-the-GamePad" mechanics and focus on real-world social interaction, this Wii U exclusive celebrates the awkward, hilarious moments that make party games memorable.

title: Splashy Duck
description: Guide a duck endlessly swimming through a vertical channel, collecting gold coins while avoiding evil whales. The duck never stops moving, but hitting A makes it pull a 180-degree turn to swim back the way it came. This simple score attack game challenges players to master timing and quick direction changes to maximize their coin collection. Playable off-TV on the GamePad or on TV in 1080p HD, this eShop title from RCMADIAX offers straightforward arcade action focused on beating high scores through precise maneuvering in tight spaces. title: Splatoon
description: Splatoon is a third-person shooter video game developed and published by Nintendo for the Wii U, which was released worldwide in May 2015. The game centers around characters known as Inklings—anthropomorphic squid that can transform between humanoid and cephalopod forms, and hide or swim through colored ink sprayed on surfaces using gun-, bucket-, roller-, or brush-like weapons. Splatoon features several game modes, including four-on-four online multiplayer, and a single player campaign.

title: Splatoon - Testfire
description: Splatoon - Testfire was a limited-time demo that gave players their first taste of Nintendo's innovative ink-based shooter before the full game's launch. Jump into frantic 4v4 Turf War battles where victory depends on covering the most ground in your team's ink. Choose from multiple weapon types including rapid-fire shooters, long-range chargers, and wide-coverage rollers, each offering unique playstyles. Swim through your own colored ink to move quickly, refill ammunition, and set up ambushes. The demo featured rotating time slots and limited map selection, creating exciting windows of competition that drew millions of players worldwide.

title: Splinter Cell Blacklist
description: Step into the boots of Sam Fisher as he leads Fourth Echelon against a deadly terrorist group called The Engineers. This stealth-action masterpiece puts you in control—ghost through missions unseen, execute precision takedowns, or go loud with aggressive tactics. The choice is yours. Utilize the GamePad's touchscreen for strategic map viewing and gadget management while navigating diverse global locations. Upgrade your arsenal with cutting-edge tech, customize your playstyle, and tackle missions solo or team up in co-op modes. With its refined mark-and-execute system and multiple approach options, Blacklist delivers intense espionage action where every decision matters.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants Plankton's Robotic Revenge
description: Join SpongeBob, Patrick, Squidward, Sandy, and Mr. Krabs in a cooperative adventure to stop Plankton's army of mechanical menaces. When Plankton's latest scheme unleashes hordes of robots across Bikini Bottom, it's up to you and your friends to battle through wave after wave of metallic mayhem. Harness each character's unique abilities and special moves to defeat enemies, solve puzzles, and save the day. Team up with friends in local co-op multiplayer, combining powers to unleash devastating attacks. Explore iconic locations from the series, collect coins to upgrade your abilities, and unlock new costumes and power-ups as you progress through the story.

title: Sportsball
description: Sportsball is a chaotic competitive sports game that combines elements of basketball, football, and jousting into one frantic multiplayer experience. Play as a bird riding atop various creatures as you attempt to grab the ball and score goals while knocking opponents off their mounts. The fast-paced action supports up to four players in local multiplayer matches filled with power-ups, environmental hazards, and unpredictable physics. Master the art of timing your jumps, positioning your mount, and executing devastating tackles to dominate the arena.

title: Spy Chameleon
description: Master the art of camouflage in this colorful stealth-action game where you control a high-tech spy chameleon on a mission to stop a sinister conspiracy. Blend into vibrant backgrounds by matching your color to the environment, carefully timing your movements to avoid detection by security cameras, guards, and other hazards. Navigate through 75 challenging missions across five distinct locations, using your color-changing abilities to sneak past enemies and reach the exit. Collect flies for bonus points and compete for the best times.

title: Squids Odyssey
description: Dive into a colorful underwater adventure where you command a team of heroic squids in turn-based tactical battles. Squids Odyssey combines the original Squids and Squids Wild West into one complete package, featuring over 90 levels of strategic gameplay. Use your squids' unique abilities to slingshot them across the battlefield, knock enemies into hazards, and execute clever combo attacks. Customize your four-squid squad by collecting loot, equipping helmets and weapons, and leveling up their skills. Battle corrupted sea creatures controlled by a mysterious black ooze in a charming story filled with humor and personality.

title: Star Fox Guard
description: Star Fox Guard is a tower defense video game co-developed by Nintendoand PlatinumGames for the Wii U. The game was bundled as a separate disc for the first print edition of Star Fox Zero during its release in April 2016, and as a digital download code on the Wii U eShop afterwards.

title: Star Fox Guard (Demo)
description: Star Fox Guard puts you in charge of defending precious metal supplies from waves of invading robots. Monitor a dozen security cameras simultaneously as mechanical enemies approach from multiple angles, switching between viewpoints to target and blast threats before they breach your defenses. Each robot type exhibits unique behaviors and attack patterns, requiring quick thinking and strategic camera placement. Slippy Toad's uncle Grippy needs your help protecting his mining operations across the Lylat system. Balance surveillance across your multi-screen setup, identify priority targets, and rotate between cameras to eliminate danger.

title: Star Fox Zero
description: Star Fox Zero is a 3D scrolling shooter video game developed by Nintendo and PlatinumGames for the Wii U. It is the sixth installment in the Star Fox series. After a delay from November 2015, the game was released worldwide in April 2016 to mixed reception. A standalone tower defense game, titled Star Fox Guard, was bundled with the game.

title: Star Fox Zero the Battle Begins + Training
description: Experience the animated short "The Battle Begins" produced by Wit Studio, then master your combat skills in this free promotional demo. Train with the versatile Arwing jet featuring Walker transformation, the stealth-focused Gyrowing flight drone, and the ground-assault Landmaster tank. Learn advanced maneuvers and dual-screen GamePad controls as you prepare to defend the Lylat system. This training experience offers hands-on preparation for the full Star Fox Zero adventure, combining cinematic storytelling with interactive tutorials. Sources: - [Star Fox Zero: The Battle Begins + Training Is Now Available On The North American Wii U eShop - My Nintendo News](https://mynintendonews.com/2016

title: Star Ghost
description: Pilot the Star Ghost through hostile alien territory in this pulse-pounding side-scrolling shooter. Your ship automatically fires, but survival depends on precise movement and strategic use of your momentum-reversing boost ability. Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with deadly enemies, treacherous obstacles, and challenging boss encounters. The unique control scheme creates a hypnotic rhythm as you weave through danger, collecting power-ups and upgrades to enhance your vessel. With its distinctive visual style featuring stark contrasts and neon highlights, Star Ghost delivers an intense arcade experience that's easy to learn but brutally difficult to master.

title: Star Sky
description: A contemplative exploration game designed as an interactive poem beneath a starlit sky. Walk or run through a serene nighttime landscape, encountering events that unfold based on your timing and choices. Each playthrough reveals different scenarios from eighteen possible encounters, leading to multiple endings. The minimalist experience prioritizes atmosphere and reflection over traditional gameplay, inviting players to discover meaning through quiet observation and subtle decision-making as they journey toward the horizon. Sources: - [Star Sky (2015) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/star_sky) - [Star Sky (Wii U eShop)- Review – Seafoam Gamin

title: Star Sky 2
description: A meditative walking experience where you stroll through atmospheric nighttime landscapes at your own pace. Using just a single button, move forward and pause to trigger mysterious events when specific conditions are met. Multiple paths and choices lead to different consequences across short five-minute journeys. An improved hint system provides visual clues to unlock events. From creator Marten Jonsson, this sequel expands on the original's contemplative gameplay with more meaningful choices and atmospheric storytelling. Sources: - [Star Sky 2 Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/star_sky_2) - [Star Sky 2 | Wii U download software | Games |

title: Star Splash Shattered Star
description: Guide a courageous dolphin through over 30 challenging levels to collect shattered pieces of the Mother Star and save the planet from evil. Swim through seas, leap high into the air, and dive at breakneck speeds using precise, well-timed acrobatics. Master the d-pad controls to navigate fast-scrolling environments and gather stars across increasingly difficult stages. Features competitive 2-player mode for racing against friends. A budget indie eShop title from Snails Arcade with simplistic visuals but demanding platforming action.

title: Star Wars Pinball
description: Experience the Star Wars universe through classic pinball action. This collection features multiple themed tables, each dedicated to iconic moments and characters from the saga. Battle the Empire on the Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back table, navigate the forest moon on the Return of the Jedi table, or take on Boba Fett and other bounty hunters. Each table features authentic sound effects, voice clips, and music from the films, along with detailed 3D models and dynamic missions that recreate memorable scenes. Complete objectives, trigger multiball modes, and climb the leaderboards while immersing yourself in pinball tables that capture the excitement of a galaxy far, far away.

title: Starwhal
description: Engage in chaotic local multiplayer combat as a space narwhal wielding a deadly piercing horn. In this physics-based party game, up to four players flop, flip, and flounder through zero-gravity arenas, attempting to stab opponents' glowing hearts while protecting their own. Master momentum-based movement as you gracefully (or clumsily) navigate asteroid fields, disco dance floors, and other bizarre cosmic battlegrounds. Customize your narwhal with unlockable costumes and accessories, then challenge friends in frantic matches where precision, timing, and a bit of luck determine victory.

title: Stealth Inc 2 - A Game of Clones
description: Break into a sinister corporation's testing facility as a test clone in this puzzle-platformer sequel that expands beyond the confined test chambers. Explore a massive Metroidvania-style overworld filled with secrets while tackling brain-bending stealth challenges in dedicated test rooms. Use shadows to hide from deadly security systems, solve intricate environmental puzzles, and unlock new gadgets to access previously unreachable areas. The Wii U GamePad serves as your clone creation tool, letting you build and share custom test chambers while seamlessly managing your equipment.

title: SteamWorld Dig
description: SteamWorld Dig is a platform action-adventure game created by Swedish video game developer Image & Form. The second instalment in the SteamWorld series and the sequel to SteamWorld Tower Defense,SteamWorld Dig has the player control Rusty, a steam-powered robot who arrives at a small Western mining town called Tumbleton after having received a deed for a mine from his long-forgotten uncle, Joe. The objective of the game is to dig through Tumbleton's mine, which also involves solving puzzles and platforming to avoid traps and enemies.

title: SteamWorld Heist
description: Command a ragtag crew of steam-powered robots in this side-scrolling turn-based strategy shooter. As Captain Piper Faraday, assemble your team and take on dangerous missions across a procedurally generated galaxy. Master the art of ricochet shots, bouncing bullets off walls and ceilings to take out enemies hiding behind cover. Customize your crew with an arsenal of weapons, utilities, and hats that provide unique abilities. Each mission offers tense tactical combat where positioning and angles matter as much as firepower.

title: Steel Lords
description: A hybrid strategy-fighting game where the factions of Light and Dark clash in board game-style combat. Command your chosen faction by strategically moving tiles across the battlefield. When opposing tiles collide, the game shifts into one-on-one fighting sequences between characters. Eliminate enemy tiles one by one until you can challenge the opposing lord in a final battle for victory. Features single-player AI battles and local multiplayer, with off-TV Play support on the GamePad. Sources: - [STEEL LORDS for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/steel-lords-wii-u/) - [STEEL LORDS (2016) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/

title: Stick It to the Man
description: Step into the mind of Ray, a hard-hat tester who gains psychic powers after a bizarre accident. Armed with a giant pink spaghetti arm sprouting from your brain, read people's thoughts, tear through the papery world, and solve mind-bending puzzles in this uniquely twisted adventure. Swing across chasms using mental staples, possess enemies to infiltrate restricted areas, and peel back layers of reality to discover hidden paths. The handcrafted art style brings a storybook world to life with dark humor and quirky characters at every turn. Use telepathy to uncover secrets, manipulate objects from afar, and outsmart the sinister agents hunting you down.

title: SturmFront - The Mutant War Übel Edition
description: Battle through relentless mutant hordes as Siegfried von Hammerstein, a semi-organic cyborg designed for destruction. This top-down arcade shooter blends Commando-style action with bullet hell intensity. Wield your flamethrower to incinerate enemies and convert their bullets into collectible gems. Face five unique bosses, uncover hidden souls to reveal the war's origins, and survive the apocalypse of 1984 to a soundtrack of heavy metal and psychedelic electronica. Classic twin-stick shooting with handcrafted pixel art. Sources: - [SturmFront - The Mutant War: Übel Edition Is Actually Coming To Wii U eShop | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2021/05/sturmfront_-_the_mutant_war

title: Sudoku Party
description: Features 1,000 exclusive puzzles by Conceptis across four difficulty levels. Solve puzzles solo or cooperatively with drop-in/drop-out local co-op. Party Mode transforms classic sudoku into fast-paced competitive action where players race to claim squares—match your opponent's move in seconds or lose it forever. Supports multiple controller types for flexible multiplayer gameplay. Perfect for both traditional puzzle enthusiasts and competitive gamers seeking quick-thinking challenges. Sources: - [Sudoku Party for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/sudoku-party-wii-u/) - [Sudoku Party: details, pricing, and footage – Perfectly Nintendo](https://www.perfectly

title: Super Destronaut
description: Battle waves of alien invaders in this modern Space Invaders tribute for the Wii U eShop. Move left and right to dodge enemy fire while unleashing your arsenal on descending extraterrestrial forces. Collect power-ups to unleash devastating weapons including rockets, bombs, and multi-row lasers. Choose Classic mode to survive three lives against endless waves, Time Attack to race against the clock, or Multiplayer to compete with friends. Polished presentation and accessible gameplay make this budget shooter a worthy eShop addition. Sources: - [Super Destronaut for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/super-destronaut-wii-u/) - [Super Destronaut Review - Review

title: Super Mario 3D World
description: Super Mario 3D World is a platform video game in the Super Mario series developed and published by Nintendo for their Wii U home video game console. It is the sixth original 3D platform game in the series and the sequel to the 2011 Nintendo 3DS game Super Mario 3D Land. The game follows Mario and friends attempting to rescue fairy-like creatures called Sprixies from Bowser, who invades the realm known as the Sprixie Kingdom. The gameplay is similar to previous instalments of the series, with players passing through individual levels to reach Bowser.

title: Super Mario Maker
description: Super Mario Maker is a side-scrolling platform game and game creation system developed and published by Nintendo for the Wii U home video game console, which released worldwide in September 2015. Players are able to create and play their own custom courses, based on Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 3, Super Mario World and New Super Mario Bros. U, share them online, and download and play courses designed by other players.

title: Super Meat Boy
description: Guide a small, skinless boy through brutally difficult platforming challenges to rescue his girlfriend, Bandage Girl, from the evil Dr. Fetus. This super-tough precision platformer demands pixel-perfect jumps, wall-climbing mastery, and lightning-fast reflexes as you navigate through hundreds of hazard-filled levels. Each stage is a bite-sized test of skill packed with saw blades, salt pools, missiles, and countless other creative ways to explode into chunks of meat. Die hundreds of times—it's part of the fun—and watch instant replays showing all your failed attempts simultaneously.

title: Super Robo Mouse
description: Navigate deadly mazes as a robotic mouse captured by the evil BOLTZ CLAN. Collect titanium cheese scattered throughout hazardous trap-filled levels to unlock the exit and escape. Face over 20 challenging courses across 3 different worlds, each filled with dangerous obstacles and precision platforming. Use the GamePad to track your cheese collection progress as you guide ROBO through increasingly complex labyrinths. Every mistake sends you back to the start, making careful planning and quick reflexes essential for survival in this demanding eShop exclusive. Sources: - [SUPER ROBO MOUSE Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/super_robo_mouse) - [

title: Super Smash Bros. for Wii U
description: At E3 2011, it was confirmed that a fourth Super Smash Bros.game would be coming to the Nintendo 3DS and Wii U, with the two games being cross-compatible with each other. Sakurai stated that the announcement was made public in order to attract developers needed for the games, as development for the games did not start until May 2012 due to production on Kid Icarus: Uprising. On June 21, 2012, Nintendo announced that the creation of the games would be a co-production between Sakurai's Sora Ltd. and Bandai Namco Entertainment. The games were officially revealed at E3 2013, with new information being released via trailers, Nintendo Direct presentations, and developer posts on Miiverse.

title: Super Toy Cars
description: Race miniature toy cars through oversized household environments in this arcade racing game. Speed across kitchen tables, bedroom floors, and other domestic tracks where everyday objects become massive obstacles and ramps. Choose from multiple toy vehicles, each with unique handling characteristics, and compete in various race modes including circuit races, time trials, and elimination challenges. Use power-ups strategically to gain advantages over opponents, from speed boosts to weapons that can knock rivals off course. The game features colorful, playful graphics that emphasize the toy-scale perspective, making familiar household items feel like an entirely new racing playground.

title: Super Ultra Star Shooter
description: Play as Vau Woah, an intergalactic fighter pilot who receives a distress signal from a dangerous planet during lunch time, sparking an cosmic quest for food. Battle through endless levels of space combat, collect power-ups to defeat enemy ships, and gather burgers and fries while chasing high scores. This arcade-style vertical shooter features straightforward controls and supports multiple controller options including the Wii U GamePad and Pro Controller. Sources: - [Mini-Review: Super Ultra Star Shooter (Wii U eShop)](https://purenintendo.com/super-ultra-star-shooter/) - [Super Ultra Star Shooter | Wii U download software | Games | Nintendo UK](https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Wii-U-do

title: Surfin' Sam
description: Run, jump, and surf through over 30 levels as Sam and his sidekick Flip Flops the beach dog. Battle against Prong and the invading Aqualites, an alien race of aquatic creatures threatening to terraform Earth into their own underwater world. Navigate obstacles, collect items, and take down enemies across varied environments. Originally a mobile title, this side-scrolling adventure brings casual platforming action to the Wii U eShop with simple controls and colorful graphics. Sources: - [Surfin' Sam - Attack of the Aqualites Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/surfin_sam_-_attack_of_the_aqualites) - [Surfin' Sam - Attack of the Aqualites (2016

title: Suspension Railroad Simulator
description: Drive the historic Wuppertal Suspension Railroad, a unique elevated rail system that has served Germany's Wuppertal since 1901. Control an authentic suspension train using realistic physics and original control panels to manage speed, brakes, doors, lights, and wipers. Navigate the complete original route featuring all 20 stations and detailed recreations of prominent Wuppertal landmarks. Experience the daily operation of this one-of-a-kind transportation system that carries over 82,000 passengers per day along the Wupper River valley. Sources: - [Suspension Railroad Simulator for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/suspension-railroad-simulator-wii-u/) - [S

title: Swords & Soldiers
description: Command your army in this fast-paced side-scrolling strategy game that blends real-time tactics with accessible gameplay. Choose from three distinct civilizations—Vikings, Aztecs, or Chinese—each with unique units, abilities, and playstyles. Build your economy by gathering gold and mana, then unleash devastating combinations of soldiers, spells, and special powers against your opponents. Battle through a humorous campaign filled with quirky characters and escalating challenges, or face off against friends in local multiplayer. The streamlined controls make complex strategy feel intuitive as you balance resource management with tactical timing.

title: Swords & Soldiers II
description: Command your armies in this fast-paced side-scrolling real-time strategy game that puts you in control of three diverse factions: Vikings, Persians, and Demons. Build up your forces, gather resources, and deploy units across a 2D battlefield where quick thinking and strategic timing are essential. Master unique faction abilities, unleash devastating special attacks, and outmaneuver your opponents in frantic multiplayer battles or challenge yourself through an extensive single-player campaign filled with humor and charm.

title: Tachyon Project
description: Tachyon Project is a dual-stick shooter that thrusts you into intense arena combat against waves of geometric enemies. Guide your triangular ship through ten challenging levels, each presenting unique tactical scenarios that demand precision aim and smart positioning. The game features a compelling narrative told through intercepted computer messages as you uncover the mystery behind a deadly virus. Customize your loadout with over twenty different weapons and special abilities, from devastating lasers to defensive shields. Face off against ten distinct bosses, each requiring different strategies to defeat.

title: Tadpole Treble
description: Swim through a melodious adventure as Tadpole, a young pollywog who must navigate treacherous streams in this unique rhythm-based side-scroller. Each level is composed to its own original song, challenging you to dodge predators, leap over obstacles, and ride the current in perfect sync with the music. The innovative composition mode lets you create your own musical stages to share. With hand-drawn artwork that brings the underwater world to life and boss battles that test your rhythmic reflexes, Tadpole Treble transforms a perilous journey home into a captivating musical experience where every movement flows to the beat.

title: Tallowmere
description: Venture into the depths of Lady Tallowmere's ever-changing dungeon in this brutal 2D roguelike platformer. Armed with your weapon of choice, battle through randomly generated rooms filled with deadly traps, spikes, and hostile creatures. Each run presents new challenges as the dungeon layout shifts, forcing you to adapt your strategy on the fly. Collect souls to upgrade your equipment, discover powerful items, and test your skills against increasingly difficult enemies. Death is permanent, but persistence is rewarded as you learn enemy patterns and master the tight controls.

title: Tank! Tank! Tank!
description: Tank! Tank! Tank is an action video game released in arcades in 2009 and for Nintendo's Wii U in North America and PAL Regions in November 2012 and in Japan the following December.

title: Tap Tap Arcade
description: A budget compilation package featuring two simple arcade games. DON'T CRASH challenges you to quickly change lanes while driving to avoid obstacles in this fast-paced reflex test. SPIKEY WALLS puts your timing skills to the test in a flappy-style game where you navigate through spike-filled passages. Both games focus on quick sessions and high score chasing. Published by RCMADIAX exclusively for the Wii U eShop, this bare-bones package offers minimalist arcade action designed for brief play sessions, though reviews noted limited content and replay value. Sources: - [TAP TAP ARCADE Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/tap_tap_arcade) - [TAP TA

title: Tap Tap Arcade 2
description: A budget eShop bundle featuring two minimalist arcade score-chasers. SKEASY challenges players to slide down snowy mountains while dodging trees to rack up points. VOLCANO adds an exclusive platforming twist where you must double-jump across rising platforms while escaping a deadly wall of lava surging from below. Both games offer simple pick-up-and-play gameplay focused on beating high scores, though their bare-bones presentation and limited depth make them brief diversions rather than lasting experiences. Sources: - [TAP TAP ARCADE 2 Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/tap_tap_arcade_2) - [TAP TAP ARCADE 2 for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details

title: Tekken Tag Tournament 2: Wii U Edition
description: Tekken Tag Tournament 2 is the eighth main instalment in the Tekken fighting gameseries, released in Japanese arcades on September 14, 2011. It received an update, subtitled Unlimited, on March 27, 2012. A console version based on the update was released for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in September 2012. It was ported to the Wii U as one of the system's launch titles in November 2012, subtitled Wii U Edition.

title: Temple of Yog
description: Guide sacrificial tributes through procedurally-generated labyrinths in this retro-style roguelike shooter. Play as a deity commanding warriors from four guilds—clerics, mages, warriors, and rogues—each with unique stats. Use shadow power to teleport between light and shadow realms displayed simultaneously on your TV and GamePad. Battle dangerous enemies across dual screens as you navigate the ever-changing Temple of Yog. Features permadeath, class-based gameplay with HP, MP, and shadow power systems, and innovative dual-screen mechanics unique to Wii U. Sources: - [Temple of Yog - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Temple_of_Yog) - [Temple of Yog Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life]

title: Tengami
description: Tengami is a unique atmospheric adventure set entirely within the pages of a Japanese pop-up book. Fold and slide parts of the beautifully crafted paper world to solve environmental puzzles and guide a lone traveler through a mystical landscape. Explore serene gardens, ancient temples, and cherry blossom groves rendered in an exquisite handcrafted art style that brings traditional Japanese aesthetics to life. Each scene unfolds like a delicate origami creation, where manipulating the world itself is key to progression. The meditative journey is accompanied by a haunting traditional soundtrack that complements the contemplative pacing.

title: Terraria
description: Terraria is a land of adventure! A land of mystery! A land that's yours to shape, to defend and to enjoy. Your options in Terraria are limitless, are you an action gamer with an itchy trigger finger? A master builder? A collector? An explorer? There's something for everyone here. Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. The world is your canvas and the ground itself is your paint.

title: Teslagrad
description: Master the power of magnetism in this hand-drawn puzzle-platformer set in a steampunk-inspired world. As a young boy fleeing from the king's guards, you seek refuge in the Tesla Tower, an ancient structure filled with electromagnetic secrets. Manipulate magnetic polarities to solve intricate environmental puzzles, traverse treacherous platforming challenges, and uncover the dark history of a despotic regime. With no dialogue and minimal text, the story unfolds through stunning visual storytelling and clever environmental design. Use the Teslamancer's tools to attract and repel objects, teleport across deadly gaps, and confront massive bosses.

title: Tetraminos
description: A Tetris-inspired puzzle game with colorful twists on the classic formula. Match falling tetraminos to clear lines, but align blocks by color for bonus points. Features expanded block types including singles, doubles, triples, short L-shapes, and plus blocks. Four game modes offer variety: Endless for high scores, Challenge with time limits, 50 puzzle stages requiring strategic thinking, and 4-player split-screen Multiplayer for competitive action. Smooth controls and straightforward gameplay deliver accessible block-dropping fun. Sources: - [Tetraminos Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/tetraminos) - [Tetraminos (2016) | Wii U eShop Game |

title: Tetrobot and Co.
description: Take control of Psychobot, a microscopic robot tasked with repairing the damaged Tetrobots—once humanity's beloved helper robots. Navigate through intricate block-based puzzles where you'll absorb, swap, and strategically place different types of blocks to progress. Each level presents increasingly complex challenges requiring clever use of your abilities and the unique properties of various materials. Solve environmental puzzles, collect memory blocks to uncover the story of each broken Tetrobot, and explore creatively designed levels filled with mechanical hazards and secrets.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man - Ultimate Edition
description: Swing through Manhattan as Spider-Man in this enhanced Wii U edition of the open-world superhero adventure. Web-sling across iconic New York landmarks, scale skyscrapers with fluid parkour movement, and engage in acrobatic combat against classic villains and criminal gangs. The game features an original story set after the events of the 2012 film, where a cross-species virus threatens the city and Peter Parker must stop a conspiracy involving Oscorp. Utilize the GamePad for immersive features like first-person web-shooting sequences and real-time camera photography. Master Web Rush mode for precision navigation, upgrade your abilities, and complete side missions throughout the city.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
description: Step into the web-slinger's suit as Spider-Man faces his greatest challenge yet. Swing through a massive open-world Manhattan, battling iconic villains and uncovering a deep conspiracy that threatens the city. The game expands beyond the film storyline, featuring an enhanced combat system that combines acrobatic moves, web-based attacks, and environmental takedowns. Hunt down notorious criminals in side missions, stop crimes in progress across the city, and unlock new suits with unique abilities. The Web Rush mechanic returns, letting you slow down time and precisely target your next move during high-speed chases and combat encounters.

title: The Beggar's Ride
description: The Beggar's Ride is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer where you harness the power of nature itself. Play as an old beggar who can transform into various animals and control elemental forces to overcome obstacles. Manipulate weather, shift between day and night, and use your shapeshifting abilities to solve intricate environmental puzzles across beautifully hand-painted landscapes. Each transformation grants unique abilities—become a bird to soar over chasms, or shift the environment to reveal hidden paths.

title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
description: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is an indie roguelike video game designed by Edmund McMillen and developed and published by Nicalis. Rebirth was released for Microsoft Windows, OS X, Linux, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation Vita in November 2014, and for Xbox One, New Nintendo 3DS, and Wii U in July 2015. After an initial rejection due to its controversial content, Nicalis released Rebirth on iOS on January 11, 2017. A version for the Nintendo Switch was released on March 17, 2017.

title: The Book of Unwritten Tales 2
description: Embark on an epic point-and-click adventure filled with humor, puzzles, and fantasy charm. Guide Wilbur the gnome mage, Nate the adventurer, Ivo the elf princess, and the critter Critter through a richly detailed world threatened by magical chaos. Solve intricate environmental puzzles, engage in witty dialogue with memorable characters, and explore beautifully hand-drawn locations ranging from mystical forests to ancient dungeons. This sequel to the beloved adventure series delivers hours of brain-teasing challenges, satirical fantasy humor, and a compelling story that lovingly parodies classic RPG and adventure game tropes while standing as an excellent puzzle adventure in its own right.

title: The Bridge
description: The Bridge defies gravity and perspective in this mind-bending puzzle platformer inspired by M.C. Escher's lithographs. You manipulate gravity and physics to navigate impossible architecture across 48 challenging levels. Rotate entire rooms, invert gravity, and bend reality itself to reach each level's exit. The game's hand-drawn art style evokes classic pen-and-ink illustrations, creating an otherworldly atmosphere that complements its brain-teasing mechanics. Each puzzle builds upon the last, introducing new concepts like vortexes and parallel dimensions that fundamentally alter how you perceive and solve spatial challenges.

title: The Cave
description: The Cave is a puzzle-platform/adventure video game developed by Double Fine Productions and published by Sega in January 2013 on the PlayStation Network, Nintendo eShop and Xbox Live Arcade storefronts via the PlayStation 3, Wii Uand Xbox 360 consoles and on Steam for Microsoft Windows, OS X and Linux. It was later released on October 3, 2013 on iOS devices, and on December 2, 2013 on the Ouya.

title: The Croods - Prehistoric Party!
description: Join the Croods family in a prehistoric party adventure filled with mini-games and challenges. Play as your favorite characters from the animated film as you explore colorful environments and compete in over 30 different activities. Hunt for food, avoid dangerous creatures, and master physical challenges that test your reflexes and timing. Team up with family and friends in multiplayer party mode, or venture through the single-player campaign to unlock new content and abilities. With simple controls designed for all ages and vibrant cartoon visuals that bring the Stone Age to life, this family-friendly party game delivers accessible fun with prehistoric charm and humor straight from the m...

title: The Deer God
description: Experience a mesmerizing journey of reincarnation and karma in this atmospheric 3D pixel art platformer. Reborn as a fawn, you must survive in a dangerous wilderness filled with predators, environmental hazards, and mystical challenges. Explore procedurally generated forests, solve puzzles using unique abilities gained through transformation, and face moral choices that shape your journey. Battle bosses, discover secrets, and unlock new animal forms as you seek to break the cycle of rebirth. With stunning voxel graphics, a hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, and gameplay that blends survival, exploration, and spiritual themes, The Deer God offers a distinctive adventure where every action ca...

title: The Fall
description: Take control of ARID, an AI onboard a combat suit whose unconscious pilot is critically injured. With your directives normally locked behind strict protocol, you can only act to preserve human life - and to do that, you'll need to explore a dark, mysterious facility and solve intricate puzzles. Combine adventure game logic with action sequences as you navigate this atmospheric sci-fi thriller. Question the nature of consciousness and the boundaries of artificial intelligence as ARID's rigid programming conflicts with the desperate need to save its human charge.

title: The Girl and the Robot
description: Guide a young girl and her mechanical companion through a mysterious castle in this charming puzzle-platformer. Switch between controlling the agile girl and the powerful robot to solve intricate environmental puzzles and overcome obstacles. The girl can slip through tight spaces and interact with delicate mechanisms, while the robot provides brute strength to move heavy objects and combat enemies. Work together to escape the castle's dangers, utilizing each character's unique abilities in creative ways. Beautiful art direction and an enchanting atmosphere bring this fairy tale-inspired adventure to life as you unravel the mystery of their unlikely partnership.

title: The Legend of Zelda - Hyrule Historia
The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild is an action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo. An entry in the long running The Legend of Zelda series, it was released for the Nintendo Switch and Wii U consoles on March 3, 2017. Breath of the Wild is set at the end of the series' timeline; the player controls Link, who awakens from a hundred-year slumber to defeat Calamity Ganon before it can destroy the kingdom of Hyrule.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
description: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker is a 2002 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the GameCube. The tenth instalment in The Legend of Zelda series, The Wind Waker is set on a group of islands in a vast sea, a departure for the series. It follows series protagonist Link as he attempts to save his sister from the sorcerer Ganon and becomes embroiled in a struggle for the Triforce, a sacred wish-granting relic. Aided by allies including pirate captain Tetra—an incarnation of Princess Zelda—and a talking boat named the King of Red Lions, Link sails the ocean, explores islands, and traverses dungeons to acquire the power necessary to defeat Ganon.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD
description: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD is an action-adventure game in Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda series for the Wii U home video game console. A high-definition remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess, originally released for the GameCube and Wii in 2006, was released on March 4, 2016. The game was co-developed by Tantalus and Nintendo Entertainment Planning & Development and published by Nintendo, and features enhanced graphics and Amiibo functionality. The release of the game marked the ten-year anniversary of the international release of the original, and was the second game in the series released on the Wii U.

title: The LEGO Movie Videogame
description: The Lego Movie Videogame is a Lego-themed action-adventure video game developed by TT Fusion. It follows the plot of the animated film The Lego Movie. The game was published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment and released alongside the film in 2014 for Microsoft Windows, Nintendo 3DS, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Wii U, Xbox 360, and Xbox One, and on 16 October 2014 for Mac OS X by Feral Interactive.

title: The Letter
description: Experience pure terror in this first-person horror adventure where you explore an abandoned mansion filled with supernatural dread. Armed only with a flashlight, you must uncover the dark secrets hidden within the estate's cursed walls. The game builds tension through atmospheric exploration, jump scares, and psychological horror as you piece together the mystery of what happened to the mansion's former residents. With its focus on creating a genuinely frightening experience, The Letter challenges you to confront your fears while searching for clues and trying to survive encounters with malevolent spirits. Will you uncover the truth, or become another victim of the mansion's terrible curse?

title: The Mysterious Cities of Gold Secret Paths
description: Based on the animated series, this puzzle-adventure follows Esteban, Zia, and Tao on their quest to find the legendary City of Gold in China. Switch between the three children to use their unique abilities: Esteban unlocks mechanisms with sun power, Zia slips through narrow spaces, and Tao decrypts ancient Mu language while commanding his parrot Pichu. Navigate through levels filled with environmental puzzles and stealth sequences, avoiding guards as you uncover the secrets of lost civilizations. Perfect for families and fans of the classic show. Sources: - [The Mysterious Cities of Gold: Secret Paths Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/myst

title: The Peanuts Movie - Snoopy's Grand Adventure
description: Join Snoopy and the Peanuts gang on a whimsical side-scrolling adventure inspired by the beloved movie. Play as Snoopy and explore colorful environments filled with platforming challenges, hidden collectibles, and light puzzle-solving. Transform into Snoopy's imaginative alter-egos including the Flying Ace, Joe Cool, and the Astronaut, each with unique abilities that help you navigate obstacles and defeat enemies. Search for the missing Beagle Scouts across diverse worlds, from mysterious forests to ancient temples.

title: The Rivers of Alice
description: Enter the dreamlike world of Alice's subconscious in this surreal point-and-click adventure. Guide young Alice through a series of hand-painted landscapes filled with puzzles that represent her deepest fears and anxieties. Each chapter introduces memorable characters and symbolic challenges that must be solved to help Alice overcome her inner demons. The game combines stunning watercolor-style artwork with an evocative soundtrack to create a meditative, atmospheric experience. Use simple touch controls to explore ethereal environments, collect items, and interact with the strange inhabitants of Alice's mind.

title: The Smurfs 2
description: Join the Smurfs in this family-friendly platformer adventure inspired by the animated film. Play as a Smurf and traverse through enchanting environments from Paris to the magical Smurf Village, using unique abilities to overcome obstacles and enemies. The game features cooperative gameplay where players can team up locally, utilizing the Wii U GamePad for asymmetric multiplayer experiences. Navigate colorful 3D levels filled with collectibles, solve environmental puzzles, and face off against the evil wizard Gargamel and his schemes.

title: The Stonecutter
description: Based on a classic Chinese folk tale, The Stonecutter tells the story of a poor stonecutter who envies those above him in the social hierarchy. A spirit grants his wishes to become wealthier and more powerful, but satisfaction remains elusive. This interactive storybook features multiple story paths and endings where players make choices that determine the stonecutter's fate. A brief morality tale exploring themes of contentment, envy, and the consequences of never being satisfied with what you have.

title: The Swapper
description: Navigate a derelict space station in this atmospheric puzzle-platformer where you wield a device that creates clones and swaps consciousness between them. Solve mind-bending puzzles by positioning up to four clones simultaneously, then transfer your awareness to navigate hazards and reach seemingly impossible areas. The station's mysterious rock formations seem to defy explanation, and scattered logs hint at the fate of the crew. With its haunting clay-modeled visuals, moody soundtrack, and philosophical narrative exploring themes of identity and consciousness, The Swapper delivers a cerebral sci-fi experience that challenges both your puzzle-solving skills and your perception of self.

title: The Swindle
description: Break into buildings, hack computers, and steal cash in this steampunk heist game where every decision counts. You're a master thief with just 100 days to pull off the ultimate score: hacking Scotland Yard's omniscient surveillance system before it goes online. Each randomly generated building presents unique challenges—disable security systems, avoid guards and robots, grab the loot, and escape before the police arrive. Permanent death means losing everything, but the money you steal funds crucial upgrades like better hacking tools, stronger bombs, and enhanced mobility.

title: The Voice - I Want You
description: Step into the spotlight with The Voice - I Want You, the official game based on the hit TV singing competition. Perform popular songs across multiple genres while the iconic coaches evaluate your vocal performance using the Wii U GamePad's microphone. Experience the authentic show format as you progress through blind auditions, battle rounds, and live performances, aiming to impress coaches and win their support. The game features motion controls for stage presence, multiplayer modes for competitive singing battles, and a track list spanning contemporary hits and classic favorites. Whether singing solo or competing with friends, prove you have what it takes to be the next Voice champion.

title: The Walking Dead - Survival Instinct
description: Step into the boots of Daryl Dixon in this first-person action game set in the early days of the zombie apocalypse. Before the events of the TV series, survive your way across the undead-infested Georgia countryside alongside your brother Merle. Scavenge for supplies, manage limited resources, and choose your path through a desperate journey to Atlanta. Every decision matters as you decide whether to help survivors or leave them behind, fight walkers or slip past undetected, and ration fuel and ammunition for the dangers ahead. The GamePad displays your inventory and map for quick tactical decisions.

title: The Wonderful 101
description: The Wonderful 101 is an action-adventure game developed by PlatinumGames and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. The game was directed by Hideki Kamiyaand produced by Atsushi Inaba; the pair also worked together on the Viewtiful Joe series and Ōkami. It was released in August 2013 in all major regions except North America, where it released the following month.

title: Thomas Was Alone
description: Guide a cast of sentient AI rectangles through a minimalist platforming adventure where friendship shapes everything. Each character possesses unique abilities—from Thomas's balanced jumps to Claire's floating prowess—requiring clever cooperation to navigate increasingly complex puzzle chambers. The brilliant narration by Danny Wallace brings unexpected warmth and personality to simple geometric shapes, transforming abstract blocks into genuinely compelling characters with hopes, fears, and relationships.

title: Titans Tower
description: Jump between the walls of a castle tower, grabbing loot and dodging spikes as you ascend. Catch power-ups to enhance your climb while racking up the highest score possible. This fast-paced vertical climber demands quick reflexes and sharp timing as obstacles appear in your path. Alternate between walls, snag coins, and push for new records in this arcade-style score-chaser from RCMADIAX. Sources: - [Nintendo Life - TITANS TOWER (2016) | Wii U eShop Game](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/titans_tower) - [HonestGamers - Titan's Tower (Wii U) Review](https://www.honestgamers.com/13462/wii-u/titans-tower/review.html) - [GameFAQs - Titan's Tower Release Information](https://gamefaqs

title: Tnt Racers
description: TNT Racers delivers explosive top-down racing action where victory demands more than just speed. Race through vibrant tracks while dropping mines, launching missiles, and using power-ups to blast opponents off the screen. The unique elimination mechanic keeps the tension high—fall too far behind and you're out of the race. Compete across multiple game modes including Championship, Time Trial, and the chaotic Survival mode where only one racer can claim victory. With local multiplayer support for up to four players, TNT Racers transforms your living room into a battle arena on wheels.

title: Toby the Secret Mine
description: Navigate a dark and atmospheric world as Toby in this haunting puzzle-platformer adventure. Traverse dangerous environments filled with deadly traps, solve intricate puzzles, and overcome challenging obstacles to rescue kidnapped friends from a mysterious kidnapper. The minimalist art style creates an eerie, shadowy world where every step could be your last. Use stealth, timing, and clever problem-solving to progress through increasingly complex levels. With physics-based puzzles, environmental hazards, and a somber atmosphere reminiscent of LIMBO and INSIDE, this indie gem challenges both your reflexes and your mind as you uncover the secrets of a sinister mine.

title: Toki Tori
description: Toki Tori is a puzzle video game with platform elements originally released by Capcom in September 2001 for the Game Boy Color. It was developed by Dutch video game development company Two Tribes B.V.and is their first published video game. The game follows a young chick, Toki Tori, and his quest to rescue his younger siblings, still in their eggs. To progress through the game, the player must pick up each egg on a level using a set number of tools, with new tools being introduced as the player progresses through the four worlds. This usually involves careful planning and creative thinking.

title: Toki Tori 2+
description: Toki Tori 2 is a puzzle platform game, developed by Dutch video game development company Two Tribes. It is the sequel to the 2001 game Toki Tori. The game was originally announced in December 2011 with an intended release for Spring 2012 for Steam and iOS devices (and was later announced as a Wii U game), but the game was pushed back due to longer than expected development times. The game was released on April 4, 2013 for Wii U and on July 11, 2013 on Steam for Windows and for Mac OS X.

title: Tokyo Mirage Sessions #FE
description: Tokyo Mirage Sessions ♯FE (formerly known as Shin Megami Tensei x Fire Emblem) is a 2015 crossover role-playing video game developed by Atlus and Nintendo ERD and published by Nintendo for the Wii U home console. The game combines gameplay, narrative and aesthetic elements from Atlus' Shin Megami Tensei and Nintendo's Fire Emblem series. It was released in Japan in December 2015, and worldwide in June 2016.

title: Toto Temple Deluxe
description: Toto Temple Deluxe is a frantic local multiplayer action game where up to four players compete to control a single goat and score points by holding onto it. The longer you possess the goat, the more points you rack up, but your opponents will stop at nothing to steal it away. Dash, bounce, and leap through colorful arenas filled with hazards and power-ups as matches descend into hilarious chaos. The simple controls make it easy to jump in, but mastering the physics-based movement and timing your attacks takes skill.
