With multiple game modes including King of the Hill variants and party modes, Toto Temple Deluxe delivers fast-paced couch competition perfect for game nights.

title: Touch Selections
description: Touch Selections bundles two GamePad touchscreen games: Peg Solitaire and Avoider. In Peg Solitaire, solve 14 puzzle boards by jumping pegs to remove them, aiming to leave only one remaining. Each board presents a uniquely shaped challenge testing strategic thinking. Avoider offers fast-paced arcade action where you guide a white triangle across the screen to dodge incoming pink triangles from all directions. Both games utilize simple touch controls designed for quick play sessions on the Wii U GamePad. Sources: - [TOUCH SELECTIONS for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/touch-selections-wii-u/) - [TOUCH SELECTIONS Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https

title: Transformers Prime
description: Join the Autobots in their battle against the Decepticons in this third-person action brawler based on the hit animated series. Play as Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, Arcee, Autobot Ratchet, and Bulkhead as you fight to protect Earth from Megatron's forces. Engage in intense combat using each character's unique weapons and special abilities - unleash Optimus Prime's Ion Blaster, strike with Arcee's speed and agility, or deploy Bumblebee's electric stingers. Battle through multiple environments from the show, facing off against powerful Decepticons in arena-style combat. Master devastating combo attacks and special moves to defeat waves of enemies.

title: Transformers Rise of the Dark Spark
description: Battle as Autobots and Decepticons across two parallel storylines in this third-person shooter that bridges the gap between the Cybertron games and the Michael Bay films. Switch between over 40 playable characters including Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, and Megatron as you fight for control of the Dark Spark, an ancient artifact with reality-altering power. Engage in intense combat using each Transformer's unique weapons and abilities, from devastating melee attacks to long-range firepower. Experience the war for Cybertron through multiple perspectives, making crucial decisions that affect the story's outcome.

title: Trine - Enchanted Edition
description: Guide three unlikely heroes through a beautiful fantasy world filled with physics-based puzzles and combat. Play as Amadeus the Wizard, Pontius the Knight, and Zoya the Thief, each with unique abilities that must work together to overcome obstacles. Conjure boxes and planks, deflect fireballs with your shield, or fire arrows through distant foes. The game's innovative three-character system lets you switch heroes instantly or team up with friends in online and local co-op. Solve environmental puzzles using creative combinations of magic, strength, and agility while battling goblin armies and enormous bosses.

title: Trine 2: Director's Cut
description: The Trine 2: Director's Cut edition, released at first only for Nintendo's Wii U console, features the original game with the Goblin Menace expansion, alongside the enhanced controls that take advantage of the GamePad controller, as well as an exclusive level called the "Dwarven Caverns". A multiplayer mode called Magic Mayhem was in development at one point but was later scrapped in favor of more focus on the Dwarven Caverns level. Director's Cut edition also features a flexible control scheme, especially for the game's multiplayer mode which is both local and online, where players can, alongside the GamePad, use Wii Remotes, Nunchuks, Wii U Pro Controllers, and even the original Wii Cla...

title: Triple Breakout
description: Triple Breakout combines classic Breakout and Pong mechanics into a competitive arcade experience. Control a paddle to deflect balls horizontally across the screen, scoring points by destroying center blocks while trying to send the ball past your opponent's goal. Blocks alter ball direction and speed, awarding points to the last player who struck them. Classic power-ups modify paddle size and introduce multiple balls. Face off against AI opponents or chase high scores in solo mode across quick, arcade-style sessions. Sources: - [Triple Breakout for Wii U - GameFAQs](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/wii-u/208874-triple-breakout) - [Triple Breakout (2017) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](htt

title: Tumblestone
description: Tumblestone revolutionizes the match-3 genre by requiring careful planning and strategic thinking. Unlike traditional match-3 games where you can usually find a move, Tumblestone's puzzles have only one solution, demanding precise execution. Clear the board by matching three or more blocks of the same color, but think ahead—the wrong move means starting over. Features an extensive Story Mode with over 360 unique puzzles across diverse environments, plus competitive multiplayer modes for up to four players. Master dozens of gameplay modifiers that dramatically change your approach, from gravity shifts to new block types.

title: Turbo Super Stunt Squad
description: Race through vibrant tracks as your favorite characters from the Turbo animated film in this action-packed kart racer. Master spectacular stunts, power-slide around corners, and unleash special abilities unique to each snail racer. Compete across diverse environments from the movie, performing gravity-defying tricks and building boost combos to leave opponents in the dust. Multiple game modes let you tackle time trials, compete in tournaments, or challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer. The stunt system rewards creativity and risk-taking, letting you chain together flips, spins, and wall-rides for massive speed boosts.

title: Turtle Tale
description: Control Shelldon the turtle as Turtle Island falls under siege by Captain O'Haire and his monkey pirate army. Armed with a water gun, blast enemies and collect 100 fruits across 15 colorful 2D platforming levels spanning five unique areas. Navigate simple controls through the first quest, then unlock a harder second playthrough with limited hearts by gathering all collectibles. This budget-friendly eShop title features HD visuals optimized for Wii U, delivering classic side-scrolling action with straightforward gameplay and vibrant graphics. Sources: - [Turtle Tale for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/turtle-tale-wii-u/) - [Turtle Tale (Wii U eShop)- Revi

title: Twin Robots
description: Guide two robots through a series of challenging puzzle-platforming stages in this unique cooperative experience that you can play solo or with a friend. The twist? One robot is trapped in a cage and running out of energy, while the other must navigate dangerous obstacles to collect energy orbs and share them to keep both robots alive. Switch between the two characters to solve environmental puzzles, avoid deadly hazards, and work together across 28 levels of increasing difficulty. With its distinctive energy-sharing mechanic and charming visual style, Twin Robots offers a fresh take on cooperative puzzle-platforming that demands careful planning and precise timing.

title: Typoman
description: Typoman is a dark atmospheric puzzle-platformer where you control a hero crafted from letters, navigating a hostile world dominated by an evil power. The core mechanic revolves around crafting words to alter your environment and solve intricate puzzles - rearrange letters to create words like "ON" to activate machinery, or "UP" to raise platforms. The game combines challenging platforming with clever wordplay puzzles that require both linguistic creativity and logical thinking. As you journey through the dystopian landscape, you'll craft, push, and manipulate letters to overcome obstacles, defeat enemies, and uncover the narrative.

title: U Host
description: Host your own customizable game show with up to four players or teams competing as contestants. Leveraging the Wii U GamePad as your control hub, choose from over 1,000 questions across 10 categories or create your own with the built-in question creator. Features multiple pre-set game show modes and 20+ mini-games to keep the party entertaining. The GamePad serves as the host's second screen for managing questions, scoring, and gameplay while contestants answer on-screen. Perfect for family gatherings or party nights where you control the action. Sources: - [U Host Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/u_host) - [U Host (2016) | Wii U eShop Ga

title: Ultratron
description: Ultratron is a frantic twin-stick shooter set in a neon-drenched robot apocalypse. Battle through endless waves of increasingly hostile machines as you fight to become the last sentient being in the universe. Upgrade your weapons, shields, and abilities between rounds using collected loot. The game features supremely tight controls, explosive particle effects, and a pulsing synthwave soundtrack that drives the relentless action. Each run offers procedurally-varied enemy patterns and strategic upgrade choices. Master bullet-hell dodging while unleashing devastating firepower across minimalist arenas filled with deadly geometric foes. Pure arcade intensity with modern roguelike progression.

title: Unalive
description: Navigate randomly generated laboratory rooms as a victim of a terrible experiment. This action roguelike features permadeath, demanding precision and quick thinking with only one life to survive. Collect unique items to enhance your abilities, overcome deadly traps, and defeat challenging bosses. Each playthrough offers random skill items, unpredictable room layouts, and varied boss encounters in this dark, atmospheric adventure through a secret facility where death means starting over. Sources: - [Unalive (2018) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/unalive) - [Unalive for Wii U Reviews](https://www.metacritic.com/game/unalive/) - [Unalive (2018)

title: Underground
description: Guide young Sari and her robot butler Sw4nk through treacherous underground caverns in this unique puzzle game. When Sari's father banishes Sw4nk to the mines, she defies his orders to rescue her mechanical friend. Navigate challenging environments using precision controls designed to teach laparoscopic surgery skills. Solve intricate puzzles while uncovering a heartwarming story of friendship and determination. Features optional specialized controller support that mimics surgical instruments, blending entertainment with genuine medical training applications. Sources: - [Underground (2015) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/underground) - [Unde

title: Unepic
description: Unepic (stylized as UnEpic) is a video game which was released on September 30, 2011. The game was developed in Barcelona, Spain by Francisco Tellez de Meneses and various collaborators.

title: Use Your Words
description: Use Your Words is a hilarious party game that transforms your smartphone into a controller for creative comedic chaos. Compete with friends by writing witty captions for bizarre photos, filling in dialogue for obscure foreign films, crafting answers to absurd survey questions, and completing other laugh-out-loud prompts. The game shines in local multiplayer sessions where quick thinking and sharp humor reign supreme. Each round presents fresh opportunities to outsmart and out-funny your opponents as everyone votes on the best responses. Whether you're captioning a confused cat or dubbing a vintage instructional video, the humor comes from your own creativity rather than pre-written jokes.

title: Vektor Wars
description: Command a Space Ranger in this neon-drenched first-person shooter inspired by 80s arcade classics like Battlezone and Robotron. Battle through nine unique zones to destroy robot armies and rescue the Robodudes. Features multiple game modes including Arcade (three lives against endless waves), Deadline (five-minute chaos), Sequence (two minutes per zone), and Survival (one life, increasing pressure). Dual-stick controls deliver fast-paced action wrapped in retro-futuristic visuals that celebrate the cyberpunk aesthetic of the 1980s. Sources: - [Vektor Wars Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/vektor_wars) - [Vektor Wars for Wii U - GameFAQs](h

title: VoxelMaker
description: VoxelMaker transforms the Wii U GamePad into a powerful 3D creation studio, letting you build voxel-based worlds block by block. Design intricate structures, sculpt detailed characters, or craft entire environments using an intuitive touch-based interface. The game features a robust toolset including symmetry modes, color palettes, and geometric shapes to speed up your creative process. Share your creations with the Miiverse community or export them as QR codes for others to scan and import. Whether you're building pixel art, architectural marvels, or abstract sculptures, VoxelMaker provides the perfect canvas for 3D artistic expression on Nintendo's dual-screen console.

title: Vrog
description: Play as a frog in your favorite pond, leaping across lily pads to catch insects and beat high scores in this unique virtual reality experience. Using the GamePad's gyroscope, look around by turning the controller and hop to lily pads or catch bugs simply by looking at them—no buttons required. Avoid dangerous wasps and a hungry stork in Arcade and Survival modes, while collecting special insects that grant abilities like slowed time and night vision. With child-friendly design and innovative motion controls, VRog offers accessible VR gameplay for all ages.

title: Völgarr the Viking
description: Völgarr the Viking is a brutally challenging 2D action platformer that pays homage to classic arcade games of the 1980s. As the undead warrior Völgarr, summoned by Odin to defeat an evil dragon, you must battle through seven perilous worlds filled with mythological monsters, deadly traps, and environmental hazards. Master precise controls and timing as you wield your sword and spear against relentless enemies. The game features no checkpoints within levels, demanding perfection and memorization. Unlock power-ups like the flaming sword and double-jump ability to reach secret paths and hidden treasure chests.

title: Warriors Orochi 3 Hyper
description: The Wii U port of the game, Warriors Orochi 3: Hyper (Musou Orochi 2: Hyper in Japan) was announced at the 2012 Tokyo Game Show as one of the launch titles for the console. Unlike past releases, this port launched outside Japan first. Hyper features a new multiplayer mode called "Duel Mode" in which players battle enemies using three-man teams. Players will also have the option to play the game using a Wii U Pro Controller or the Wii U GamePad. The GamePad can be used to display an expanded mini-map. Local co-op includes an option that allows each player to have a full screen to play on, with one player using the TV screen while the other uses the GamePad's screen.

title: Watch Dogs
description: Watch Dogs is an action-adventure video game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft. It was released worldwide on May 27, 2014 for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox 360, and Xbox One. A Wii U version was released in November 2014. Set in a fictionalized, free-roam, open world version of Chicago, the single-player story follows hacker Aiden Pearce's search for revenge after the killing of his niece. The game is played from a third-person perspective, and the world is navigated on foot or by vehicle. An online multiplayer mode allows up to eight players to engage in cooperative and competitive gameplay.

title: Wheel of Fortune
description: Spin the iconic wheel and solve word puzzles in this digital adaptation of television's longest-running game show. Test your vocabulary and luck as you compete against friends or AI opponents to solve clever phrases and win virtual prizes. The Wii U GamePad displays your personal rack of letters while keeping your guesses hidden from competitors, creating an authentic experience that captures the excitement of the TV show. Call out consonants, buy vowels, and race to solve puzzles across multiple rounds. Features classic gameplay modes, thousands of puzzles spanning various categories, and the nail-biting tension of landing on Bankrupt or hitting the coveted $1 Million wedge.

title: Whispering Willows
description: Guide Elena Elkhorn through a haunted mansion as she searches for her missing father in this atmospheric horror adventure. Using a mystical amulet inherited from your shaman ancestors, separate your spirit from your body to explore beyond physical barriers, communicate with tormented souls, and uncover dark secrets from the past. Solve environmental puzzles by switching between physical and spirit form, each offering unique abilities and perspectives. The hand-drawn art style brings eerie beauty to abandoned corridors and overgrown grounds, while the spirits you encounter reveal tragic stories tied to the mansion's grim history.

title: Wii Fit U
description: Wii Fit U is an exergaming video game developed by Nintendo for the Wii Uconsole, and is the successor to the Wii games Wii Fit and Wii Fit Plus. Wii Fit U utilizes both the Wii Balance Board and the Wii U GamePad in gameplay, and is bundled with the newly introduced Fit Meter, an activity meter accessory. It was released in Japan on October 31, 2013, followed by North America and Europe one day later.

title: Wii Fit U (Free)
description: Step onto the Wii U Balance Board and transform your living room into a personal fitness center. This free trial version of Wii Fit U lets you explore a selection of exercises and activities designed to improve balance, strength, and aerobic conditioning. Track your progress with the Fit Meter accessory, which monitors your daily activity even when you're away from the console. Choose from yoga poses, strength training exercises, balance games, and aerobic activities, all guided by a virtual trainer who adapts to your fitness level. The GamePad displays detailed feedback and progress charts, helping you set goals and stay motivated as you work toward a healthier lifestyle.

title: Wii Party U
description: Wii Party U is a party video game from Nintendo for the Wii U. It was announced in a January 2013 Nintendo Direct, and later detailed at E3 2013 and the October 2013 Nintendo Direct. It is the sequel to the 2010 Wii game, Wii Party.

title: Wii Sports Club
description: Wii Sports Club is a sports video game from Nintendo released as downloadable software for the Wii U. It consists of HD remakes of the individual sports from the 2006 Wii launch title, Wii Sports, which can be purchased individually or rented for a period of time. The first set of sports, bowling and tennis, were released in Japan on 30 October 2013, in Europe and North America on 7 November 2013, and in Australia and New Zealand on 8 November 2013. Golf was later released following a Nintendo Direct presentation on 18 December 2013. Baseball and Boxing were released at the end of June 2014.

title: Wind-Up Knight 2
description: Wind-Up Knight 2 is a challenging 3D auto-running platformer where you control a mechanical knight navigating treacherous obstacle courses. Master precise timing as your character automatically sprints forward through beautifully crafted levels filled with deadly traps, enemies, and hazards. Jump, roll, slash, and shield your way through increasingly complex challenges that demand split-second decision-making. The game features responsive one-touch controls that belie its deep mechanical complexity, requiring players to memorize patterns and execute perfect runs.

title: Wipeout 3
description: Based on ABC's hit game show, Wipeout 3 challenges players to run, jump, duck and slide through 12 outrageous winter and summer obstacle courses from an over-the-shoulder perspective. Navigate iconic obstacles like Sweeper Arms and Big Balls while racing against the clock. Features Trap Attack mode where a GamePad player controls obstacles to sabotage up to four competitors using Wii Remotes. Includes split-screen multiplayer, team modes, instant replays, and off-TV play support. Sources: - [Wipeout 3 Review (Wii U) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu/wipeout_3) - [Amazon.com: Wipeout 3 - Nintendo Wii U](https://www.amazon.com/Wipeout-3-Nintendo-Wii-U/dp/B009ETRAGA) -

title: Wipeout Create & Crash
description: Race through fantastical obstacle courses inspired by the beloved animated franchise in this high-speed kart racer. Choose from fan-favorite characters and navigate wild, destructive tracks filled with massive wrecking balls, explosive hazards, and outrageous shortcuts. The game features both racing and creative modes - build your own chaotic courses using an intuitive track editor, then challenge friends to survive your devious designs. Master power-ups, execute daring stunts, and compete across varied environments from tropical islands to mechanical fortresses.

title: Woah Dave!
description: Woah Dave! is a frantic arcade-style platformer that channels the spirit of classic single-screen arcade games. As Dave, you must survive increasingly chaotic waves of alien eggs and skull blocks that rain from the sky. Grab these hazards and hurl them at enemies before they hatch into more dangerous creatures. Every throw counts - toss eggs into the lava pits for coins, or use them as weapons against the bizarre alien menaces. The catch? Everything you don't deal with quickly becomes a bigger threat.

title: Wooden Sen'SeY
description: Take control of a powerful lumberjack warrior in this fast-paced 2D action platformer that blends martial arts combat with environmental destruction. Armed with your mighty Shinto axe-staff, dash through vibrant hand-drawn levels, smashing through obstacles and enemies with brutal efficiency. Master a unique combo system that rewards aggressive play, chaining together devastating attacks as you sprint, jump, and slide through each stage. Time your moves carefully to maximize your score multipliers while racing against the clock. Battle through forests, temples, and mystical landscapes with fluid animation and satisfying impact.

title: Word Logic by Powgi
description: Six logic-based word puzzle types with 120 puzzles each. Includes Kriss Kross word-fitting grids, Ladders word-transformation chains, Crypto cryptogram quotes, Word Sudoku with letter placement, Gaps for deducing missing letters, and Wordsweeper inspired by Minesweeper. Touch screen controls let you place letters directly on the GamePad. Cross-buy with 3DS version included. 720 puzzles total focused on deduction and wordplay. Sources: - [Word Logic by POWGI (Wii U) - Christ Centered Gamer](https://www.christcenteredgamer.com/reviews/consoles/wii-u/word-logic-by-powgi-wii-u) - [Word Logic by POWGI Review - Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/word_logic_by_powgi) -

title: Word Party
description: A word puzzle mini-game collection featuring 28 different challenges for up to five players. Test your vocabulary and spelling skills through word searches, crosswords, anagrams, and unique games like Spelling Bee, Space Blaster, and Word Factory. Play solo or compete with friends using the GamePad and Wii Remotes. Mini-games unlock progressively as you play, offering a variety of word-based challenges set in colorful themed environments with bees, robots, fish, spaceships and more. Perfect for families seeking educational entertainment. Sources: - [Word Party | Wii U download software | Games | Nintendo UK](https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Wii-U-download-software/Word-Party-1066939.htm

title: Word Puzzles by Powgi
description: A collection of six classic word puzzle types with 480 challenges total. Solve Word Mazes by linking letters into continuous paths, search for hidden words in One Word grids, build vocabulary chains in Flowers, unscramble overlapping words in Circles, complete mini-crosswords in Crossovers, and untangle three-way anagrams in Mixups. Touch-screen controls make solving intuitive, while amiibo support generates special bonus puzzles. Each puzzle type offers 80 brain-teasing challenges ranging from relaxing to fiendishly difficult. Sources: - [Word Puzzles by POWGI for Wii U - Nintendo Game Details](https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/word-puzzles-by-powgi-wii-u/) - [Word Puzzles by POWGI Rev

title: Word Search by Powgi
description: A classic word search puzzle game featuring over 300 puzzles across 27 themed categories. Find hidden words in letter grids by selecting them with the GamePad's touch screen or Wii Remote. Supports up to five players for cooperative or competitive puzzle-solving. Play entirely on the GamePad without a TV. Each completed puzzle reveals a fun fact related to its theme. Simple, straightforward word-finding gameplay ideal for vocabulary practice and casual gaming sessions. Includes diverse categories ranging from animals and geography to pop culture and science. Sources: - [Word Search by POWGI (Wii U eShop)- Review – Seafoam Gaming](https://seafoamgaming.com/2015/05/16/word-search-by-powgi-wii

title: Xenoblade Chronicles X
description: Xenoblade Chronicles X is an open world action role-playing video game developed by Monolith Soft and published by Nintendo for the Wii U home video game console in 2015. Xenoblade Chronicles X forms part of the Xenometa series, being a spiritual successor to Xenoblade Chronicles without any narrative connections to prior Xeno titles. Carrying over several gameplay elements from Xenoblade Chronicles, players explore the open world planet Mira, completing a variety of quests and unlocking new regions to explore and gather resources from across Mira's five continents.

title: Xeodrifter
description: Explore alien planets and blast your way through this retro-inspired sci-fi adventure. As a lone explorer searching for a mysterious power, you'll navigate procedurally-connected worlds, battle bizarre bosses, and upgrade your abilities to reach new areas. Xeodrifter delivers classic Metroidvania gameplay in a compact package, featuring pixel-perfect platforming, intense shoot-em-up action, and multiple planets to explore. Defeat massive guardians to collect valuable upgrades that enhance your weapon and movement abilities, then use your new powers to access previously unreachable locations.

title: XType Plus
description: A vertical shoot 'em up with twin-stick controls where you defend against endless waves of procedurally generated enemies. Features two game modes: Classic Mode offers zen-like survival gameplay, while Plus Mode adds faster movement, EMP bombs, and a time-based challenge where destroying bosses extends your survival counter. Each boss encounter is procedurally generated, ensuring no two battles are identical. Developed using HTML5 and the Nintendo Web Framework by PhobosLab. Sources: - [XType Plus Review (Wii U eShop) | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/wiiu-eshop/xtype_plus) - [XType Plus – an HTML5 Game for the Nintendo Wii U](https://phoboslab.org/log/2014/07/xtype-plus

title: Year Walk
description: Step into a haunting Swedish folklore experience where ancient myths come alive. This atmospheric first-person adventure challenges you to brave the mysterious ritual of Year Walking, venturing into a dark winter night to glimpse the future. Explore a beautifully eerie 2D landscape filled with cryptic puzzles, supernatural encounters, and deeply unsettling creatures drawn from Nordic mythology. Every interaction reveals fragments of forgotten traditions and strange phenomena. The minimalist art style and ambient soundscape create a uniquely disturbing atmosphere as you piece together the rules governing this otherworldly journey.

title: Yoshi's Woolly World
description: Yoshi's Woolly World is a side-scrolling platformer video game developed by Good-Feel and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. The game is the seventh main entry in the Yoshi series of games, the first home console title in the series since 1997's Yoshi's Story, as well as the spiritual successor to 2010's Kirby's Epic Yarn.The game was released worldwide throughout 2015. A port for the Nintendo 3DS, known as Poochy & Yoshi's Woolly World, was released worldwide in early 2017.

title: Your Shape - Fitness Evolved 2013
description: Step into your personal fitness center with Your Shape: Fitness Evolved 2013, bringing Ubisoft's acclaimed motion-controlled workout series to Wii U. Using advanced camera tracking technology, the game scans your body and delivers personalized fitness programs tailored to your goals. Choose from over 125 workout routines spanning cardio boxing, dance classes, yoga, strength training, and boot camp exercises. The GamePad serves as your personal trainer, displaying real-time feedback and form corrections while you exercise. Challenge friends in competitive fitness games, unlock achievements as you progress, and track your fitness journey with detailed statistics.

title: ZaciSa's Last Stand
description: Defend your base against relentless waves of demons in this chaotic tower defense shooter. As the last line of defense, you must strategically place defensive structures while directly controlling your character to blast away hordes of enemies. Combine strategic tower placement with frantic twin-stick shooting action as demons pour in from all directions. Upgrade your defenses, unlock powerful weapons, and master the balance between building your fortress and jumping into the fray yourself. With its blend of tactical planning and arcade-style combat, every wave becomes an intense test of multitasking and quick reflexes. Can you survive the onslaught and make your last stand count?

title: ZEN Pinball 2
description: Zen Pinball 2 is a pinball video game developed by Zen Studios for the Wii U, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Android, and PlayStation Vita. The game was announced on April 9, 2012. The first PlayStation versions were released on September 4, 2012 in North America and September 5 in Europe while the Wii U version was released on March 21, 2013 in North America and January 31, 2013 in Europe.

title: Ziggurat
description: Step into a mysterious dungeon as a neophyte sorcerer in this fast-paced first-person shooter roguelite. Wield an arsenal of magical weapons and spells as you battle through procedurally generated rooms filled with monstrous enemies. Each run offers new wand and spell combinations, with over 50 weapons to discover and master. Unlock powerful perks, collect rare alchemy items, and upgrade your character between runs. The roguelite structure means permanent death, but also fresh challenges and build possibilities every time. Quick reflexes and smart spellcasting are essential as enemy hordes grow fiercer with each floor.

title: Zombeer
description: Zombeer is a first-person shooter that combines zombie-slaying action with crude humor and beer-fueled gameplay. As the protagonist fighting through a zombie outbreak, you'll discover that beer is the only thing keeping you from turning into a zombie yourself. Blast through hordes of undead enemies while managing your beer consumption to stay human. The game features over-the-top comic violence, irreverent humor, and a variety of weapons ranging from conventional firearms to improvised zombie-smashing tools. Navigate through infested environments, uncover the source of the zombie plague, and maintain your buzz to survive.

title: Zombie Defense
description: Rally desperate soldiers and fight off relentless waves of the undead in this hybrid tower defense and RTS experience. Deploy 15 different army units, equip them with 19 weapon types, and command them strategically across 35 deadly missions. Upgrade your forces with 98 improvements and advanced technologies including laser turrets and Tesla towers. Battle through Normal and Nightmare modes as you innovate destructive new technologies to halt the zombie apocalypse. Victory depends on smart placement, tactical commands, and lethal firepower. Sources: - [Zombie Defense (2015) | Wii U eShop Game | Nintendo Life](https://www.nintendolife.com/games/wiiu-eshop/zombie_defense) - [Zombie Defense Rev

title: ZombiU
description: ZombiU (known as Zombion platforms other than the Wii U) is a first-person survival horror video game developed by Ubisoft Montpellier and published by Ubisoft. It was released for the Wii U as one of its launch games in November 2012. In the game, the player assumes control of a human survivor amid a 2012 zombie apocalypse. Featuring a permadeath system, it uses the Wii U GamePad extensively to scan the environment and maintain the survivor's inventory.

title: Zumba Fitness World Party
description: Dance your way around the world in this exhilarating fitness party game that transforms your living room into a global dance floor. Zumba Fitness World Party brings authentic Zumba choreography to life with 40+ high-energy routines set to new and licensed songs spanning international styles from Brazil to Bollywood. The GamePad displays real-time feedback on your moves and calories burned while you follow on-screen instructors through Latin, hip-hop, and world music-inspired workouts. With customizable workout lengths, multiplayer support for up to four players, and unlockable venues from exotic locations worldwide, every session delivers an engaging fitness experience that never feels li...
